H1.definition: a primitive word; 1) father of an individual; 2) of God as father of his people; 3) head or founder of a household, group, family, or clan; 4) ancestor; 4a) grandfather, forefathers — of person; 4b) of people; 5) originator or patron of a class, profession, or art; 6) of producer, generator (fig.); 7) of benevolence and protection (fig.); 8) term of respect and honour; 9) ruler or chief (spec.)
H1.kjvUsage: chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'

H3.definition: from the same as H24; 1) freshness, fresh green, green shoots, or greenery

H4.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3 1) fruit, fresh, young, greening

H5.definition: of foreign origin; Abagtha = "God-given"; 1) one of the seven eunuchs in the Persian court of Ahasuerus

H6.definition: a primitive root; 1) perish, vanish, go astray, be destroyed; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) perish, die, be exterminated; 1a2) perish, vanish (fig.); 1a3) be lost, strayed; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to destroy, kill, cause to perish, to give up (as lost), exterminate; 1b2) to blot out, do away with, cause to vanish, (fig.); 1b3) cause to stray, lose; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to destroy, put to death; 1c1a) of divine judgment; 1c2) object name of kings (fig.)
H6.kjvUsage: break, destroy(-uction), [phrase] not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, [idiom] and surely, take, be undone, [idiom] utterly, be void of, have no way to flee

H7.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H6 1) to perish, vanish; 1a) (P'al) shall perish; 1b) (Aphel) destroy; 1c) (Hophal) be destroyed

H8.definition: active of participle of H6; 1) destruction

H9.definition: from H6; Compare H10. 1) a lost thing, something lost

H10.definition: the same as H9, miswritten for H11; 1) a lost thing, something lost, a perishing

H11.definition: intensive from H6; 1) place of destruction, destruction, ruin, Abaddon

H14.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be willing, consent; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be willing; 1a2) to consent, yield to, accept; 1a3) to desire
H14.kjvUsage: consent, rest content will, be willing

H16.definition: from H14 (in the sense of bending toward); 1) reed, papyrus; ++++; Probably ships made of reeds or papyrus were the clipper sailing ships of those days because of their speed.

H17.definition: from H14 (in the sense of desiring); 1) Oh!, Woe!, (exclamation of pain — indicates desire or uneasiness)

H18.definition: from H75; 1) crib, manger, feeding trough

H19.definition: from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn); 1) slaughter, flesh, meat, slaughtered meat

H20.definition: of uncertain derivation; 1) watermelon, Egyptian fruit

H21.definition: from H1; fatherly; Abi = "my father"; 1) mother of Hezekiah (cf H029)

H22.definition: from H1 and H410; father (i.e. possessor) of God; Abiel = "El (God) is (my) father"; 1) Saul's grandfather

H23.definition: from H1 and H622; father of gathering (i.e. gatherer); Abiasaph = "my father has gathered"; 1) son (descendant) of Korah

H24.definition: from an unused root (meaning to be tender); 1) fresh, young barley ears, barley; 2) month of ear-forming, of greening of crop, of growing green Abib, month of exodus and passover (March or April)
H24.kjvUsage: Abib, ear, green ears of corn (not maize)

H25.definition: from H1 and H1391; father (i.e. founder) of Gibon; Abi Gibon = "father of Gibeon"; 1) site of great Bamah, location of the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place

H26.definition: or shorter אֲבִיגַל; from H1 and H1524; father (i.e. source) of joy; Abigail = "my father is joy"; 1) wife of Nabal, then of David; 2) sister of David

H27.definition: from H1 and H1777; father of judgment (i.e. judge); Abidan = "my father is judge"; 1) a prince (ruler) of Benjamin

H28.definition: from H1 and H3045; father of knowledge (i.e. knowing); Abida or Abidah = "my father knows"; 1) fourth son of Midian and grandson of Abraham by his wife Keturah (after Sarah died)

H29.definition: or prolonged אֲבִיָּהוּ ; from H1 and H3050; father (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Abia or Abiah or Abijah = "Jehovah is (my) father"; 1) king of Judah, son and successor of Rehoboam; 2) second son of Samuel; 3) son of Jeroboam the first, king of Israel; 4) son of Becher, a Benjamite; 5) head of a priestly house (one of the 24 Levite groups); 6) head of a priestly house (after the exile); 7) wife of Hezron; 8) mother of Hezekiah (cf H021)

H30.definition: from H1 and H1931; father (i.e. worshipper) of Him (i.e. God); Abihu = "he is (my) father"; 1) a son of Aaron destroyed for sacrificing strange fire to God

H31.definition: from H1 and H1935; father (i.e. possessor) of renown; Abihud = "my father is majesty"; 1) son of Bela, a Benjamite

H32.definition: or (more correctly) אֲבִיחַיִל ; from H1 and H2428; father (i.e. possessor) of might; Abihail = "my father is might"; 1) a Levite in Moses's time; 2) a Gadite; 3) father of Esther; 4) wife of Abishur; 5) wife of Rehoboam

H33.definition: from H44 with the article inserted; father of the Ezrite; Abiezrite = "my father is help"; 1) one of the family of Abiezer, a descendant of Joseph's son, Manasseh

H34.definition: from H14, in the sense of want (especially in feeling); 1) in want, needy, chiefly poor, needy person; 2) subject to oppression and abuse; 3) needing help, deliverance from trouble, especially as delivered by God; 4) general reference to lowest class

H36.definition: from H1 and H2898; father of goodness (i.e. good); Abitub = "my father is good(ness)"; 1) son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite

H37.definition: from H1 and H2919; father of dew (i.e. fresh); Abital = "my father is (the) dew"; 1) a wife of David

H38.definition: from H1 and H3220; father of (the) sea (i.e. seaman); Abijam = "my father is the sea" or "Yah(u) is (my) father"; 1) king of Judah, son and successor of Rehoboam

H39.definition: from H1 and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe); Abimael = "my father is El (God)"; 1) son of Joktan, descendant of Shem

H40.definition: from H1 and H4428; father of (the) king; Abimelech = "Melek is father" or "my father is king"; 1) king of Gerar in Abraham's time; 2) king of Gath in David's time; maybe title of Philistine kings; 3) son of Gideon by a concubine; 4) priest, son of Abiathar

H41.definition: from H1 and H5068; father of generosity (i.e. liberal); Abinadab = "my father is noble" or "my father is willing"; 1) a man of Gibeah who sheltered the ark; 2) second son of Jesse, David's older brother; 3) a son of Saul, slain with him by the Philistines

H42.definition: from H1 and H5278; father of pleasantness (i.e. gracious); Abinoam = "my father is delight"; 1) father of Barak, descendant of Naphtali

H43.definition: contracted from H23; Ebiasaph = "my father has gathered"; 1) a son or descendant of Korah

H44.definition: from H1 and H5829; father of help (i.e. helpful); Abiezer = "my father is help"; 1) a Manassite, called "son" of Gilead, also son of Gilead's sister; 2) a Benjamite, warrior of David

H45.definition: from H1 and an unused root of uncertain derivation; probably, father of strength (i.e. valiant); Abialbon = "El (God) is my father"; 1) one of David's mighty men (hero)

H46.definition: from H82; 1) strong, mighty-used only to describe God; 2) the Strong-old name for God (poetic)

H47.definition: for H46 1) mighty, valiant; 1a) of men; 1b) of angels; 1c) of animals; 1d) (metaph); 1d1) of enemies; 1d2) of princes; 1d3) of sacrificial objects; 1e) obstinate (fig.)
H47.kjvUsage: angel, bull, chiefest, mighty (one), stout(-hearted), strong (one), valiant

H48.definition: from H1 and H7311; father of height (i.e. lofty); Abiram = "my father is exalted" or "(the) Exalted One is (my) father"; 1) a Reubenite, son of Eliab in exodus; 2) son of Hiel the Bethelite who worked to rebuild Jericho

H49.definition: from H1 and H7686; father of error (i.e. blundering); Abishag = "my father is a wanderer"; 1) David's beautiful young nurse

H50.definition: from H1 and H7771; father of plenty (i.e. prosperous); Abishua = "my father is rescue (safety), or is opulence"; 1) son of Phinehas, grandson of Aaron

H51.definition: from H1 and H7791; father of (the) wall (i.e. perhaps mason); Abishur = "my father is a wall"; 1) son of Shammai, descendant of Judah

H52.definition: or (shorter) אַבְשַׁי ; from H1 and H7862; father of a gift (i.e. probably generous); Abishai = "my father is Jesse" or "my father is a gift"; 1) grandson of Jesse, nephew of David via his sister Zeruiah, brother of Joab

H53.definition: or (shortened) אַבְשָׁלוֹם ; from H1 and H7965; father of peace (i.e. friendly); Absalom or Abishalom = "my father is peace"; 1) father-in-law of Rehoboam; 2) third son of David, killer of first-born son Amnon, also leader of revolt against his father-David

H54.definition: contracted from H1 and H3498; father of abundance (i.e. liberal); Abiathar = "my father is great"; 1) priest, son of Ahitub (Ahimelech), faithful to David, but later rebelled with Adonijah

H55.definition: a primitive root; 1) to roll, turn; 1a) (Hithpael) to roll, roll up, billow

H56.definition: a primitive root; 1) to mourn, lament; 1a) (Qal) to mourn, lament; 1a1) of humans; 1a2) of inanimate objects (fig.); 1a2a) of gates; 1a2b) of land; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to mourn, cause to mourn (fig.); 1c) (Hithpael); 1c1) to mourn; 1c2) play the mourner

H57.definition: from H56; 1) mourning; 1a) for the dead; 1b) because of calamity; 1c) of rites of mourning; 2) mourner (subst.); 2a) for the dead; 2b) for calamity

H58.definition: from an unused root (meaning to be grassy); 1) meadow (from verb-to grow green, to withstand)
H58.kjvUsage: plain. Compare also the proper names beginning with Abel-

H59.definition: from H58; a meadow; 1) city in northern Israel near Bethmaachah; 2) the place where the ark rested in the field of Joshua at Bethshemesh

H60.definition: from H56; 1) mourning; 1a) for the dead; 1b) for rites of mourning (metaph); 1c) mourning garb; 1d) period of mourning

H61.definition: apparently from H56 through the idea of negation; 1) truly, verily, surely; 2) but, however, howbeit; 3) contrariwise, nay rather (neg.)

H62.definition: from H58 and H1004 and H4601; meadow of Beth-Maakah; Abel Beth Maachah = "meadow of the house of Maachah"; 1) city in northern Israel near Beth Maachah

H63.definition: from H58 and the plural of H7848, with the article inserted; meadow of the acacias; Abel Shittim = "meadow of acacias"; 1) place in lowlands of Moab

H64.definition: from H58 and the plural of H3754; meadow of vineyards; Abel Keramim = "meadow of the vineyards"; 1) a place in Ammon

H65.definition: from H58 and H4246xlit mᵉchôwlâh corrected to mᵉchôlâh; meadow of dancing; Abel Meholah = "meadow of dancing"; 1) a city of Issachar, birthplace of Elisha

H66.definition: from H58 and H4325; meadow of water; Abel Maim = "meadow of waters"; 1) a city in northern Israel (perhaps Abel Beth Maachah)

H67.definition: from H58 and H4714; meadow of Egypt; Abel Mizraim = "meadow of Egypt"; 1) a place east of the Jordan (perhaps "as fertile as Egypt")

H68.definition: from the root of H1129 through the meaning to build; 1) stone (large or small); 1a) common stone (in natural state); 1b) stone, as material; 1b1) of tablets; 1b2) marble, hewn stones; 1c) precious stones, stones of fire; 1d) stones containing metal (ore), tool for work or weapon; 1e) weight; 1f) plummet (stones of destruction) also made of metal; 1g) stonelike objects, eg hailstones, stony heart, ice; 1h) sacred object, as memorial Samuel set up to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines; 1i) (simile); 1i1) sinking in water, motionlessness; 1i2) strength, firmness, solidity; 1i3) commonness; 1j) (metaph); 1j1) petrified with terror; 1j2) perverse, hard heart
H68.kjvUsage: [phrase] carbuncle, [phrase] mason, [phrase] plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-) stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s)

H69.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H68 1) stone; 1a) a (the) stone; 1b) stone, material of idols and buildings

H70.definition: from the same as H68; 1) wheel, disc; 1a) potter's wheel; 1b) bearing-stool, midwife's stool

H71.definition: perhaps feminine of H68; stony; Compare H549. 1) river Abana, Syrian river flowing through Damascus

H72.definition: from H68 and H5828 with the article inserted; stone of the help; Ebenezer = "stone of help"; 1) memorial stone erected by Samuel to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines-north of Jerusalem

H73.definition: of uncertain derivation; 1) girdle, sash, waistband; 1a) of high priest; 1b) of other priests; 1c) of high official

H74.definition: or (fully) אֲבִינֵר ; from H1 and H5216; father of light (i.e. enlightening); Abner = "my father is a lamp"; 1) Saul's cousin and army captain, treacherously slain by Joab

H75.definition: a primitive root; 1) to feed, fatten; 1a) (Qal) fattened (passive participle)

H76.definition: (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth); 1) blisters, boils (from root, to swell up)

H77.definition: from an unused root probably meaning to gleam; conspicuous; Abez = "I will make white (or miry)"; 1) a city in Issachar

H78.definition: from the same as H76; splendid; Ibzan, "their whiteness (literally their tin — as white"; 1) a Bethlehemite judge in time of the judges

H79.definition: a primitive root, probably to float away (as vapor), but used only as denominative from H80; 1) (Niphal) to wrestle, grapple (get dusty), bedust

H80.definition: from root of H79; 1) dust; 1a) on ground; 1b) clouds (fig.)

H81.definition: feminine of H80 1) aromatic powders, powder

H82.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Hiphil) to fly (to move wings)

H83.definition: from H82; 1) pinion, wing; 1a) of bird (dove, eagle); 1b) of Babylonian king (fig.)

H84.definition: feminine of H83 1) pinion, wing; 1a) of bird (ostrich, eagle, dove); 1b) of God (metaph)

H85.definition: contracted from H1 and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous); father of a multitude; Abraham = "father of a multitude" or "chief of multitude"; 1) friend of God and founder of Hebrew nation via God's elective covenant

H86.definition: probably an Egyptian word meaning 1) (meaning dubious) -a shout made to announce Joseph's chariot; 1a) command; 1b) bow

H87.definition: contracted from H48; high father; Abram = "exalted father"; 1) original name of Abraham

H88.definition: plural of H178; water-skins; Oboth = "waterskins"; 1) undetermined site of an Israelite camp in the wilderness (perhaps at east boundary of Moab)

H89.definition: of uncertain derivation (compare H90); Agee = "I shall increase"; 1) father of a warrior of David

H90.definition: or אֲגָג; of uncertain derivation (compare H89); flame; Agag = "I will overtop"; 1) king of Amalek, spared by Saul but slain by Samuel

H91.definition: patrial or patronymic from H90; Agagite = "I will overtop"; 1) said of Haman, Haman the Agagite

H92.definition: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to bind); 1) band, binding; 1a) cords, bands, thongs (metaphorical of slavery); 1b) bunch of hyssop; 1c) band of men, troops; 1d) vault (of the heavens), firmament (binding earth to the heavens)

H94.definition: passive participle of H103; gathered (i.e. received among the sages); Agur = "gathered"; 1) son of Jakeh, an author or compiler of Pr 30:1-33

H95.definition: from the same as H94; 1) payment, piece, coin

H96.definition: from an unused root (meaning to flow down or together as drops); 1) drop, reserve supply, collections, stores

H97.definition: dual of H96.; a double pond; Eglaim = "double reservoir"; 1) a town in Moab

H98.definition: from an unused root (meaning to collect as water); 1) pool, troubled pool; 1a) troubled or muddy (gloomy) pools, marshes; 1b) any pool, pond; 1c) swamp reeds, reeds, rush(es)

H99.definition: probably from the same as H98 (in the sense of stagnant water); 1) stagnant pond

H100.definition: from the same as H98; a marshy pool (others from a different root, a kettle); by implication 1) rush, bulrush; 1a) used as cord or line (of twisted rushes or spun of rush fibre); 1b) of the lowly, insignificant (metaph); 2) sad, drooping; 1a) of line of bulrushes; 1b) bowing of the head (fig.); 1c) of the lowly (metaph)

H101.definition: probably from H5059; 1) bowl, basins; 1a) basins used in ritual; 1b) human body (metaph), curves of the body (simile); 1c) of family of Eliakim (metaph)

H102.definition: probably from H5062 (through the idea of impending); a cover or heap; i.e. 1) wing (of an army), band, army, hordes

H103.definition: a primitive root; 1) to gather; 1a) (Qal) to gather

H104.definition: (Aramaic) of Persian origin; 1) letter, missive (Aramaic loan-word used in last OT books)

H105.definition: of uncertain derivation; 1) vessel, basket, leather bag, basin

H106.definition: from H1640 (in the sense of grasping); 1) fist

H108.definition: from the same as H181 (in the sense of enveloping); 1) mist

H109.definition: a primitive root; 1) to grieve, cause grief; 1a) (Hiph) to cause to grieve, to grieve, to cause grief

H110.definition: probably from H109 (in the sense of chastisement) and H410; disciplined of God; Adbeel = "chastened of God"; 1) third son of Ishmael and grandson of Abraham

H111.definition: probably an orthographical variation for H2301; Hadad = "I shall move softly: I shall love"; 1) an Edomite enemy God raised up to punish Solomon for his sins

H112.definition: of uncertain derivation; Iddo = "I will praise him"; 1) a chief Israelite during resettlement

H113.definition: or (shortened) אָדֹן; from an unused root (meaning to rule); 1) firm, strong, lord, master; 1a) lord, master; 1a1) reference to men; 1a1a) superintendent of household, of affairs; 1a1b) master; 1a1c) king; 1a2) reference to God; 1a2a) the Lord God; 1a2b) Lord of the whole earth; 1b) lords, kings; 1b1) reference to men; 1b1a) proprietor of hill of Samaria; 1b1b) master; 1b1c) husband; 1b1d) prophet; 1b1e) governor; 1b1f) prince; 1b1g) king; 1b2) reference to God; 1b2a) Lord of lords (probably = "thy husband, Yahweh"); 1c) my lord, my master; 1c1) reference to men; 1c1a) master; 1c1b) husband; 1c1c) prophet; 1c1d) prince; 1c1e) king; 1c1f) father; 1c1g) Moses; 1c1h) priest; 1c1i) theophanic angel; 1c1j) captain; 1c1k) general recognition of superiority; 1c2) reference to God; 1c2a) my Lord, my Lord and my God; 1c2b) Adonai (parallel with Yahweh)
H113.kjvUsage: lord, master, owner. Compare also names beginning with 'Adoni-'

H114.definition: probably intensive for H113; powerful; Addon = "powerful"; 1) an Israelite?

H115.definition: dual from H142 (in the sense of eminence); double mound; Adoraim = "double glory"; 1) city in Judah fortified by Rehoboam about 5 miles or 8 km SW of Hebron

H116.definition: (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; 1) then, afterwards, thereupon, from that time

H117.definition: from H142; 1) great, majestic; 1a) of waters of sea; 1b) of a tree; 1c) of kings, nations, gods; 2) great one, majestic one; 2a) of nobles, chieftains, servants
H117.kjvUsage: excellent, famous, gallant, glorious, goodly, lordly, mighty(-ier one), noble, principal, worthy

H118.definition: of Persian derivation; Adalia = "I shall be drawn up of Jah"; 1) fifth son of Haman, executed at same time

H119.definition: to show blood (in the face), i.e. 1) to be red, red; 1a) (Qal) ruddy (of Nazarites); 1b) (Pual); 1b1) to be rubbed red; 1b2) dyed red; 1b3) reddened; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to show red; 1c2) to glare; 1c3) to emit (show) redness; 1d) (Hithpael); 1d1) to redden; 1d2) to grow red; 1d3) to look red

H120.definition: from H119; 1) man, mankind; 1a) man, human being; 1b) man, mankind (much more frequently intended sense in OT); 1c) Adam, first man; 1d) city in Jordan valley
H120.kjvUsage: [idiom] another, [phrase] hypocrite, [phrase] common sort, [idiom] low, man (mean, of low degree), person

H121.definition: the same as H120; Adam = "red"; 1) first man; 2) city in Jordan valley

H122.definition: from H119; 1) red, ruddy (of man, horse, heifer, garment, water, lentils)

H123.definition: or (fully) אֱדוֹם ; from H122; red (see Genesis 25:25); Edom = "red"; 1) Edom; 2) Edomite, Idumean-descendants of Esau; 3) land of Edom, Idumea-land south and south east of Palestine

H124.definition: from H119; 1) ruby, carnelian (redness); 1a) precious stone

H125.definition: reduplicated from H119; 1) reddish, be reddish

H126.definition: contracted for H127; earthy; Admah = "red earth"; 1) city in the Siddim valley

H127.definition: from H119; 1) ground, land; 1a) ground (as general, tilled, yielding sustenance); 1b) piece of ground, a specific plot of land; 1c) earth substance (for building or constructing); 1d) ground as earth's visible surface; 1e) land, territory, country; 1f) whole inhabited earth; 1g) city in Naphtali

H128.definition: the same as H127; Adamah = "the earth"; 1) city in Naphtali

H129.definition: from H127; earthy; Adami = "man of Adar"; 1) a pass or fortified place in Naphtali

H130.definition: or (fully) אֱדוֹמִי ; patronymic from H123; See H726. 1) Edomite

H131.definition: plural of H121; red spots; Adummim = "ruddy one: quieted ones?"; 1) pass or ridge of hills, west of Gilgal

H132.definition: or (fully) אַדְמוֹנִי ; from H119; 1) red, ruddy (of Esau as infant)

H133.definition: probably of Persian derivation; Admatha = "a testimony to them"; 1) prince of Persia in reign of Ahasuerus (Xerxes)

H134.definition: from the same as H113 (in the sense of strength); 1) base, pedestal, socket (strong, firm); 1a) pedestals of gold on which marble pillars were set; 1b) pedestals of the earth, foundation of the earth; 1c) pedestals, bases, or sockets on which tabernacle stood

H135.definition: intensive from the same as H134; firm; Addan = "strong, firm"; 1) place in Babylon, from which exiles returned

H136.definition: an emphatic form of H113; 1) my lord, lord; 1a) of men; 1b) of God; 2) Lord-title, spoken in place of Yahweh in Jewish display of reverence

H137.definition: from H113 and H966; lord of Bezek; Adoni-Bezek = "my lord is Besek"; 1) king of the Canaanite city of Bezek, killed by Israelites

H138.definition: original (prolonged) אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ ; from H113 and H3050; lord (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Adonijah = "my lord is Jehovah"; 1) fourth son of David and Solomon's rival for the throne; 2) Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law; 3) a chief of the people who co-operated with Nehemiah

H139.definition: from H113 and H6664; lord of justice; Adoni-zedek = "my lord is righteous"; 1) Canaanite king slain by Joshua

H140.definition: from H113 and H6965; lord of rising (i.e. high); Adonikam = "my lord arose"; 1) the head of an Israelite clan who returned from exile

H141.definition: from H113 and H7311; lord of height; Adoniram = "my lord is exalted"; 1) one of Solomon's officers

H142.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be great, be majestic, wide, noble (poetic); 1a) (Niphal) majestic, glorious (participle); 1b) (Hiphil) make glorious

H143.definition: probably of foreign derivation; perhaps meaning fire; Adar = "glorious"; 1) twelfth month, corresponding to modern March-April

H144.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H143 Adar = "glorious"; 1) twelfth month, corresponding to modern March or April

H145.definition: from H142; 1) glory, magnificence; 2) mantle, cloak (as wide)

H146.definition: intensive from H142; ample; Addar or Adar = "exceeding glorious"; 1) son of Bela and Benjamin's grandson; 2) city in Judah near Edom

H147.definition: (Aramaic) intensive, from a root corresponding to H142; 1) threshing floor

H148.definition: (Aramaic) from the same as H147, and H1505; 1) judge (diviner), counsellor

H149.definition: (Aramaic) probably of Persian origin; 1) correctly, exactly, diligently, earnestly

H150.definition: of Persian origin; 1) drachma, dram, daric-unit of weight and value (of gold, money) equal to 128 grains or 4.32 grams

H151.definition: contracted for H141; Adoram = "my lord is exalted"; 1) an officer of David; 2) an officer of Rehoboam

H152.definition: from H142 and H4428; splendor of (the) king; Adrammelech = "honour of the king" or "Adar is prince" or "Adar is Counsellor, Decider"; 1) an idol or god of the Sepharvites, introduced to Israel by Shalmaneser the fifth; 2) the son and murderer of Sennacherib

H153.definition: (Aramaic) an orthographical variation for H1872; 1) strong, force, arm, power

H154.definition: from the equivalent of H153; mighty; Edrei = "goodly pasture"; 1) a chief city of Bashan, north of Jabbok river

H155.definition: feminine of H117; ; also the same as H145 1) glory, cloak; 1a) glory, splendour, magnificence (of a vine, shepherds); 1b) mantle, cloak made of fur or fine material; 1b1) prophet's garment

H156.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to tread, tread on, thresh, trample on

H159.definition: from H156; meaning the same as H158 1) loved object; 2) (TWOT) love

H161.definition: from an unused root meaning to be united; unity; Ohad = "united"; 1) son of Simeon and grandson of Jacob

H162.definition: apparently a primitive word expressing pain exclamatorily; 1) alas!, oh!, ah!

H163.definition: probably of foreign origin; Ahava = "I shall subsist"; 1) town or area in Babylonia

H165.definition: apparently an orthographical variation for H346; 1) where

H166.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Hiphil) to be clear, shine

H167.definition: a denominative from H168; 1) to pitch a tent, to move a tent; 1a) (Qal) pitch or remove a tent; 1a) (Piel) to pitch one's tent

H168.definition: from H166; 1) tent; 1a) nomad's tent, and thus symbolic of wilderness life, transience; 1b) dwelling, home, habitation; 1c) the sacred tent of Jehovah (the tabernacle)

H169.definition: the same as H168; Ohel = "tent"; 1) son of Zerubbabel

H170.definition: in form a feminine of H168, but in fact for אׇהֳלָהּ; from H168; her tent (i.e. idolatrous sanctuary); Aholah = "her own tent"; 1) Samaria as an adulteress with Assyria (metaph)

H171.definition: from H168 and H1; tent of (his) father; Aholiab = "Father's tent"; 1) chief assistant of Bezaleel in construction of the tabernacle

H172.definition: (similarly with H170) for אׇהֳלִיבָהּ ; from H168; my tent (is) in her; Aholibah = "woman of the tent" or "the tent is in her"; 1) (metaph) Jerusalem as adulterous wife of Jehovah

H173.definition: from H168 and H1116; tent of (the) height; Aholibamah = "tent of the high place"; 1) wife of Esau; 2) an Edomite chieftain

H174.definition: or (feminine) אֲהָלוֹת (only used thus in the plural); of foreign origin; 1) aloes, aloe tree; 1a) aloe tree; 1b) aloe (perfume)

H175.definition: of uncertain derivation; Aaron = "light bringer"; 1) brother of Moses, a Levite and the first high priest

H176.definition: presumed to be the 'constructive' or genitival form of אַו ; short for H185; 1) or, rather; 1a) implying that the latter choice is preferred; 1b) or if, introducing an example to be seen under a particular principle; 1c) (in series) either...or, whether...or; 1d) if perchance; 1e) except, or else; 2) whether, not the least, if, otherwise, also, and, then

H177.definition: from H176 and H410; wish of God; Uel = "wish or will of God"; 1) a Judean who had taken a foreign woman during the exile

H178.definition: from the same as H1 (apparently through the idea of prattling a father's name); 1) water skin bottle; 2) necromancer; 1b) necromancer, one who evokes the dead; 1c) ghost, spirit of a dead one; 1d) practice of necromancy; 3) one that has a familiar spirit

H179.definition: probably from H56; mournful; Obil = "camel driver"; 1) manager of David's camels

H180.definition: or (shortened) אֻבָל ; from H2986 (in the sense of H2988); 1) stream, river

H181.definition: from an unused root meaning to rake together; 1) brand, fire brand

H182.definition: or (shortened) אֹדוֹת (only thus in the plural); from the same as H181; 1) cause; 1a) cause, reason for; 1b) the occasion of

H183.definition: a primitive root; 1) desire, incline, covet, wait longingly, wish, sigh, want, be greedy, prefer; 1a) (Piel) to desire, crave (food and drink); 1b) (Hithpael) to desire, long for, lust after (of bodily appetites)
H183.kjvUsage: covet, (greatly) desire, be desirous, long, lust (after)

H184.definition: a primitive root; 1) to sign, mark, describe with a mark; 1a) (Hithpael) to measure, mark out, mark you out

H185.definition: from H183; 1) desire, lust, will (not necessarily evil)

H186.definition: perhaps by permutation for H5813, strong; Uzai = "I shall have my sprinklings"; 1) a Judean, one of the repairers of Jerusalem's walls

H187.definition: of uncertain derivation; Uzal = "I shall be flooded"; 1) sixth son Joktan

H188.definition: probably from H183 (in the sense of crying out after); 1) woe! alas! oh!; 1a) passionate cry of grief or despair

H189.definition: probably from H183; desirous; Evi = "my desire"; 1) one of five chiefs of Midian

H191.definition: from an unused root (meaning to be perverse); 1) be foolish, foolish; 1a) (subst); 1a1) of one who despises wisdom; 1a2) of one who mocks when guilty; 1a3) of one who is quarrelsome; 1a4) of one who is licentious

H193.definition: from an unused root meaning to twist, i.e. (by implication) be strong; 1) prominence; 1a) body, belly (contemptuous); 1b) nobles, wealthy men

H194.definition: or (shortened) אֻלַי; from H176; 1) perhaps, peradventure; 2) if peradventure; 3) unless; 4) suppose

H195.definition: of Persian derivation; Ulai = "my leaders (mighties)"; 1) river of Elam

H197.definition: or (shortened), אֻלָם ; from H481 (in the sense of tying); 1) porch; 1a) in Solomon's temple; 1b) in Solomon's palace; 1c) in temple of Ezekiel's vision

H198.definition: appar, from H481 (in the sense of dumbness); solitary; Ulam = "their leader: vestibule"; 1) a Manassite; 2) a Benjamite of Saul's family

H199.definition: apparently a variation of H194; 1) but, but indeed (a strong adversative); 2) however, nevertheless

H200.definition: from the same as H191; 1) foolishness, folly

H201.definition: from H559; talkative; Omar = "speaker" or "eloquent"; 1) grandson of Esau

H202.definition: probably from the same as H205 (in the sense of effort, but successful); 1) vigour, generative power; 2) wealth; 3) physical strength (of men and behemoth)

H212.definition: or (shortened) אֹפָן; from an unused root meaning to revolve; 1) wheel; 1a) chariot wheel; 1b) wheel in Ezekiel's vision; 1c) wheels of the ten bases beneath the lavers in Solomon's temple

H213.definition: a primitive root; 1) to press, be pressed, make haste, urge, be narrow; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to press, hasten; 1a2) to be pressed, confined, narrow; 1a3) to hasten, make haste; 1a4) be narrow; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to urge, insist; 1b2) to hasten

H216.definition: from H215; 1) light; 1a) light of day; 1b) light of heavenly luminaries (moon, sun, stars); 1c) day-break, dawn, morning light; 1d) daylight; 1e) lightning; 1f) light of lamp; 1g) light of life; 1h) light of prosperity; 1i) light of instruction; 1j) light of face (fig.); 1k) Jehovah as Israel's light

H217.definition: from H215; 1) flame, light of fire

H231.definition: probably of foreign derivation; 1) hyssop, a plant used for medicinal and religious purposes

H232.definition: from H246; 1) waist-cloth, the innermost piece of clothing; 1a) of God's power over kings (fig.); 1b) of faithfulness (metaph); 2) waistband

H233.definition: probably from H227; 1) then, in that case

H234.definition: from H2142; 1) memorial-offering, the portion of the meal (food) offering which is burned

H237.definition: from H235; departure; Ezel = "departure"; 1) a memorial stone between Ramah and Nob; scene of final farewell between David and Jonathan

H238.definition: a primitive root; probably to expand; but used only as a denominative from H241; 1) to hear, listen; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to hear, listen, give ear; 1a2) to be obedient, harken; 1a3) to hear or listen to prayers (of God)

H243.definition: from H238 and H8396; flats (i.e. tops) of Tabor (i.e. situated on it); Aznoth Tabor = "peaks of Tabor"; 1) a pair of hills on Naphtali's border

H245.definition: from H238 and H3050; heard by Jah; Azaniah = "Jehovah (Yahweh) hears"; 1) the father of Jeshua, a Levite

H246.definition: a variation for H2131; 1) chains, manacles

H251.definition: a primitive word; 1) brother; 1a) brother of same parents; 1b) half-brother (same father); 1c) relative, kinship, same tribe; 1d) each to the other (reciprocal relationship); 1e) (fig.) of resemblance

H259.definition: a numeral from H258; 1) one (number); 1a) one (number); 1b) each, every; 1c) a certain; 1d) an (indefinite article); 1e) only, once, once for all; 1f) one...another, the one...the other, one after another, one by one; 1g) first; 1h) eleven (in combination), eleventh (ordinal)

H260.definition: of uncertain (perhaps Egyptian) derivation; 1) reeds, marsh plants, rushes

H261.definition: from H258; united; Ehud = "united"; 1) great grandson of Benjamin

H262.definition: from H2331 (in the sense of H2324); 1) declaration

H263.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H262; 1) declaration, a declaring

H265.definition: by reduplication from H251; brotherly; Ahoah = "brother of rest"; 1) a grandson of Benjamin

H266.definition: patronymic from H264; Ahohite = "brother of rest"; 1) one of the clan of Ahoah

H267.definition: perhaps from H251 and H4325; brother (i.e. neighbour) of water; Ahumai = "a water reed: brother of waters"; 1) grandson of Shobal, descendant of Judah

H268.definition: or (shortened) אָחֹר ; from H299; 1) the back side, the rear; 1a) backwards; 1b) hereafter (of time); 1c) behind

H269.definition: irregular feminine of H251; 1) sister; 1a) sister (same parents); 1b) half-sister (same father); 1c) relative; 1c1)(metaph) of Israel's and Judah's relationship; 1d) beloved; 1d1) bride; 1e) (fig.) of intimate connection; 1f) another

H272.definition: feminine passive participle from H270; 1) possession, property; 1a) land; 1b) possession by inheritance

H273.definition: from H270; seizer; Ahasai = "my holder, protector"; 1) a post-exilic priest, in Jerusalem

H274.definition: or (prolonged) אֲחַזְיָהוּ ; from H270 and H3050; Jah has seized; Ahaziah = "Jehovah (Yahu) holds (possesses)"; 1) ruler of Israel, son of Ahab; 2) ruler of Judah, son of Jehoram (Joram)

H275.definition: from H270; seizure; Ahuzam = "possessor"; 1) a descendant of Judah through Caleb

H276.definition: a variation of H272; possession; Ahuzzath = "possession"; 1) friend of Abimelech

H277.definition: from H251; brotherly; Ahi = "my brother"; 1) a head of the families of Gad; 2) an Asherite

H278.definition: probably the same as H277; Ehi = "my brother"; 1) son of Benjamin

H279.definition: from H251 and H517; brother of the mother (i.e. uncle); Ahiam = "mother's brother"; 1) one of David's warriors (heroes)

H283.definition: prolonged from H251; brotherly; Ahio = "brotherly" or "fraternal"; 1) son of Abinadab who sheltered the ark; 2) a Benjamite; 3) another Benjamite of Saul's ancestry

H284.definition: from H251 and H2330; brother of a riddle (i.e. mysterious); Ahihud = "brother of mystery"; 1) a Benjamite, son of Ehud

H285.definition: from H251 and H2898; brother of goodness; Ahitub = "my brother is good (goodness)"; 1) a grandson of Eli; 2) the father of Zadok the priest

H286.definition: from H251 and H3205; brother of one born; Ahilud = "child's brother"; 1) father of Jehoshaphat, David's recorder; 2) father of Baana, an officer of Solomon

H289.definition: or אֲחִימָן ; from H251 and H4480; brother of a portion (i.e. gift); Ahiman = "my brother is a gift"; 1) a son of Anak; 2) a Levite servant in the temple

H290.definition: from H251 and the equivalent of H4619; brother of anger; Ahimaaz = "my brother is anger (wrath)"; 1) father-in-law of Saul; 2) Zadok's son who aided David during Absalom's rebellion; 3) a supply officer of Solomon

H291.definition: from H251; brotherly; Ahian = "brotherly" or "fraternal"; 1) son of Shemida of Manasseh

H292.definition: from H251 and H5068; brother of liberality; Ahinadab = "my brother is liberal, or, noble"; 1) a supply officer of Solomon

H293.definition: from H251 and H5278; brother of pleasantness; Ahinoam = "my brother is delight"; 1) wife of Saul, daughter of Ahimaaz; 2) wife of David, mother of Amnon, a Jezreelitess

H294.definition: from H251 and H5564; brother of support; Ahisamach = "my brother is support (has supported)"; 1) a Danite, father of Aholiab, a workman on the tabernacle

H295.definition: from H251 and H5828; brother of help; Ahiezer = "my brother is help"; 1) a Danite chief who assisted Moses; 2) a Danite chief, one of David's heroes

H296.definition: from H251 and H6965; brother of rising (i.e. high); Ahikam = "my brother has risen (arisen)"; 1) son of Shaphan, an officer in Josiah's reign; 2) protector of Jeremiah; 3) father of Gedaliah

H297.definition: from H251 and H7311; brother of height (i.e. high); Ahiram = "my brother is exalted" or "brother or (the) lofty"; 1) a Benjamite, son of Benjamin

H298.definition: patronymic from H297; Ahiramite = "brother of mother"; 1) one of the clan of Ahiram

H299.definition: from H251 and H7451; brother of wrong; Ahira = "my brother is evil"; 1) a chief of Naphtali

H300.definition: from H251 and H7837; brother of (the) dawn; Ahishahar = "my brother is dawn" or "brother of the dawn"; 1) a Benjamite

H301.definition: from H251 and H7891; brother of (the) singer; Ahishar = "my brother sang"; 1) chief steward for Solomon

H303.definition: from the same root as H2459; fatness (i.e. fertile); Ahlab = "fertile place"; 1) a town allotted to Asher, site presently unknown

H805.definition: or אַשּׁוּרִי; from a patrial word of the same form as H804; Ashurites = "guided: blessed"; adj; 1) a tribe inhabiting the plain of Esdraelon; Asshuri = "steps"; n pr m; 2) a tribe descended from Abraham and Keturah

H806.definition: probably from H7835; black; Ashur = "black"; 1) son of Pharez

H807.definition: of foreign origin; Ashima = "guiltiness: I will make desolate"; 1) a god of Hamath

H808.definition: from the same as H784 (in the sense of pressing down firmly; compare H803); 1) with sense of pressing down, foundation

H809.definition: feminine of H808; 1) raisin-cake, used in sacrificial feasts; 1a) consistently translated in AV as "flagon of wine"

H810.definition: from an unused root (probably meaning to bunch together); 1) testicle; 2) (CLBL) stone

H811.definition: or אֶשְׁכֹּל; probably prolonged from H810; 1) cluster; 1a) of grapes; 1b) of flowers (metaphor of lover)

H812.definition: the same as H811; Eshcol = "cluster"; 1) an area of Hebron, the valley of Eshcol; 2) an Amorite, the brother of Mamre, dwelling in Hebron

H813.definition: of foreign origin; Ashchenaz or Ashkenaz = "a man as sprinkled: fire as scattered"; 1) a descendant of Japheth; 2) a northern people, perhaps of Bithynia

H815.definition: from a root of uncertain signification; 1) tamarisk tree

H816.definition: or אָשֵׁם; a primitive root; 1) to offend, be guilty, trespass; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to do wrong, offend, trespass, commit an offense, do injury; 1a2) to be or become guilty; 1a3) to be held guilty; 1a4) to be incriminated; 1b) (Niphal) to suffer punishment; 1c) (Hiphil) to declare guilty; 2) (TWOT) to be desolate, acknowledge offense
H816.kjvUsage: [idiom] certainly, be(-come, made) desolate, destroy, [idiom] greatly, be(-come, found, hold) guilty, offend (acknowledge offence), trespass

H817.definition: from H816; 1) guilt, offense, guiltiness; 1a) offense, trespass, fault; 1b) guilt, guiltiness; 1c) compensation (for offense); 1d) trespass offering, guilt offering

H818.definition: from H816; 1) guilty, faulty (and obliged to offer a guilt-offering)

H819.definition: feminine of H817; 1) guiltiness, guilt, offense, sin, wrong-doing; 1a) doing wrong, committing a trespass or offense; 1b) becoming guilty, guilt; 1c) bringing a guilt-offering

H820.definition: probably from H8081; 1) the stout, among the stout; 2) (CLBL) the desolate, like dead

H821.definition: or אַשׁמוּרָה; or אַשׁמֹרֶת; (feminine) from H8104; 1) watch (a period of time), night-watch

H822.definition: apparently from an unused root (probably meaning to leave interstices); 1) window-lattice

H823.definition: probably a variation for H3466; Ashnah = "I will cause change"; 1) a town near Dan; 2) a town in Judah

H824.definition: from H8172; support; Eshean = "support"; 1) a city in Judah

H825.definition: from an unused root (probably meaning to lisp, i.e. practice enchantment); 1) necromancer, conjurer,; 2) (TWOT) astrologer, enchanter, exorcist

H826.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H825 1) conjurer, enchanter, (CLBL) necromancer

H827.definition: perhaps (feminine) from the same as H825 (in the sense of covering); 1) quiver (for arrows); 1a) of home, of God's instruments (fig.)

H828.definition: of foreign origin; Ashpenaz = "I will make prominent the sprinkled"; 1) chief eunuch of Nebuchadnezzar

H829.definition: of uncertain derivation; 1) piece of meat, measured portion, date-cake (meaning and significance obscure)

H830.definition: or אַשְׁפּוֹת; or שְׁפֹת; (contraction) plural of a noun of the same form as H827, from H8192 (in the sense of scraping); 1) ash heap, refuse heap, dung-hill

H831.definition: probably from H8254 in the sense of weighing-place (i.e. mart); Askelon or Ashkelon = "the fire of infamy: I shall be weighed"; 1) a maritime city of the Philistines, southwest of Jerusalem

H832.definition: patrial from H831; Eshkalonites = "the fire of infamy: I shall be weighed"; 1) an inhabitant of Ashkelon

H833.definition: or אָשֵׁר; a primitive root; 1) to go straight, walk, go on, advance, make progress; 1a)(Qal) to go straight on, make progress; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to go straight on, advance; 1b2) to lead on (causative); 1b3) to set right, righten; 1b4) to pronounce happy, call blessed; 1c) (Pual); 1c1) to be advanced, be led on; 1c2) to be made happy, be blessed
H833.kjvUsage: (call, be) bless(-ed, happy), go, guide, lead, relieve

H834.definition: a primitive relative pronoun (of every gender and number); 1) (relative part.); 1a) which, who; 1b) that which; 2) (conj); 2a) that (in obj clause); 2b) when; 2c) since; 2d) as; 2e) conditional if
H834.kjvUsage: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection

H835.definition: from H833; 1) happiness, blessedness; 1a) often used as interjection; 1b) blessed are

H836.definition: from H833, Asher = "happy"; 1) son of Jacob and Zilpah; 2) the tribe descended from Asher; 3) a city east of Shechem in Manasseh

H838.definition: or אַשֻּׁר; from H833 in the sense of going; 1) step, going

H839.definition: contracted for H8391; 1) one from the tribe of Asher

H840.definition: by orthographical variation from H833 and H410; right of God; Asareel = "God holds"; 1) a descendant of Judah through Caleb

H841.definition: from the same as H840; right toward God; Asarelah = "God holds"; 1) a son of Asaph, appointed sanctuary musician by David

H842.definition: or אֲשֵׁירָה; from H833; happy; Ashera(h) = "groves (for idol worship)"; 1) a Babylonian (Astarte)-Canaanite goddess (of fortune and happiness), the supposed consort of Baal, her images; 1a) the goddess, goddesses; 1b) her images; 1c) sacred trees or poles set up near an altar

H843.definition: patronymic from H836; Asherites = "happy"; 1) those descended from Asher

H844.definition: an orthographical variation for H840; Ashriel or Asriel = "I shall be prince of God"; 1) a great-grandson of Manasseh, and son of Gilead; 2) a son of Manasseh

H845.definition: patronymic from H844; Asrielites = "I shall be prince of God"; 1) the clan descended from Ashriel

H846.definition: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H833; 1) wall, panelling, beams, structure (precise meaning and derivation uncertain)

H847.definition: or אֶשְׁתָּאוֹל; probably from H7592; intreaty; Eshtaol = "entreaty"; 1) a Danite city located within Judah

H848.definition: patrial from H847; Eshtaulites = "I will be entreated"; 1) the inhabitants of Eshtaol

H849.definition: (Aramaic) from H7712 (in a bad sense); 1) revolt, sedition

H850.definition: probably from the same as H7764; restful; Eshton = "effeminate"; 1) a descendant of Caleb of tribe of Judah

H851.definition: or אֶשְׁתְּמוֹעַ; or אֶשְׁתְּמֹה; from H8085 (in the sense of obedience); Eshtemoa = "I will make myself heard" Eshtemoh = "I shall cause my own ruin: fire of astonishment: I shall soar aloft"; 1) a Levitical city in Judah; 2) a man of Judah

H852.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H226; 1) sign, miraculous signs, wonders

H853.definition: apparent contracted from H226 in the demonstrative sense of entity; 1) sign of the definite direct object, not translated in English but generally preceding and indicating the accusative

H854.definition: probably from H579; 1) with, near, together with; 1a) with, together with; 1b) with (of relationship); 1c) near (of place); 1d) with (poss.); 1e) from...with, from (with other prep)
H854.kjvUsage: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix

H856.definition: from H854 and H1168; with Baal; Ethbaal = "with Baal"; 1) king of Sidon, father of Jezebel

H857.definition: or אָתָא; a primitive root (collateral to H225 contraction); 1) to come, arrive; 1a) (Qal) to come (of men, time, beasts, calamity); 1b) (Hiphil) to bring

H858.definition: (Aramaic) or אָתָא; (Aramaic), corresponding to H857 1) to come, arrive; 1a) (P'al) to come; 1b) (Aphel) to bring; 1c) (Hophal) to be brought; 2) used in the NT in the phrase "maranatha" -"Lord come"

H859.definition: or (shortened); אַתָּ; or אַת; feminine (irregular) sometimes אַתִּי; plural masculine אַתֶּם; feminine אַתֶּן; or אַתֵּנָהlemma אתֵּנָה missing vowel, corrected to אַתֵּנָה; or אַתֵּנָּה; a primitive pronoun of the second person; 1) you (second pers. sing. masc.)

H860.definition: probably from the same as H386 (in the sense of patience); 1) she-ass, she-donkey

H861.definition: (Aramaic) probably from the corresponding to H784; 1) furnace

H862.definition: or אַתִּיק; from H5423 in the sense of decreasing; 1) gallery, porch

H863.definition: or אִיתַי; from H854; near; Ittai or Ithai = "with me"; 1) a Gittite commander from Gath in David's army; 2) one of David's 30 mighty warriors, a Benjamite

H864.definition: of Egyptian derivation; Etham = "with them: their plowshare"; 1) a stopping place for Israel during the Exodus

H865.definition: or אִתְמוֹל; or אֶתְמוּל; probably from H853 or H854 and H4136; 1) yesterday, recently, formerly; 1a) yesterday; 1b) formerly (fig.); 1c) from yesterday, already (in phrase); 2) (TWOT +) before, before that time, before the time, heretofore, of late, of old, these days, time(s) past
H865.kjvUsage: [phrase] before (that) time, [phrase] heretofore, of late (old), [phrase] times past, yester(day)

H866.definition: from H8566; 1) hire, price (of a harlot); 2) (TWOT) reward

H867.definition: perhaps from H866; munificence; Ethni = "my hire"; 1) an ancestor of Asaph

H868.definition: the same as H866; 1) hire of prostitute, price; 1a) hire (of harlot); 1b) of idolatrous Israel, Jerusalem, Tyre (fig.)

H869.definition: the same as H868 in the sense of H867; Ethnan = "hire of unchastity"; 1) a grandson of Ashur

H870.definition: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of H871; 1) track, place

H871.definition: plural from an unused root (probably meaning to step); places; 1) meaning uncertain-perhaps mountain pass or caravan route

H872.definition: from H935; 1) entrance, a coming in, entering, entry (of the temple); 1a) entrance; 1b) entering (act of entrance)

H873.definition: (Aramaic) from H888; 1) evil, bad, be evil

H874.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Piel); 1a) to make plain, distinct; 1b) to make clear; 1c) to declare; 1d) letters on a tablet

H876.definition: the same as H875; Beer = "well"; 1) an oasis rest in desert during the Exodus; 2) a city west of Hebron

H878.definition: from H875; a well; Beera = "a well"; 1) a man of Asher

H879.definition: from H875 and the plural of H410; well of heroes; Beer-elim = "well of God"; 1) a well in the south of Moab

H880.definition: the same as H878; Beerah = "well"; 1) a Reubenite chief exiled to Assyria

H881.definition: feminine plural of H875; wells; Beeroth = "wells"; 1) a Gibeonite city allotted to Benjamin

H882.definition: from H875; fountained; Beeri = "my well"; 1) Esau's Hittite father-in-law; 2) father of Hosea

H883.definition: from H875 and H2416 (with prefix) and H7203; well of a living (One) my Seer; Beer-lahai-roi = "well of the Living One seeing me"; 1) a well west of Kadesh, south of Israel

H884.definition: from H875 and H7651 (in the sense of H7650); well of an oath; Beer-sheba = "well of the sevenfold oath"; 1) a city at the south edge of Israel

H885.definition: from the feminine plural of H875, and the plural contraction of H1121, and H3292; wells of (the) sons of Jaakan; Beeroth Bene-Jaakan or Beeroth = "wells" or "wells of the sons of Jaakan"; 1) an encampment for Israel in the wilderness probably in the country of the Horites
H885.kjvUsage: Beeroth of the children of Jaakan

H886.definition: patrial from H881; Beerothite = "wells"; 1) an inhabitant of Beeroth (in Benjamin)

H887.definition: a primitive root; 1) to have a bad smell, stink, smell bad; 1a) (Qal) to stink, smell bad; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to become odious; 1b2) to make oneself odious; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to stink, emit a stinking odour; 1c2) to cause to stink; 1c3) of wickedness (fig.); 1d) (Hithpael) to make oneself odious; 2) (TWOT) to abhor
H887.kjvUsage: (make to) be abhorred (had in abomination, loathsome, odious), (cause a, make to) stink(-ing savour), [idiom] utterly

H888.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H887 1) (P'al) to be evil, be bad, be displeasing

H890.definition: feminine of H889; 1) stinking things, stinking or noxious weeds, stinkweed

H891.definition: plural of H889; 1) stinking or worthless things, wild grapes, stinkberries

H892.definition: feminine active participle of an unused root meaning to hollow out; 1) the apple (pupil) of the eye

H893.definition: probably of foreign origin; Bebai = "my cavities"; 1) a leader of the returning exiles

H894.definition: from H1101; confusion; Babel or Babylon = "confusion (by mixing)"; 1) Babel or Babylon, the ancient site and/or capital of Babylonia (modern Hillah) situated on the Euphrates

H895.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H894 Babel or Babylon = "confusion (by mixing)"; 1) Babel or Babylon, the ancient site and/or capital of Babylonia (modern Hillah) situated on the Euphrates

H896.definition: (Aramaic) patrial from H895; Babylonian = "confusion (by mixing)"; 1) Babylonian

H898.definition: a primitive root; 1) to act treacherously, deceitfully, deal treacherously; 1a) (Qal) to act or deal treacherously, faithlessly, deceitfully, offend
H898.kjvUsage: deal deceitfully (treacherously, unfaithfully), offend, transgress(-or), (depart), treacherous (dealer, -ly, man), unfaithful(-ly, man), [idiom] very

H899.definition: from H898; 1) treachery, deceit; 2) (CLBL) garment, clothing (used indiscriminately)
H899.kjvUsage: apparel, cloth(-es, ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, [idiom] very (treacherously), vesture, wardrobe

H900.definition: feminine plural active participle of H898; 1) treacherous, treacherousness, men of treacherous behaviour

H902.definition: probably of foreign origin; Bigvai = "in my bodies"; 1) an exile who returned under Zerubbabel, perhaps the head of a family

H903.definition: of Persian derivation; Bigtha = "in the wine-press"; 1) a eunuch in king Ahasuerus' (Xerxes) court

H904.definition: or בִּגְתָנָא; of similar derivation to H903; Bigthan = "in their wine-press"; 1) a eunuch in king Ahasuerus' (Xerxes) court

H905.definition: from H909; 1) alone, by itself, besides, a part, separation, being alone; 1a) separation, alone, by itself; 1a1) only (adv); 1a2) apart from, besides (prep); 1b) part; 1c) parts (eg limbs, shoots), bars
H905.kjvUsage: alone, apart, bar, besides, branch, by self, of each alike, except, only, part, staff, strength

H906.definition: perhaps from H909 (in the sense of divided fibres); 1) linen, white linen

H907.definition: from H908; 1) empty talk, idle talk, liar, lie

H908.definition: a primitive root; 1) to devise, contrive, invent (bad sense); 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to devise; 1a2) to contrive

H909.definition: a primitive root; 1) to withdraw, be separate, be isolated; 1a) (Qal) an army straggler (part.); 1a1) of Ephraim (metaph.); 2) (TWOT) alone

H910.definition: from H909; n m; 1) isolation, withdrawal, separation; 1a) an isolated city; adv; 2) alone; 2a) security (fig.)

H911.definition: from H909; separation; Bedad = "solitary"; 1) the father of an Edomite chief

H912.definition: probably a shortened form H5662; servant of Jehovah; Bedeiah = "servant of Jehovah"; 1) an Israelite exile who took a foreign woman

H913.definition: from H914; 1) alloy, tin, dross; 1a) of Israel (metaph.)

H914.definition: a primitive root; 1) to divide, separate; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to divide, separate, sever; 1a2) to separate, set apart; 1a3) to make a distinction, difference; 1a4) to divide into parts; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to separate oneself from (reflexive of 1a2); 1b2) to withdraw from; 1b3) to separate oneself unto; 1b4) to be separated; 1b5) to be excluded; 1b6) to be set apart
H914.kjvUsage: (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), [idiom] utterly

H915.definition: from H914; 1) a piece, severed piece, a piece (of an ear)

H916.definition: probably from H914; 1) bdellium (ie gum resin)

H917.definition: probably shortened for H5658; servile; Bedan = "in judging"; 1) a judge who followed Gideon; 2) a Manassite

H918.definition: a primitive root; to gap open; used only as a denominative from H919; 1) (Qal) to mend, repair (a building)

H919.definition: from H918; 1) fissure, rent, breach, leak (in a building)

H920.definition: probably from H1856 with a prepositional prefix; by stabbing, i.e. assassin; Bidkar = "with a stab"; 1) a captain of Jehu

H921.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding (by transposition) to H6504; 1) (Pael) to scatter

H922.definition: from an unused root (meaning to be empty); 1) emptiness, void, waste

H923.definition: from an unused root (probably meaning to glisten); 1) a costly stone (perhaps porphyry), red marble

H925.definition: from an unused root (meaning to be bright); 1) bright, brilliant (of light)

H926.definition: a primitive root; 1) to disturb, alarm, terrify, hurry, be disturbed, be anxious, be afraid, be hurried, be nervous; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to be disturbed, dismayed, terrified, anxious; 1a2) to be in haste, be hasty; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to make haste, act hastily, be hurried, be hastened; 1b2) to dismay, terrify; 1c) (Pual); 1c1) to hasten; 1c2) hastened, hastily gained (part.); 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to hasten, hurry, make haste; 1d2) to dismay, terrify
H926.kjvUsage: be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste(-n, -y, -ily), (give) speedy(-ily), thrust out, trouble, vex

H927.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H926; 1) (Pual) to frighten, alarm, dismay; 2) (Ithpa'al) to hurry, hasten; 3) (Ithpa'al) alarmed (part.)

H928.definition: from H926; 1) dismay, sudden terror or ruin, alarm

H929.definition: from an unused root (probably meaning to be mute); 1) beast, cattle, animal; 1a) beasts (coll of all animals); 1b) cattle, livestock (of domestic animals); 1c) wild beasts

H930.definition: in form a plural or H929, but really a singular of Egyptian derivation; 1) perhaps an extinct dinosaur; 1a) a Diplodocus or Brachiosaurus, exact meaning unknown; ++++; Some translate as elephant or hippopotamus but from the description in Job 40:15-24, this is patently absurd.

H931.definition: from an unused root apparently meaning to be thick; 1) thumb, great (big) toe (always used of both together)

H932.definition: an orthographical variation of H931; Bohan = "thumb"; 1) a Reubenite who set a boundary stone between Judah and Benjamin; 2) (BDB) a mark of division between Judah and Benjamin

H933.definition: from an unused root meaning to be pale; 1) a harmless eruption of the skin, skin spot

H934.definition: feminine active participle of the same as H925; 1) white patch of skin, brightness, bright spot (on skin); 2) (CLBL) bright spot, scar, blister, boil; 2a) resulting from fire; 2b) resulting from inflammation of the skin; 2c) possible sign of leprosy

H935.definition: a primitive root; 1) to go in, enter, come, go, come in; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to enter, come in; 1a2) to come; 1a2a) to come with; 1a2b) to come upon, fall or light upon, attack (enemy); 1a2c) to come to pass; 1a3) to attain to; 1a4) to be enumerated; 1a5) to go; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to lead in; 1b2) to carry in; 1b3) to bring in, cause to come in, gather, cause to come, bring near, bring against, bring upon; 1b4) to bring to pass; 1c) (Hophal); 1c1) to be brought, brought in; 1c2) to be introduced, be put
H935.kjvUsage: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way

H936.definition: a primitive root; 1) to despise, hold in contempt, hold as insignificant; 1a) (Qal) to despise, show despite toward

H937.definition: from H936; 1) contempt; 1a) springing from evil; 1b) springing from prosperity; 1c) springing from judgment

H938.definition: the same as H937; Buz = "contempt"; 1) second son of Nahor, Abraham's nephew; 2) a Gadite

H939.definition: feminine passive participle of H936; 1) contempt

H940.definition: patronymic from H938; Buzite = "contempt"; 1) one of the ancestors of Elihu

H941.definition: the same as H940; Buzi = "my contempt"; 1) father of Ezekiel (or ancestor)

H942.definition: probably of Persian origin; Bavai = "my goings"; 1) a rebuilder of Jerusalem's walls in Nehemiah's time

H943.definition: a primitive root; 1) to perplex, confuse, be confused; 1a) (Niphal) to be confused, be in confusion

H945.definition: the same as H944 (in the sense of rain); Bul = "increase: produce"; 1) the eighth Hebrew month, corresponding to modern Oct-Nov (Nov-Dec)

H946.definition: from H995; discretion; Bunah = "intelligence"; 1) a son of Jerahmeel, a Judahite

H947.definition: a primitive root; 1) to tread down, reject, trample down; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to tread down, trample (of warriors); 1a2) of rejection (fig.); 1b) (Polel); 1b1) to tread down (in bad sense); 1b2) to desecrate; 1c) (Hithpolel); 1c1) to tread; 1c2) to kick out; 1c2a) of infants' blind movements; 1c2b) of Jerusalem (fig.); 1d) (Hophal) to be trodden down

H948.definition: from an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, i.e. (intransitive) be white; 1) byssus, a costly, fine white linen cloth made in Egypt

H949.definition: from the same as H948; shining; Bozez = "surpassing white: glistening"; 1) a rock formation near Michmash by which Jonathan approached the Philistine troop

H950.definition: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to be hollow); 1) emptiness

H951.definition: properly, active participle from H1239 as denominative from H1241; 1) herdsman

H952.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal); 1a) to make clear, clear up, explain, prove; 1b) (CLBL) to bore into; 1c) (TWOT) to declare (?)

H953.definition: from H952 (in the sense of H877); 1) pit, well, cistern

H954.definition: a primitive root; 1) to put to shame, be ashamed, be disconcerted, be disappointed; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to feel shame; 1a2) to be ashamed, disconcerted, disappointed (by reason of); 1b) (Piel) to delay (in shame); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to put to shame; 1c2) to act shamefully; 1c3) to be ashamed; 1d) (Hithpolel) to be ashamed before one another
H954.kjvUsage: (be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-) shamed(-d), be (put to) confounded(-fusion), become dry, delay, be long

H955.definition: feminine participle passive of H954; 1) shame

H956.definition: (Aramaic) apparent denominative from H1005; 1) (P'al) to pass the night, lodge

H957.definition: from H962; 1) spoil, booty, robbery, spoiling

H958.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to divide, cleave, cut through

H959.definition: a primitive root; 1) to despise, hold in contempt, disdain; 1a) (Qal) to despise, regard with contempt; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be despised; 1b2) to be despicable; 1b3) to be vile, worthless; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to despise
