H1115.definition: constructive feminine of H1086 (equivalent to H1097); subst; 1) not, except; adv; 2) not; 3) except (after preceding negation); conj; 4) except (after an implied or expressed negation); with prep; 5) so as not, in order not; 6) an account of not, because...not; 7) until not
H1115.kjvUsage: because un(satiable), beside, but, [phrase] continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without

H1116.definition: from an unused root (meaning to be high); 1) high place, ridge, height, bamah (technical name for cultic platform); 1a) high place, mountain; 1b) high places, battlefields; 1c) high places (as places of worship); 1d) funeral mound?

H1117.definition: the same as H1116; Bamah = "high place"; 1) a place in Palestine (of places of idolatrous worship)

H1118.definition: probably from H4107 with prepositional prefix; with pruning; Bimhal = "in circumcision: in weakness (by mixture)"; 1) a descendant of Asher

H1119.definition: prolongation for prepositional prefix; 1) in, at, by

H1120.definition: plural of H1116; heights; or (fully) בָּמוֹת בַּעַל; from the same and H1168; heights of Baal; Bamoth = "high places" or "great high place"; 1) a town on the river Arnon in Moab

H1121.definition: from H1129; 1) son, grandson, child, member of a group; 1a) son, male child; 1b) grandson; 1c) children (pl. - male and female); 1d) youth, young men (pl.); 1e) young (of animals); 1f) sons (as characterisation, i.e. sons of injustice [for un- righteous men] or sons of God [for angels]; 1g) people (of a nation) (pl.); 1h) of lifeless things, i.e. sparks, stars, arrows (fig.); 1i) a member of a guild, order, class
H1121.kjvUsage: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth

H1122.definition: the same as H1121; Ben = "son"; 1) a Levite, one of the porters appointed by David for the ark

H1124.definition: (Aramaic) or בְּנָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1129; 1) to build; 1a) (P'al) to build; 1b) (Ithp'il) to be built

H1125.definition: from H1121 and H40; (the) son of Abinadab; Ben-Abinadab = "son of Abinadab"; 1) an officer of Solomon

H1126.definition: from H1121 and H205; son of my sorrow; Ben-oni = "son of my sorrow"; 1) the name given to Benjamin by Rachel

H1127.definition: from H1121 and H1397; son of (the) hero; Ben-geber = "the son of Geber" or "the son of a man"; 1) an officer of Solomon

H1128.definition: from H1121 and a derivative of H1856; son of piercing (or of a lance); Ben-dekar = "son of stabbing" or "son of Dekar"; 1) an officer of Solomon

H1129.definition: a primitive root; 1) to build, rebuild, establish, cause to continue; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to build, rebuild; 1a2) to build a house (ie, establish a family); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be built; 1b2) to be rebuilt; 1b3) established (of restored exiles) (fig.); 1b4) established (made permanent); 1b5) to be built up (of childless wife becoming the mother of a family through the children of a concubine)
H1129.kjvUsage: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely

H1130.definition: from H1121 and H1908; son of Hadad; Ben-hadad = "son of [the false god] Hadad"; 1) the king of Syria, contemporary with Asa of Judah; 2) the son of Hazael, also king of Syria

H1131.definition: from H1129; built up; Binnui = "built up"; 1) an exile returnee with Zerubbabel, son of Henadad, who assisted at the reparation of the wall of Jerusalem, under Nehemiah; 2) a Levite in time of Ezra, father of Noadiah; 3) another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife; 4) still another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife

H1132.definition: from H1121 and H2105; son of Zocheth; Ben-zoheth = "son of Zoheth"; 1) one of the tribe of Judah

H1133.definition: from H1121 and H2354; son of Chur; Ben-hur = "son of whiteness" or "son of Chur"; 1) a man who was commissariat officer for Solomon in Mount Ephraim

H1134.definition: from H1121 and H2428; son of might; Ben-hail = "son of strength" or "son (man) of might"; 1) a ruler (prince) under Jehoshaphat

H1135.definition: from H1121 and H2605; son of Chanan; Ben-hanan = "son of favour"; 1) one of the tribe of Judah

H1136.definition: from H1121 and H2617; son of kindness; Ben-hesed = "son of mercy"; 1) an officer of Solomon

H1137.definition: from H1129; built; Bani = "built"; 1) a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors; 2) a Levite of the line of Merari, and forefather to Ethan; 3) a man of Judah of the line of Pharez; 4) "children of Bani" returned from captivity with Zerubbabel; 5) one or up to three Levites in Nehemiah's time

H1138.definition: or (fuller) בּוּנִי; from H1129; built; Bunni = "built"; 1) a Levite in the time of Nehemiah; 2) another Levite of earlier date

H1139.definition: from the plural construction of H1121 and H1300; Bene-barak = "sons of lightning"; 1) a city in Dan

H1141.definition: or בּנָיָהוּ; (prolonged) from H1129 and H3050; Jah has built; Benaiah = "Jehovah has built" or "Yahweh has built up"; 1) one of David's mighty warriors, son of Jehoiada the chief priest, a Levite, set by David over his bodyguard, later having remained faithful to Solomon during Adonijah's attempt on the crown, was raised into the place of Joab as commander-in-chief of the army; 2) the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite, one of David's thirty mighty warriors, and the captain of the eleventh monthly course; 3) a Simeonite, a prince of the families of Simeon; 4) a Levite in the time of David who played with a psaltery on Alamoth; 5) a priest in the time of David, appointed to blow the trumpet before the ark; 6) a Levite of the sons of Asaph; 7) a Levite in the time of Hezekiah; 8) Four Israelites in the time of Ezra who had taken strange wives; 9) the father of Pelatiah

H1142.definition: from the plural of H1121 and H3292; sons of Yaakan; Bene-jaakan = "sons of twisting"; 1) an Israelite place of encampment in the wilderness (same as H0885)

H1143.definition: dual of H996; 1) between, space between two armies; 1a) man of the space between armies, i.e. champion (of Goliath) (meton)

H1144.definition: from H1121 and H3225; son of (the) right hand; Benjamin = "son of the right hand"; 1) Jacob's and Rachel's youngest son, Joseph's full brother; 2) son of Bilhan, great-grandson of Benjamin; 3) a Benjamite, one of the sons of Harim, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife; 4) the tribe descended from Benjamin, the son of Jacob

H1145.definition: sometimes (with the article inserted) בֵּן־הַיּמִינִי; with H376 inserted (1 Samuel 9:1) בֶּן־אִישׁ ימִינִי; son of a man of Jemini; or shortened אִישׁ יְמִינִי; (1 Samuel 9:4; Esther 2:5) a man of Jemini, or (1 Samuel 20:1) simply יְמִינִיxlit Yᵉmînîy corrected to Yᵉmîynîy; a Jeminite; (plural) בְּנֵי יְמִינִיxlit Bᵉnîy corrected to Bᵉnêy; patron from H1144; Benjamite = "a son of the right hand"; 1) one of the tribe of Benjamin

H1147.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H1146 1) a building, structure

H1148.definition: probably from H1121 with pron. suff.; our son; Beninu = "our son"; 1) a returning Levite exile who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah

H1149.definition: (Aramaic) of uncertain affinity; 1) (P'al) to be angry

H1150.definition: or בִּנְעָה; of uncertain derivation; Binea or Bineah = fountain; 1) a descendant of Jonathan

H1151.definition: from H1121 and H5971 with pronomial suffix; son of my people; Ben-ami = "son of my people"; 1) son of Lot, born to his second daughter, progenitor of the Ammonites

H1152.definition: from H5475 and H3050 with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah; Besodeiah = "with the counsel of Jehovah" or "in the secret of the Lord"; 1) father of one of the repairers of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah

H1153.definition: from H947; domineering; Besai = "my treading"; 1) a temple slave (or group of slaves) who returned with Zerubbabel

H1154.definition: from an unused root meaning to be sour; 1) unripe or sour grapes

H1155.definition: from the same as H1154 1) unripe grapes, sour grapes

H1156.definition: (Aramaic) or בְּעָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1158; 1) to ask, seek, request, desire, pray, make petition; 1a) (P'al); 1a1) to ask, request; 1a2) to seek (for favour)
H1156.kjvUsage: ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek

H1157.definition: from H5704 with prepositional prefix; 1) behind, through, round about, on behalf of, away from, about; 1a) through (of action); 1b) behind (with verbs of shutting); 1c) about (with verbs of fencing); 1d) on behalf of (metaph. especially with Hithpael)
H1157.kjvUsage: about, at by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within

H1158.definition: a primitive root; 1) to seek out, swell, cause to swell, boil up, enquire; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to seek, enquire; 1a2) to cause to boil up; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be searched out; 1b2) to be swelling, bulging, swelling out
H1158.kjvUsage: cause, inquire, seek up, swell out

H1159.definition: (Aramaic) from H1156; 1) petition, request; 2) prayer (always in Jewish liturgy)

H1160.definition: from H1197 (in the sense of burning); a lamp; Beor = "burning"; 1) father of Balaam; 2) father of Bela, king of Edom

H1161.definition: masculine plural from H1204; 1) terrors, alarms (occasioned by God)

H1162.definition: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Boaz = "fleetness"; 1) ancestor of David, kinsman-redeemer to Ruth, daughter-in-law of Naomi; 2) name of the left of two brazen pillars, 18 cubits high, erected in the porch of Solomon's temple

H1163.definition: a primitive root; 1) to kick, kick at; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to kick; 1a2) to kick at; 1a3) to desire (fig.)

H1164.definition: from H1158; 1) ruin, heap of ruins

H1165.definition: from H1197 (in the sense of eating); 1) beasts, cattle

H1166.definition: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1167 1) to marry, rule over, possess, own; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to marry, be lord (husband) over; 1a2) to rule over; 1b) (Niphal) to be married
H1166.kjvUsage: have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, [idiom] wife)

H1167.definition: from H1166; 1) owner, husband, lord; 1a) owner; 1b) a husband; 1c) citizens, inhabitants; 1d) rulers, lords; 1e) (noun of relationship used to characterise-ie, master of dreams); 1f) lord (used of foreign gods)
H1167.kjvUsage: [phrase] archer, [phrase] babbler, [phrase] bird, captain, chief man, [phrase] confederate, [phrase] have to do, [phrase] dreamer, those to whom it is due, [phrase] furious, those that are given to it, great, [phrase] hairy, he that hath it, have, [phrase] horseman, husband, lord, man, [phrase] married, master, person, [phrase] sworn, they of

H1168.definition: the same as H1167; Baal = "lord"; n pr m; 1) supreme male divinity of the Phoenicians or Canaanites; 2) a Reubenite; 3) the son of Jehiel and grandfather of Saul; n pr loc; 4) a town of Simeon, probably identical to Baalath-beer

H1170.definition: from H1168 and H1285; Baal of (the) covenant; Baal-berith = "lord of the covenant"; 1) a god of the Philistines

H1171.definition: from H1168 and H1409; Baal of Fortune; Baal-gad = "lord of fortune"; 1) a city noted for Baal-worship, located at the most northern or northwestern point to which Joshua's victories extended

H1172.definition: feminine of H1167; 1) mistress, female owner; 2) sorceress, necromancer (noun of relationship)

H1173.definition: the same as H1172; Baalah = "mistress"; 1) another name for Kirjath-jearim or Kirjath-baal; modern Kuriet el Enab; 2) a town in the south of Judah, also called Balah and Bilhah

H1174.definition: from H1167 and H1995; possessor of a multitude; Baal-hamon = "lord (possessor) of abundance"; 1) the site of Solomon's vineyard

H1175.definition: plural of H1172; mistresses; Baalath or Bealoth = "mistresses"; 1) a town in south Judah
H1175.kjvUsage: Bealoth, in Aloth (by mistake for a plural from H5927 with prepositional prefix)

H1176.definition: from H1168 and H2070; Baal of (the) Fly; Baal-zebub = "lord of the fly"; 1) a Philistine deity worshipped at Ekron

H1177.definition: from H1167 and H2603; possessor of grace; Baal-hanan = "Baal is gracious"; 1) an early king of Edom; 2) one of David's officers, a Gederite, who had the superintendence of his olive and sycamore plantations

H1178.definition: from H1167 and a modification of H2691; possessor of a village; Baal-hazor = "lord of the village"; 1) a town on the border between Ephraim and Benjamin, apparent location of a sheep farm of Absalom and location of Amnon's murder

H1179.definition: from H1167 and H2768; possessor of Hermon; Baal-hermon or Baal-chermon = "lord of destruction"; 1) a city near or on Mount Hermon, named as a seat of Baal worship

H1180.definition: from H1167 with pron. suff.; my master; Baali = "my lord"; 1) a deity in the northern kingdom, variation of the name 'Baal'

H1181.definition: from the plural of H1168 and the plural of H1116; Baals of (the) heights; Baale-bamoth = "the lords of the high places"; 1) the people of Arnon, east of Jordan

H1182.definition: from H1168 and H3045; Baal has known; Beeliada = "the lord knows"; 1) a son of David, born in Jerusalem, elsewhere named 'Eliada'

H1183.definition: from H1167 and H3050; Jah (is) master; Bealiah = "Jehovah is master"; 1) a Benjamite who went over to David at Ziklag and was one of David's mighty warriors

H1184.definition: from the plural of H1167 and H3063; masters of Judah; Baale-Judah = "the lords of Judah"; 1) a place in Judah named for the Baalim, also known as Kirjath-jearim, Kirjath-baal; modern Kuriet el Enab

H1185.definition: probably from a derivative of H5965 with prepositional prefix; in exultation; Baalis = "lord of the banner: in causing the joy"; 1) king of the Ammonites at the time of the destruction of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar

H1186.definition: from H1168 and H4583; Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare H1010); Baal-meon = "lord of the habitation"; 1) a town in Reuben, mentioned in connection with Nebo, and in the time of Ezekiel, Moabite

H1187.definition: from H1168 and H6465; Baal of Peor; Baal-peor = "lord of the gap"; 1) the deity worshipped at Peor with probable licentious rites

H1188.definition: from H1167 and the plural of H6556; possessor of breaches; Baal-perazim = "lord of the breaks"; 1) the site of a victory of David over the Philistines, and of a great destruction of their images; also called 'Mount Perazim'

H1189.definition: from H1168 and H6828 (in the sense of cold) (according to others an Egyptian form of Typhon, the destroyer); Baal of winter; Baal Tsphon or Baal-zephon = "lord of the north"; 1) a place in Egypt near the Red Sea where Pharaoh and his army were destroyed during the Exodus

H1190.definition: from H1168 and H8031; Baal-shalisha = "thrice-great lord"; 1) a place in Ephraim near Gilgal

H1191.definition: a modification of H1172; mistressship; Baalath = "mistress"; 1) a town in Dan

H1192.definition: from H1172 and H875; mistress of a well; Baalath-beer = "mistress of the well"; 1) a town in the south part of Judah, given to Simeon, which also bore the name of 'Ramath-negeb'

H1193.definition: from H1167 and H8558; possessor of (the) palm-tree; Baal-tamar = "lord of the palms"; 1) a place near Gibeah in Benjamin

H1194.definition: probably a contraction of H1010; Beon = "in the dwelling: indwelling"; 1) a place or city in Reuben

H1195.definition: the same as H1196; Baana or Baanah = "in the affliction"; 1) the son of Ahilud, Solomon's commissariat officer in Jezreel and the north of the Jordan valley; 2) another of Solomon's officers; 3) father of Zadok who assisted in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah

H1196.definition: from a derivative of H6031 with prepositional prefix; in affliction Baana or Baanah = "in affliction"; 1) a Benjamite, son Rimmon, who with his brother Rechab murdered Ish-bosheth. For this, killed by David, mutilated bodies hung up over the pool at Hebron; 2) a Netophathite, father of Heleb or Heled, one of David's mighty warriors; 3) the head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel; 4) a chief of the people

H1197.definition: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1198 1) to burn, consume, kindle, be kindled; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to begin to burn, be kindled, start burning; 1a2) to burn, be burning; 1a3) to burn, consume; 1a4) Jehovah's wrath, human wrath (fig.); 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to kindle, burn; 1b2) to consume, remove (of guilt) (fig.); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to kindle; 1c2) to burn up; 1c3) to consume (destroy); 1d) (Pual) to burn; v denom; 2) to be stupid, brutish, barbarous; 2a) (Qal) to be stupid, dull-hearted, unreceptive; 2b) (Niphal) to be stupid, dull-hearted; 2c) (Piel) to feed, graze; 2d) (Hiphil) to cause to be grazed over
H1197.kjvUsage: be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set (on fire), waste

H1199.definition: from H1198; brutish; Baara = "brutish"; 1) one of the wives of Shaharaim, a Benjamite

H1201.definition: from an unused root meaning to stink; offensiveness; Baasha = "wicked"; 1) third king of the northern kingdom of Israel and the founder of its second dynasty having killed the second king, Nadab

H1202.definition: from H6213 and H3050 with a prepositional prefix; in (the) work of Jah; Baaseiah = "in the service of Jehovah"; 1) a Gershonite Levite, one of the forefathers of Asaph the singer

H1203.definition: from H6251 (as singular of H6252) with a prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth; Beeshterah = "with increase"; 1) a Levitical city in Manasseh, east of the Jordan; probably identical with 'Ashtaroth'

H1204.definition: a primitive root; 1) to terrify, startle, fall upon, dismay, be overtaken by sudden terror; 1a) (Niphal) to be terrified; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to fall upon, overwhelm; 1b2) to terrify

H1206.definition: probably the same as H948; 1) mire

H1209.definition: perhaps the same as H1153; Bezai = "conqueror"; 1) a chief of the returning exiles in the time of Ezra

H1211.definition: from an unused root apparently meaning to peel; 1) onion

H1212.definition: probably from H6738 and H410 with a prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (i.e. protection) of God; Bezaleel = "in the shadow (i.e. protection) of God"; 1) son of Uri and grandson of Hur; a skilled Judahite artisan in all works of metal, wood, and stone and one of the architects of the tabernacle; 2) an Israelite, one of the sons of Pahath-moab, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife

H1213.definition: or בַּצְלִית; from the same as H1211xlit bᵉtsel corrected to betsel; a peeling; Bazlith or Bazluth = "asking"; 1) a head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel

H1214.definition: a primitive root to break off, i.e. (usually) plunder; 1) to cut off, break off, gain by unrighteous violence, get, finish, be covetous, be greedy; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cut off; 1a2) to stop; 1a3) to gain wrongfully or by violence; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to cut off, sever; 1b2) to finish, complete, accomplish; 1b3) to violently make gain of
H1214.kjvUsage: (be) covet(-ous), cut (off), finish, fulfill, gain (greedily), get, be given to (covetousness), greedy, perform, be wounded

H1215.definition: from H1214; 1) profit, unjust gain, gain (profit) acquired by violence

H1216.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to swell, become blistered

H1218.definition: from H1216; a swell of ground; Bozkath or Boscath = "rocky height"; 1) a city in Judah in the lowlands toward the Philistines, home of Josiah's mother

H1219.definition: a primitive root; to clip off; specifically (as denominative from H1210) 1) to gather, restrain, fence, fortify, make inaccessible, enclose; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cut off; 1a2) fortified, cut off, made inaccessible (pass participle); 1a3) secrets, mysteries, inaccessible things (subst); 1b) (Niphal) to be withheld; 1c) (Piel) to fortify
H1219.kjvUsage: cut off, (de-) fenced, fortify, (grape) gather(-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold

H1220.definition: from H1219; 1) gold, precious ore, ring-gold

H1221.definition: the same as H1220, an inaccessible spot; Bezer = "gold ore" or "remote fortress"; n pr m; 1) son of Zophah, one of the heads of the houses of Asher; n pr loc; 2) a city of refuge in Reuben in the downs on the east of the Jordan

H1222.definition: another form for H1220; 1) precious ore, gold, ring-gold

H1223.definition: feminine from H1219; 1) enclosure, fold, sheepfold (AV-Bozrah)

H1224.definition: the same as H1223; Bozrah = "sheepfold" or "fortress"; 1) a town in Edom; 2) a town in Moab

H1226.definition: feminine intensive from H1219; 1) dearth, drought, destitution

H1227.definition: the same as H1228xlit baqbûk corrected to baqbuq; Bakbuk = "bottle"; 1) a head of a family of temple-slaves returning from exile with Zerubbabel

H1229.definition: from H1228xlit baqbûk corrected to baqbuq and H3050; emptying (i.e. wasting) of Jah; Bakbukiah = "wasting of Jehovah"; 1) a Levite in the time of Nehemiah

H1230.definition: reduplicated from H1239; searcher; Bakbakkar = "searcher"; 1) a Levite, apparently a descendant of Asaph

H1231.definition: from H1238; wasteful; Bukki = "wasting"; 1) son of Abishua and father of Uzzi, fifth from Aaron in the line of the high priests; 2) son of Jogli, prince of the tribe of Dan, one of the ten men chosen to apportion the land of Canaan between the tribes

H1232.definition: from H1238 and H3050; wasting of Jah; Bukkiah = "Jehovah has emptied"; 1) a Kohathite Levite, of the sons of Heman, one of the musicians in the temple

H1234.definition: a primitive root; 1) to split, cleave, break open, divide, break through, rip up, break up, tear; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cleave, cleave open; 1a2) to break through, break into; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be cleft, be rent open, be split open; 1b2) to be broken into; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to cleave, cut to pieces, rend open; 1c2) to break through, break down; 1d) (Pual); 1d1) to be ripped open, be torn open; 1d2) to be rent; 1d3) to be broken into; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to break into; 1e2) to break through; 1f) (Hophal) to be broken into; 1g) (Hithpael) to burst (themselves) open, cleave asunder
H1234.kjvUsage: make a breach, break forth (into, out, in pieces, through, up), be ready to burst, cleave (asunder), cut out, divide, hatch, rend (asunder), rip up, tear, win

H1235.definition: from H1234; 1) half, part also called "shekel of the sanctuary" or "holy shekel"; 2) half a shekel (meton) There appears to be at least three different shekels, one of silver, gold and copper. See a Bible Dictionary for a complete treatment of the subject.

H1237.definition: from H1234; 1) valley; 2) plain, level valley

H1238.definition: a primitive root; 1) to empty; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to empty, lay waste; 1a2) to make void (fig.); 1b) (Niphal) to be emptied; 1c) (Polel) to empty out, devastate

H1239.definition: a primitive root; 1) to seek, enquire, consider; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to seek, look for; 1a2) to consider, reflect

H1240.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H1239 1) to seek, enquire; 1a) (Pael) to enquire; 1b) (Ithpael) to let search be made

H1241.definition: from H1239; 1) cattle, herd, oxen, ox; 1a) cattle (generic pl. but sing. in form-coll); 1b) herd (particular one); 1c) head of cattle (individually)
H1241.kjvUsage: beeve, bull ([phrase] -ock), [phrase] calf, [phrase] cow, great (cattle), [phrase] heifer, herd, kine, ox

H1242.definition: from H1239; 1) morning, break of day; 1a) morning; 1a1) of end of night; 1a2) of coming of daylight; 1a3) of coming of sunrise; 1a4) of beginning of day; 1a5) of bright joy after night of distress (fig.); 1b) morrow, next day, next morning

H1243.definition: intensive from H1239; 1) a seeking, a care, concern

H1244.definition: from H1239; 1) punishment (after judicial enquiry), compensation

H1272.definition: a primitive root; 1) to go through, flee, run away, chase, drive away, put to flight, reach, shoot (extend), hurry away; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go, pass through; 1a2) to flee; 1a3) to hasten, come quickly; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to pass through; 1b2) to cause to flee, put to flight; 1b3) to drive away

H1879.definition: from H1878; adj; 1) fat; subst; 2) vigorous, stalwart ones

H2039.definition: perhaps from H2022; mountaineer; Haran = "mountaineer"; n pr m; 1) youngest son of Terah, brother of Abraham, father of Lot, Milcah, and Iscah; born and died in Ur of the Chaldees; 2) a Gershonite Levite in the time of David, one of the family of Shimei; 3) a son of Caleb by the concubine Ephah; n pr loc; 4) name of the place to which Abraham migrated from Ur of the Chaldees and where the descendants of his brother Nahor established themselves; probably located in Mesopotamia, in Padanaram, the cultivated district at the foot of the hills between the Khabour and the Euphrates below Mount Masius

H2040.definition: a primitive root; 1) to tear down, break down, overthrow, beat down, break, break through, destroy, pluck down, pull down, throw down, ruined, destroyer, utterly; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to throw down, tear down; 1a2) to break through; 1a3) to break down, break away; 1b) (Niphal) to be torn down, be thrown down; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to overthrow, tear down; 1c2) destroyer (participle)
H2040.kjvUsage: beat down, break (down, through), destroy, overthrow, pluck down, pull down, ruin, throw down, [idiom] utterly

H2041.definition: from H2040; n m; 1) overthrow, destruction; n pr loc; 2) (CLBL) city of destruction in Egypt, probably On-Heliopolis

H2042.definition: from an unused root meaning to loom up; 1) mountain, hill, hill country, mount

H2044.definition: perhaps from the same as H2828; wealthy; Hashem = "fat"; 1) a Gizonite, father of some sons who were members of David's mighty warriors

H2045.definition: from H8085; 1) a causing to hear, a report, a communication

H2047.definition: probably of foreign origin; Hatach = "verily"; 1) a eunuch in the court of Ahasuerus

H2048.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Piel) to mock, deceive; 2) (Pual) deceive

H2049.definition: from H2048 (only in plural collectively); 1) mockery, mocker

H2050.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Poel) to shout at, be frantic at, assail, break in, overwhelm, imagine mischief

H2051.definition: perhaps for H5730; Vedan = "and Dan"; 1) a place, site uncertain, perhaps near Medina in Arabia or; 1) may simply be read 'even Dan'

H2052.definition: of uncertain derivation; Vaheb of Waheb = "now, come on: and do thou give"; 1) a place in Moab, site unknown

H2057.definition: perhaps for H6043; Vaniah = "Jehovah is praise"; 1) one of the sons of Bani, in the time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife

H2058.definition: probably from H3254; additional; Vophsi = "rich"; 1) father of Nahbi, the man chosen as the spy for Naphtali

H2059.definition: probably from H3461; weak; Vashni = "strong"; 1) a son of Samuel

H2060.definition: of Persian origin; Vashti = "beautiful"; 1) the queen, wife of Ahasuerus, whom he divorced for disobeying his orders

H2061.definition: from an unused root meaning to be yellow; 1) wolf

H2062.definition: the same as H2061; Zeeb = "wolf"; 1) one of the two princes of Midian mentioned in the conquest; brought to bay in a winepress

H2066.definition: from H2064; giver; Zabad = "he endows"; 1) a descendant of Judah; son of Nathan, grandson of Attai, great grandson of Ahlai Sheshan's daughter; 2) son of Tahath; 3) one of David's mighty warriors (could be the same as 1 above); 4) son of Shimeath, an Ammonitess; a conspirator against and, with Jehozabad, the murderer of Joash (also called 'Jozachar'); 5) one of the sons of Zattu, who put away his foreign wife at the command of Ezra; 6) one of the descendants of Hashum, who, in the time of Ezra, had a foreign wife; 7) one of the sons of Nebo, who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H2067.definition: from H2065; giving; Zabdi = "endowment"; 1) son of Zerah and grandson of Judah; grandfather of Achan; 2) one of the sons of Shimhi, a Benjamite; 3) an officer of David, in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine-cellars; 4) son of Asaph the minstrel; also called 'Zaccur' and 'Zichri'

H2068.definition: from H2065 and H410; Zabdiel = "God is my endowment"; 1) father of Jashobeam, the chief of David's guard; 2) a priest in Nehemiah's time

H2069.definition: or זְבַדְיָהוּ; from H2064 and H3050; Jah has given; Zebadiah = "endowment of Jehovah"; 1) a Benjamite of the sons of Beriah; 2) a Benjamite of the sons of Elpaal; 3) one of the sons of Jeroham of Gedor and one of David's men; 4) son of Asahel, brother of Joab, and one of David's men; 5) son of Michael, of the sons of Shephatiah; 6) a priest of the sons of Immer, who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 7) a Levite, 3rd son of Meshelemiah the Korhite; 8) a Levite in the reign of Jehoshaphat; 9) son of Ishmael and prince of the house of Judah in the reign of Jehoshaphat

H2070.definition: from an unused root (meaning to flit); 1) fly

H2071.definition: from H2064; Zabud = "given"; 1) a priest, son of Nathan, who held the post of 'king's friend' to Solomon

H2072.definition: a form of H2071; given; Zabbud = "given"; 1) one of the sons of Bigvai, who returned in the 2nd caravan with Ezra

H2073.definition: or זְבֻל; from H2082; 1) exalted, residence, elevation, lofty abode, height, habitation

H2074.definition: or זְבֻלוּן; or זְבוּלֻן; from H2082; habitation; Zebulun = "exalted"; n pr m; 1) the 10th of the sons of Jacob, 6th and last of Leah; progenitor of Zebulun; 2) the tribe descended from Zebulun; n pr loc; 3) the land allocated to the tribe of Zebulun

H2075.definition: patronymically from H2074; Zebulonite = see Zebulun; 1) a descendant of Zebulun and member of the tribe of Zebulun

H2076.definition: a primitive root; 1) to slaughter, kill, sacrifice, slaughter for sacrifice; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to slaughter for sacrifice; 1a2) to slaughter for eating; 1a3) to slaughter in divine judgment; 1b) (Piel) to sacrifice, offer sacrifice

H2077.definition: from H2076; 1) sacrifice; 1a) sacrifices of righteousness; 1b) sacrifices of strife; 1c) sacrifices to dead things; 1d) the covenant sacrifice; 1e) the passover; 1f) annual sacrifice; 1g) thank offering

H2079.definition: probably by orthographical error for H2140; Zabbai = "pure"; 1) a descendant of Bebai who took a foreign wife in the days of Ezra; 2) father of Baruch, who assisted Nehemiah in rebuilding the city wall

H2080.definition: feminine from H2064; giving; Zebudah = "given"; 1) wife of Josiah and mother of Jehoiakim, both kings of Judah

H2081.definition: from an unused root (meaning to purchase); gainfulness; Zebina = "bought"; 1) a son of Nebo who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H2082.definition: a primitive root; apparently properly, to inclose, i.e. 1) (Qal) to exalt, honour, (possible) dwell exaltedly

H2085.definition: from an unused root probably meaning to inclose; 1) (meaning uncertain); 1a) name of some insignificant product of the vine, forbidden to Nazarites, perhaps the stem or skin of the grape

H2086.definition: from H2102; 1) arrogant, proud, insolent, presumptuous; 1a) the arrogant ones (as n coll pl); 1b) presumptuous (as adj)

H2087.definition: from H2102; 1) pride, insolence, presumptuousness, arrogance

H2089.definition: (1 Samuel by permutation for H7716; 1) lamb, sheep (may be a typographical error for 'seh')

H2093.definition: from H2092; loathing; Zaham = "loathing"; 1) the son of Rehoboam by Mahalath, David's granddaughter

H2098.definition: for H2088; demons pron; 1) this, such rel pron; 2) (of) which, (of) whom

H2110.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H2109 1) to feed; 1a) (Ithp'el) to feed oneself

H2111.definition: a primitive root; 1) to tremble, quiver, quake, be in terror; 1a) (Qal) to tremble, quake; 1b) (Pilpel); 1b1) to shake violently; 1b2) to cause to tremble

H2136.definition: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2135; 1) purity, innocence, innocence (in God's sight)

H2137.definition: from H2135; 1) glass, crystal, fine glass

H2138.definition: properly, passive participle of H2142, but used for H2145; 1) male

H2139.definition: from H2142; mindful; Zaccur or Zacchur = "mindful"; 1) father of Shammua, the Reubenite spy; 2) a Simeonite of the family of Mishma; 3) a Merarite Levite, son of Jaaziah; 4) son of Asaph the singer; 5) the son of Imri who assisted Nehemiah in rebuilding the wall; 6) a Levite, or family of Levites, who signed the covenant with Nehemiah; 7) a Levite whose son or descendant Hanan was one of the treasurers over the treasuries appointed by Nehemiah

H2140.definition: from H2141; pure; Zaccai = "pure"; 1) the head of a family of 760 exiles returning with Zerubbabel

He prophesied in the spirit; 24) one of the sons of Jehoshaphat; 25) a prophet in the reign of Uzziah, who appears to have acted as the king's counsellor, but of whom nothing is known; 26) father of Abijah or Abi, Hezekiah's mother; 27) one of the family of Asaph in the reign of Hezekiah; 28) one of the rulers of the temple in the reign of Josiah; 29) son of Jeberechiah who was taken by the prophet Isaiah as one of the 'faithful witnesses to record' when he wrote concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz

H2150.definition: by reduplication from H2151; 1) (quivering) tendrils, twig, shoot, tendrils

H2151.definition: a primitive root (compare H2107); 1) to be worthless, be vile, be insignificant, be light; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be worthless, be insignificant; 1a2) to make light of, squander, be lavish with; 2) to shake, tremble, quake; 1a) (Niphal) to shake, quake

H2152.definition: or זִלְעָפָהxlit zilʻâphâph corrected to zilʻâphâh; from H2196; 1) burning heat, raging heat

H2154.definition: or זַמָּה; from H2161; 1) plan, device, wickedness, evil plan, mischievous purpose; 1a) plan, purpose; 1b) evil device, wickedness; 1c) not chaste, incest, licentiousness, adultery, idolatry, harlotry

H2156.definition: or זְמֹרָה (feminine); and זְמֹר (masculine); from H2168; 1) branch, twig, shoot

H2157.definition: from H2161; intriguing; Zamzummims = "plotters"; 1) the Ammonite name for the people who by others were called Rephaim, and were described as a numerous nation of giants; perhaps the same as 'Zuzim'

H2158.definition: or זָמִר; and (feminine) זְמִרָה; from H2167; 1) song, psalm

H2160.definition: feminine of H2158; song; Zemira = "song"; 1) one of the sons of Becher, the son of Benjamin

H2914.definition: from an unused root meaning to burn; 1) tumours, haemorrhoids, piles

H2915.definition: from (the equiv. of) H2902; 1) a coating, plaster

H2916.definition: from an unused root meaning apparently to be sticky (rather perb. a demonstrative); from H2894, through the idea of dirt to be swept away); 1) mud, clay, mire, damp dirt; 1a) mud, mire; 1b) clay (poetical)

H2917.definition: (Aramaic) perhaps, by interchange, for a word corresponding to H2916; 1) clay

H2918.definition: feminine of (an equivalent to) H2905; 1) encampment, battlement; 1a) encampment, tent camp; 1b) walled dwelling places, battlement (metaph.); 1c) row (of stones)

H2921.definition: a primitive root; 1) to patch, spot, be spotted, be coloured; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to spot; 1a2) spotted (participle); 1b) (Pual) to be patched

H2922.definition: apparently from H2921 in the (orig.) sense of covering (for protection); (compare H2924) 1) lamb

H2923.definition: from the plural of H2922; lambs; Telaim = "lambs"; 1) a place in Judah where Saul mustered his forces before attacking Amalek; site unknown

H2926.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Piel) to cover with a roof, cover over, roof

H2927.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H2926; 1) (Aphel) to seek shade, have shade

H2928.definition: from an unused root meaning to break up or treat violently; oppression; Telem = "oppression"; n pr m; 1) a gatekeeper among the returning exiles in the time of Ezra; n pr loc; 2) one of the cities in the extreme south of Judah in the Negeb

H2929.definition: from the same as H2728; oppressive; Talmon = "oppressor"; 1) the head of a family of doorkeepers in the temple; some of his descendants returned from exile with Zerubbabel and were employed in their hereditary office in the days of Nehemiah and Ezra; 1a) possibly two other doorkeepers in the time of Nehemiah

H2930.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be unclean, become unclean, become impure; 1a) (Qal) to be or become unclean; 1a1) sexually; 1a2) religiously; 1a3) ceremonially; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to defile oneself, be defiled; 1b1a) sexually; 1b1b) by idolatry; 1b1c) ceremonially; 1b2) to be regarded as unclean; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to defile; 1c1a) sexually; 1c1b) religiously; 1c1c) ceremonially; 1c2) to pronounce unclean, declare unclean (ceremonially); 1c3) to profane (God's name); 1d) (Pual) to be defiled; 1e) (Hithpael) to be unclean; 1f) (Hothpael) to be defiled
H2930.kjvUsage: defile (self), pollute (self), be (make, make self, pronounce) unclean, [idiom] utterly

H2931.definition: from H2930; 1) unclean, impure; 1a) ethically and religiously; 1b) ritually; 1c) of places

H2932.definition: from H2930; 1) uncleanness; 1a) sexual; 1b) of filthy mass; 1c) ethical and religious; 1d) ritual; 1e) local (of nations)

H2933.definition: a collateral form of H2930; 1) (Niphal) to be stopped up; 1a) to be regarded as unclean (metaplastic)

H2934.definition: a primitive root; 1) to hide, conceal, bury; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to hide; 1a2) hiding, concealing, secretly laying (participle); 1a3) darkness (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to hide oneself; 1c) (Hiphil) to hide

H2935.definition: from an unused root probably meaning to weave; 1) basket

H2936.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Piel) to defile, soil

H2937.definition: a primitive root; 1) to wander, stray, wander astray, err; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to seduce; 1a2) to cause to go astray

H2938.definition: a primitive root; 1) to taste, perceive, eat; 1a) (Qal) to taste

H2939.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H2938; 1) (P'al) to feed, cause to eat

H2940.definition: from H2938; 1) taste, judgment; 1a) taste; 1b) judgment (fig.); 1c) decision, decree
H2940.kjvUsage: advice, behaviour, decree, discretion, judgment, reason, taste, understanding

H2941.definition: (Aramaic) from H2939; compare H2940) 1) taste, judgment, command; 1a) taste; 1b) judgment, discretion; 1c) report; 1d) command
H2941.kjvUsage: account, [idiom] to be commanded, commandment, matter

H2942.definition: (Aramaic) from H2939, and equivalent to H2941; 1) decree, taste, judgment, command; 1a) taste; 1b) judgment, discretion; 1c) report; 1d) command
H2942.kjvUsage: [phrase] chancellor, [phrase] command, commandment, decree, [phrase] regard, taste, wisdom

H2945.definition: from H2952 (perhaps referring to the tripping gait of children); 1) children, little children, little ones

H2946.definition: a primitive root; or perhaps a denominative from H2947, from dandling on the palms 1) to extend, spread, trip, take quick little steps; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to spread out; 1a2) to carry on the palms, dandle; 1a3) to rear children

H2947.definition: from H2946; 1) span, width of the hand, hand breadth; 1a) a unit of measurement, measurement of length; 2) coping (an architectural term)

H2948.definition: from H2946 (the same as H2947) 1) span, hand breadth

H2950.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to smear, plaster over, stick, glue

H2951.definition: of foreign derivation; 1) scribe, official, marshal

H2952.definition: a primitive root; apparently 1) (Qal) to skip, trip, take quick little steps

H2953.definition: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H6852, and meaning the same as H6856; 1) fingernail, nail, claw

H2954.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to be gross, be insensitive, be fat

H2955.definition: probably from H5197; a dropping (of ointment); Taphath = "ornament"; 1) the daughter of Solomon who was married to Ben-Abinadab

H2956.definition: a primitive root; 1) to pursue, chase, be continuous; 1a) (Qal) dripping (participle)

H2957.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H2956; 1) (P'al) to drive away, drive from, chase away

H2958.definition: a variation of H2962; 1) before, not yet, before that, ere (of time)

H2959.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Hiphil) to burden, toil, be burdened

H2961.definition: from an unused root apparently meaning to be moist; 1) fresh, new

H2962.definition: from an unused root apparently meaning to interrupt or suspend; 1) before, not yet, before that

H2963.definition: a primitive root; 1) to tear, rend, pluck; 1a) (Qal) to tear, rend; 1b) (Niphal) to be torn in pieces; 1c) (Poal) to be torn in pieces; 1d) (Hiphil) to provide food
H2963.kjvUsage: catch, [idiom] without doubt, feed, ravin, rend in pieces, [idiom] surely, tear (in pieces)

H2964.definition: from H2963; 1) prey, food, leaf; 1a) prey; 1b) food; 1c) leaf

H2965.definition: from H2963; 1) freshly picked, freshly plucked, fresh-plucked

H2966.definition: feminine (collectively) of H2964; 1) that which is torn, animal torn (by beasts)
H2966.kjvUsage: ravin, (that which was) torn (of beasts, in pieces)

H2967.definition: (Aramaic) from a name of foreign derivation; Tarpelites = "they of the fallen (or wondrous) mountain"; 1) the group of Assyrian colonists who were planted in the cities of Samaria after the captivity of the northern kingdom of Israel; identity uncertain

H2968.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to long, long for, desire

H2969.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to pertain to, befit, be befitting

H2970.definition: or יַאֲזַנְיָהוּ; from H238 and H3050; heard of Jah; Jaazaniah = "Jehovah hears"; 1) a Judean, son of the Maachathite, a captain of the Judean forces who visited Gedaliah at Mizpah after Gedaliah had been appointed governor of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar; 2) son of Shaphan, an elder of Israel in the days of Ezekiel; 3) son of Azur, one of the princes of the people against whom Ezekiel was directed to prophesy; 4) a Rechabite, son of Jeremiah the prophet

H2971.definition: from H215; enlightener; Jair = "he enlightens"; 1) a descendant of Manasseh who conquered many towns during the time of the conquest; 2) the Gileadite, a judge of Israel for 22 years during the time of the judges; father of 30 sons; 3) a Benjamite, son of Kish, and father of Mordecai; 4) father of Elhanan, one of David's mighty warriors

H2972.definition: patronymically from H2971; Jairite = "descendant of Jair"; 1) a descendant of Jair; 1a) Ira the Jairite was a priest to David

H2973.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be foolish, become fools, act foolishly, show wicked folly; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to show wicked folly; 1a2) to become fools

H2974.definition: a primitive root (probably rather the same as H2973 through the idea of mental weakness); 1) to begin, make a beginning, show willingness, undertake to do, be pleased, be determined; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to agree to, show willingness, acquiesce, accept an invitation, be willing; 1a2) to undertake; 1a3) to resolve, be pleased, be determined
H2974.kjvUsage: assay, begin, be content, please, take upon, [idiom] willingly, would

H2975.definition: of Egyptian origin; 1) river, stream, canal, Nile, Nile-canal; 1a) stream, river (Nile); 1b) Nile-arms, Nile-canals; 1c) watercourses; 1d) shafts (mining); 1e) river (in general)

H2976.definition: a primitive root; 1) to despair; 1a) (Niphal) to be despaired, be desperate; 1b) (Piel) to cause to despair; interj; 2) it is hopeless!
H2976.kjvUsage: (cause to) despair, one that is desperate, be no hope

H2977.definition: or יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ; from the same root as H803 and H3050; founded of Jah; Josiah = "whom Jehovah heals"; 1) son of Amon by Jedidah who succeeded his father to the throne of Judah and reigned for 31 years; his reign is noteworthy for the great revivals back to the worship of Jehovah which he led; 2) a returned exile and son of Zephaniah at whose house took place the solemn and symbolical crowning of Joshua the high priest in the time of Zechariah the prophet

H2979.definition: from the same as H871; stepping; Jeaterai = "whom Jehovah leads"; 1) a Gershonite Levite, son of Zerah

H2980.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Piel) to cry, cry shrilly

H2981.definition: from H2986; 1) produce, fruit, produce (of the soil)

H2982.definition: from H947; trodden, i.e. threshing-place; Jebus = "threshing place"; 1) an early name for Jerusalem, the city of the Jebusites; also 'Jebusi'

H2983.definition: patrial from H2982; Jebusite = "descendants of Jebus"; 1) descendants of the 3rd son of Canaan who lived in or around the site of Jebus, the early name for Jerusalem

H2984.definition: from H977; choice; Ibhar = "Jehovah chooses"; 1) one of the sons of David, born in Jerusalem

H2985.definition: from H995; intelligent; Jabin = "whom God observes"; 1) a king of Hazor who organised a confederacy of the northern princes against Joshua; confederacy routed by the waters of Merom; 2) another king of Hazor whose general, Sisera, was defeated by Barak

H2986.definition: a primitive root; 1) to bring, lead, carry, conduct, bear along; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to bear along, bring; 1a2) to carry away, lead away; 1a3) to lead, conduct; 1b) (Hophal); 1b1) to be borne along; 1b2) to be borne (to the grave); 1b3) to be brought, be led, be conducted

H2987.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H2986; 1) (Aphel) to bring, carry, bear along

H2988.definition: from H2986; 1) a stream, watercourse; 1a) as irrigating

H2989.definition: the same as H2988; Jabal = "stream of water"; 1) the son of Lamech by Adah and brother of Jubal; described as the father of such as dwell in tents and have cattle

H2990.definition: from H2986; 1) running sore, runnings, suppurating, ulcer

H2991.definition: from H1104 and H5971; devouring people; Ibleam = "devouring the people"; 1) a city of Manasseh apparently located in the territory of either Issachar or Asher

H2992.definition: a primitive root of doubtful meaning; used only as a denominative from H2993; 1) (Piel) to perform levirate marriage, perform the duty of a brother-in-law; 1a) the duty due to a brother who died childless - to marry his widow and have a son for his name
H2992.kjvUsage: perform the duty of a husband's brother, marry

H2993.definition: from (the orig. of) H2992; 1) brother-in-law, husband's brother

H2994.definition: feminine participle of H2992; 1) sister-in-law, brother's wife, brother's widow

H2995.definition: from H1129 and H410; built of God; Jabneel = "God causes to build"; 1) a town in Judah on the northern boundary near the sea; 2) a town in Naphtali on the boundary in upper Galilee

H2996.definition: from H1129; a building; Jabneh = "building of God"; 1) a Philistine city

H2997.definition: from H1129 and H3050; built of Jah; Ibneiah = "Jehovah builds"; 1) a Benjamite, son of Jehoram

H2998.definition: from H1129 and H3050; building of Jah; Ibnijah = "whom Jehovah will build up"; 1) a Benjamite

H2999.definition: probably from H1238; pouring forth; Jabbok = "emptying"; 1) a stream which intersects the mountain range of Gilead, and falls into the Jordan on the east about midway between the Sea of Galilee and the Dead Sea

H3000.definition: from H1288 and H3050; blessed of Jah; Jeberechiah = "Jehovah blesses"; 1) father of a Zechariah, in the reign of Ahaz and time of Isaiah

H3001.definition: a primitive root; 1) to make dry, wither, be dry, become dry, be dried up, be withered; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be dry, be dried up, be without moisture; 1a2) to be dried up; 1b) (Piel) to make dry, dry up; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to dry up, make dry; 1c1a) to dry up (water); 1c1b) to make dry, wither; 1c1c) to exhibit dryness
H3001.kjvUsage: be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame(-fully), [idiom] utterly, wither (away)

H3003.definition: the same as H3002 (also יָבֵישׁ; often with the addition of H1568, i.e. Jabesh of Gilad); Jabesh = "dry"; n pr loc; 1) a town in the territory of Gilead; according to Eusebius, it is beyond the Jordan, 6 miles (10 km) from Pella, on the mountain road to Gerasa; site unknown but may be modern 'Wadi Yabes'; n pr m; 2) father of Shallum, the 15th king of the northern kingdom

H3004.definition: from H3001; 1) dry land, dry ground

H3005.definition: from the same as H1314; fragrant; Jibsam = "pleasant"; 1) one of the sons of Tola and a grandson of Issachar

H3006.definition: a variation of H3004; 1) dry land

H3007.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3006; 1) the earth (as a planet); 2) dry land

H3008.definition: from H1350; avenger; Igal or Igeal = "He redeems"; 1) son of Joseph and a spy from the tribe of Issachar; 2) son of Nathan of Zobah, one of David's mighty warriors; 3) a son of Shemaiah and descendant of Zerubbabel

H3009.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to till, be a husbandman

H3011.definition: feminine from H1361; hillock; Jogbehah = "lofty"; 1) one of the cities east of the Jordan which was built and fortified by the tribe of Gad

H3012.definition: from H1431 and H3050; magnified of Jah; Igdaliah = "Jehovah is great"; 1) a prophet or holy man and father of Hanan in the time of Josiah

H3013.definition: a primitive root; 1) to afflict, grieve, suffer, cause grief; 1a) (Niphal) grieved, grieving (participle); 1b) (Piel) to grieve; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause grief, cause sorrow
H3013.kjvUsage: afflict, cause grief, grieve, sorrowful, vex

H3014.definition: a primitive root (probably rather the same as H3013 through the common idea of dissatisfaction); 1) (Hiphil) to repel, thrust away, push away

H3017.definition: probably from H1481; a lodging; Jagur = "he sojourns"; 1) a town of Judah, one of those farthest to the south, on the frontier of Edom

H3018.definition: from H3021; 1) toil, work; 2) product, produce, acquired property (as a result of work)

H3020.definition: from H1540; exiled; Jogli = "he is exiled"; 1) a Danite and father of Bukki who was one of the 12 rulers charged with the conquest of Canaan

H3021.definition: a primitive root; 1) to toil, labour, grow weary, be weary; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to toil, labour; 1a2) to grow weary, be weary; 1b) (Piel) to weary, make weary, cause to go toilsomely; 1c) (Hiphil) to make to toil, make weary, cause to be weary

H3022.definition: from H3021; 1) earnings, gain (product of labour)

H3024.definition: feminine of H3019; 1) a wearing, a tiring

H3025.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to fear, dread, be afraid

H3026.definition: (Aramaic) from a word derived from an unused root (meaning to gather) and a derivation of a root corresponding to H7717; heap of the testimony; Jegar-sahadutha = "witness heap"; 1) the mound of stones raised as witness between Jacob and Laban, called by Jacob in Hebrew 'Galeed'

H3027.definition: a primitive word; in distinction from H3709, the closed one); used (as noun, adverb, etc.) in a great variety of applications, both literally and figuratively, both proximate and remote (as follows) 1) hand; 1a) hand (of man); 1b) strength, power (fig.); 1c) side (of land), part, portion (metaph.) (fig.); 1d) (various special, technical senses); 1d1) sign, monument; 1d2) part, fractional part, share; 1d3) time, repetition; 1d4) axle-trees, axle; 1d5) stays, support (for laver); 1d6) tenons (in tabernacle); 1d7) a phallus, a hand (meaning unsure); 1d8) wrists
H3027.kjvUsage: ([phrase] be) able, [idiom] about, [phrase] armholes, at, axletree, because of, beside, border, [idiom] bounty, [phrase] broad, (broken-) handed, [idiom] by, charge, coast, [phrase] consecrate, [phrase] creditor, custody, debt, dominion, [idiom] enough, [phrase] fellowship, force, [idiom] from, hand(-staves, -y work), [idiom] he, himself, [idiom] in, labour, [phrase] large, ledge, (left-) handed, means, [idiom] mine, ministry, near, [idiom] of, [idiom] order, ordinance, [idiom] our, parts, pain, power, [idiom] presumptuously, service, side, sore, state, stay, draw with strength, stroke, [phrase] swear, terror, [idiom] thee, [idiom] by them, [idiom] themselves, [idiom] thine own, [idiom] thou, through, [idiom] throwing, [phrase] thumb, times, [idiom] to, [idiom] under, [idiom] us, [idiom] wait on, (way-) side, where, [phrase] wide, [idiom] with (him, me, you), work, [phrase] yield, [idiom] yourselves

H3029.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3034; 1) (Aphel) to praise, give thanks

H3030.definition: of uncertain derivation; Idalah = "memorial of God"; 1) a town in Zebulun between Shimron and Bethlehem, site unknown

H3031.definition: from the same as H1706; perhaps honeyed; Idbash = "stout"; 1) one of the 3 sons of Abi-etam, a descendant of Judah

H3032.definition: a primitive root; (compare H3034) v; 1) (Qal) to throw lots, cast lots; n; 2) love, loving-one, friend

H3033.definition: from H3039; 1) one dearly loved, beloved one, object of love

H3034.definition: a primitive root; used only as denominative from H3027; literally, to use (i.e. hold out) the hand; 1) to throw, shoot, cast; 1a) (Qal) to shoot (arrows); 1b) (Piel) to cast, cast down, throw down; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to give thanks, laud, praise; 1c2) to confess, confess (the name of God); 1d) (Hithpael); 1d1) to confess (sin); 1d2) to give thanks

H3035.definition: from H3034; praised; Iddo = "timely" or "lovely"; 1) son of Zechariah, ruler of the tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan in the time of David; 2) a man who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H3036.definition: from H3034; thankful; Jadon = "thankful"; 1) a Meronothite and one of the builders of the walls of Jerusalem

H3037.definition: from H3045; knowing; Jaddua = "knowing"; 1) one of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; 2) son and successor in the high priesthood of Jonathan, Jeshua, or Johanan; the last of the high priests mentioned in the OT, probably living in the time of Alexander the Great

H3038.definition: or יְדֻתוּן; or יְדִיתוּן; probably from H3034; laudatory; Jeduthun = "praising"; 1) a Levite of the family of Merari and the chief of one of the 3 choirs of the temple whose descendants also formed one of the perpetual temple choirs; he is named at the beginning of 3 Psalms (Ps 39:1; 62:1; 77:1) either as the composer or the recipient of those Psalms but most likely as the leader of the choir by which those Psalms were to be sung

H3039.definition: from the same as H1730; n m; 1) one beloved, beloved; adj; 2) lovely

H3040.definition: feminine of H3039; beloved; Jedidah = "beloved"; 1) the wife of king Amon and mother of king Josiah

H3041.definition: from H3039 and H3050; beloved of Jah; Jedidiah = "beloved of Jehovah"; 1) the name given to Solomon through Nathan the prophet

H3042.definition: from H3034 and H3050; praised of Jah; Jedaiah = "praised of Jehovah"; 1) a Simeonite, forefather of Ziza; 2) son of Harumaph and one who took part in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem

H3043.definition: from H3045 and H410; knowing God; Jediael = "God makes known"; 1) a chief patriarch of the tribe of Benjamin; maybe the same as 'Ashbel'; 2) the 2nd son of Meshelemiahand a Korahite gatekeeper; 3) son of Shimri and one of David's mighty warriors; 4) one of the chiefs of the thousands of Manasseh who joined David on his march to Ziklag; maybe the same man as 3 above

H3044.definition: from H1811; tearful; Jidlaph = "weeping"; 1) a son of Nahor

H3045.definition: a primitive root; 1) to know; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to know; 1a1a) to know, learn to know; 1a1b) to perceive; 1a1c) to perceive and see, find out and discern; 1a1d) to discriminate, distinguish; 1a1e) to know by experience; 1a1f) to recognise, admit, acknowledge, confess; 1a1g) to consider; 1a2) to know, be acquainted with; 1a3) to know (a person carnally); 1a4) to know how, be skilful in; 1a5) to have knowledge, be wise; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be made known, be or become known, be revealed; 1b2) to make oneself known; 1b3) to be perceived; 1b4) to be instructed; 1c) (Piel) to cause to know; 1d) (Poal) to cause to know; 1e) (Pual); 1e1) to be known; 1e2) known, one known, acquaintance (participle); 1f) (Hiphil) to make known, declare; 1g) (Hophal) to be made known; 1h) (Hithpael) to make oneself known, reveal oneself
