H3046.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3045 1) to know; 1a) (P'al) to know; 1b) (Aphel) to let someone know, communicate, inform, cause to know

H3047.definition: from H3045; knowing; Jada = "He knows"; 1) a Judahite, son of Onam and brother of Shammai, in the genealogy of the sons of Jerahmeel by his wife Atarah

H3048.definition: from H3045 and H3050; Jah has known; Jedaiah = "Jehovah has known"; 1) a priest in Jerusalem; 2) a man who returned with Zerubbabel; 3) a ruler of the priests in the days of Jeshua; 4) a post exilic priest; 5) one honoured by Jehovah, perhaps one of the above

H3049.definition: from H3045; 1) a knower, one who has a familiar spirit; 1a) a familiar spirit, soothsayer, necromancer (meton)

H3050.definition: contraction for H3068, and meaning the same; 1) Jah (Jehovah in the shortened form); 1a) the proper name of the one true God; 1b) used in many compounds; 1b1) names beginning with the letters 'Je'; 1b2) names ending with 'iah' or 'jah'
H3050.kjvUsage: Jah, the Lord, most vehement. Compare names in '-iah,' '-jah.'

H3051.definition: a primitive root; 1) to give, provide, ascribe, come; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to give; 1a2) to set, place; 1a3) to provide (with reflexive); 1a4) to ascribe (glory); 1a5) to grant, permit, come now
H3051.kjvUsage: ascribe, bring, come on, give, go, set, take

H3052.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3051 1) to give, provide; 1a) (P'al); 1a1) to give; 1a2) to place, lay (foundations); 1b) (Hithp'al); 1b1) to be given; 1b2) to be paid
H3052.kjvUsage: deliver, give, lay, [phrase] prolong, pay, yield

H3053.definition: from H3051; 1) burden, lot (that which is given)

H3054.definition: denominative from a form corresponding to H3061lemma יְהיּד yod, corrected to יְהוּד; 1) (Hithpael) to become a Jew (in fact or in fraud), become Judaised

H3055.definition: a briefer form of one corresponding to H3061lemma יְהיּד yod, corrected to יְהוּד; Jehud = "beauty"; 1) a town in Dan, located between Baalath and Bene-berak and 8 miles east of Joppa

H3056.definition: perhaps from a form corresponding to H3061lemma יְהיּד yod, corrected to יְהוּד; Judaistic; Jahdai "whom he will place"; 1) one of the family of Caleb

H3057.definition: feminine of H3064; adj f; 1) the Jewess; Jehudijah = Jewess; n pr f; 2) (CLBL) a Calebite, the wife of one named Ezra

H3058.definition: from H3068 and H1931; Jehovah (is) He; Jehu = "Jehovah is He"; 1) the king of the northern kingdom Israel who overthrew the dynasty of Omri; 2) son of Hanani and an Israelite prophet in the time of Baasha and Jehoshaphat; 3) the Antothite, a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors; 4) a descendant of Judah of the house of Hezron; 5) son of Josibiah and a chief of the tribe of Simeon

H3059.definition: from H3068 and H270; Jehovah-seized; Jehoahaz = "Jehovah has seized"; 1) a king of Judah and son of Josiah; 2) a king of the northern kingdom of Israel and son of Jehu; 3) a king of Judah and son of Jehoram (Ahaziah)

H3060.definition: from H3068 and (perhaps) H784; Jehovah-fired; Jehoash = "given by the Lord"; 1) son of king Ahaziah and the 8th king of Judah; 2) son of king Jehoahaz and the 12th king of the northern kingdom of Israel

H3061.definition: (Aramaic) contracted from a form corresponding to H3063; 1) Judah-the territory of the tribe of Judah

H3062.definition: (Aramaic) patrial from H3061lemma יְהיּד yod, corrected to יְהוּד; 1) Jew

H3063.definition: from H3034; celebrated; Judah = "praised"; 1) the son of Jacob by Leah; 2) the tribe descended from Judah the son of Jacob; 3) the territory occupied by the tribe of Judah; 4) the kingdom comprised of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin which occupied the southern part of Canaan after the nation split upon the death of Solomon; 5) a Levite in Ezra's time; 6) an overseer of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; 7) a Levite musician in the time of Nehemiah; 8) a priest in the time of Nehemiah

H3065.definition: the same as H3064; Jehudi = "Jew"; 1) son of Nethaniah and servant of king Jehoiakim

H3066.definition: feminine of H3064; 1) in the Jewish language, in Hebrew

H3067.definition: the same as H3066; Jewess; Judith = "Jewess" or "praised"; 1) the daughter of Beeri the Hittite and wife of Esau

H3068.definition: from H1961; (the) self-Existent or Eternal; Jehovah = "the existing One"; 1) the proper name of the one true God; 1a) unpronounced except with the vowel pointings of H0136
H3068.kjvUsage: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050, H3069

H3069.definition: a variation of H3068 (used after H136, and pronounced by Jews as H430, in order to prevent the repetition of the same sound, since they elsewhere pronounce H3068 as H136) 1) Jehovah-used primarily in the combination 'Lord Jehovah'; 1a) equal to H03068 but pointed with the vowels of H0430

H3070.definition: from H3068 and H7200; Jehovah will see (to it); Jehovah-jireh = "Jehovah sees"; 1) symbolic name given by Abraham to Mount Moriah in commemoration of the interposition of the angel of Jehovah who prevented the sacrifice of Isaac and provided a substitute

H3071.definition: from H3068 and H5251 with the prononimal suffix; Jehovah (is) my banner; Jehovah-nissi = "Jehovah is my banner"; 1) the name given by Moses to the altar which he built in commemoration of the discomfiture of the Amalekites

H3072.definition: from H3068 and H6664 with pronominal suffix; Jehovah (is) our right; Jehovah is our righteousness; 1) a sacred name symbolically applied to Jerusalem and the Messiah

H3073.definition: from H3068 and H7965; Jehovah (is) peace; Jehovah-shalom = "Jehovah is peace"; 1) the name of a sacred altar built by Gideon in Ophrah

H3074.definition: from H3068 and H8033 with directive enclitic; Jehovah (is) thither; Jehovah-shammah = "Jehovah is there"; 1) a symbolic name for Jerusalem

H3075.definition: from H3068 and H2064; Jehovah-endowed; Jehozabad = "Jehovah has endowed"; 1) son of Shomer, a Moabitish woman, who murdered Joash, king of Judah; 2) a Benjamite, captain of 180,000 armed men, in the days of Jehoshaphat; 3) a Korhite Levite, 2nd son of Obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David

H3076.definition: from H3068 and H2603; Jehovah-favored; Jehohanan = "Jehovah has graced"; 1) a priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim who returned with Zerubbabel; 2) a high priest in the time of Ezra; 3) a Levite priest who took part in the dedication of the wall in the time of Nehemiah; 4) son of Tobiah; 5) a Korhite Levite and one of the doorkeepers to the tabernacle in the time of David; 6) a captain of Judah under king Jehoshaphat; 7) an Ephraimite; 8) an Israelite with a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 9) a Jewish captain after the fall of Jerusalem; 10) the eldest son of king Josiah; 11) a post-exilic prince of the line of David; 12) father of Azariah, priest in Solomon's time; 13) a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors; 14) a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors; 15) a returning exile

H3077.definition: from H3068 and H3045; Jehovah-known; Jehoiada = "Jehovah knows"; 1) father of Benaiah, David's mighty warrior; 2) leader of the priests who joined David at Hebron; 3) high priest at the time of Athaliah's usurpation of the throne of Judah; hid Joash, the king's son, for six years and eventually replaced him on the throne of Judah; 4) second priest, or sagan, to Seraiah the high priest

H3078.definition: from H3068 and H3559; Jehovah will establish; Jehoiachin = "Jehovah establishes"; 1) king of Judah, son of Jehoiakim, and the next to last king of Judah before the Babylonian captivity; kingship lasted for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar who took him to Babylon and imprisoned him for 36 years when he was finally released

H3079.definition: from H3068 abbreviated and H6965; Jehovah will raise; Jehoiakim = "Jehovah raises up"; 1) son of Josiah and the third from the last king of Judah; subject vassel of Nebuchadnezzar who reigned for 11 years before he died a violent death either in combat or by the hands of his own subjects

H3080.definition: from H3068 and H7378; Jehovah will contend; Jehoiarib = "Jehovah contends"; 1) A priest in Jerusalem; 2) the head of the 1st of the 24 courses of priests in David's time

H3081.definition: from H3201; potent; Jehucal = "Jehovah is able"; 1) a son of Shelemiah and a servant of king Zedekiah whom he sent to Jeremiah to entreat his prayers and advice

H3082.definition: from H3068 and H5068; Jehovah-largessed; Jehonadab = "Jehovah is willing"; 1) a son of Rechab, chief of the Rechabites, in the time of Jehu and Ahab; 2) a nephew of David

H3083.definition: from H3068 and H5414; Jehovah-given; Jonathan or Jehonathan = "Jehovah has given"; 1) a son of king Saul and a friend of David; 2) a son of the high priest Abiathar and the last descendant of Eli of whom we hear; 3) a nephew of David who like David slew a giant of Gath; 4) an uncle of David; 5) one of David's mighty warriors; 6) one of David's treasurers; 7) a scribe in the time of Jeremiah; 8) a Levite and father of Zechariah, a priest who blew the trumpet at the dedication of the wall; 9) a son or descendant of Gershom, the son of Moses, and a priest to the tribe of Dan; 10) a son of Kareah and a brother of Johanan; a Judaite captain after the fall of Jerusalem; 11) another Judaite father of Peleth; 12) father of Ebed in the time of Ezra; 13) son of Asahel in the time of Ezra; 14) a priest of the family of Melicu in the time of Nehemiah; 15) son of Joiada and his successor to the high priesthood in the time of Nehemiah

H3084.definition: a fuller form of H3130; Joseph = "Jehovah has added"; 1) the eldest son of Jacob by Rachel

H3085.definition: from H3068 and H5710; Jehovah-adorned; Jehoadah = "Jehovah has adorned"; 1) a descendant of Saul through Jonathan

H3086.definition: or יְהוֹעַדָּן; from H3068 and H5727; Jehovahpleased; Jehoaddan = "Jehovah delights"; 1) wife of king Joash and mother of king Amaziah of Judah

H3087.definition: from H3068 and H6663; Jehovah-righted; Jehozadak or Josedech = "Jehovah is righteous"; 1) grandson of the high priest Hilkiah; son of the high priest Seraiah; and father of the high priest Joshua; he never attained the office of high priest himself because he was carried captive to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar

H3088.definition: from H3068 and H7311; Jehovah-raised; Jehoram or Joram = "Jehovah is exalted"; 1) son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and himself king of Judah for 8 years; his wife was the wicked Athaliah who was probably the instigator for his returning the nation of Judah to the worship of Baal; 2) son of king Ahab of the northern kingdom of Israel and king of Israel himself for 12 years; he was murdered by Jehu on the plot of land for which his father had murdered Naboth thus fulfilling the prophecy of Elijah to the very letter; 3) a priest in the reign of Jehoshaphat

H3089.definition: from H3068 and H7650; Jehovah-sworn; Jehosheba = "Jehovah has sworn"; 1) daughter of king Joram of Judah and wife of the high priest Jehoiada; 1a) alternate spelling 'Jehoshabeath' - H03090

H3090.definition: a form of H3089; Jehoshabeath = "Jehovah is an oath"; 1) daughter of king Joram of Judah and wife of the high priest Jehoiada; 1a) alternate spelling 'Jehosheba- H3089

H3091.definition: or יְהוֹשֻׁעַ; from H3068 and H3467; Jehovah-saved; Joshua or Jehoshua = "Jehovah is salvation"; n pr m; 1) son of Nun of the tribe of Ephraim and successor to Moses as the leader of the children of Israel; led the conquest of Canaan; 2) a resident of Beth-shemesh on whose land the Ark of the Covenant came to a stop after the Philistines returned it; 3) son of Jehozadak and high priest after the restoration; 4) governor of Jerusalem under king Josiah who gave his name to a gate of the city of Jerusalem
H3091.kjvUsage: Jehoshua, Jehoshuah, Joshua. Compare H1954, H3442

H3092.definition: from H3068 and H8199; Jehovah-judged; Jehoshaphat = "Jehovah has judged"; n pr m; 1) son of king Asa and himself king of Judah for 25 years; one of the best, most pious, and prosperous kings of Judah; 2) son of Nimshi and father of king Jehu of the northern kingdom of Israel; 3) son of Ahilud and chronicler under David and Solomon; 4) son of Paruah and one of the 12 commissary officers under Solomon; 5) a priest and trumpeter in the time of David; n pr loc; 6) symbolical name of a valley near Jerusalem which is the place of ultimate judgment; maybe the deep ravine which separates Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives through which the Kidron flowed

H3093.definition: probably from the same as H2022; 1) proud, arrogant, haughty

H3094.definition: from H1984 and H410; praising God; Jehaleleel or Jehalelel = "God is praised"; 1) a Calebite descendant of Judah; 2) father of Azariah and a Merarite Levite in the time of Hezekiah

H3095.definition: from H1986 (in the sense of hardness); 1) a precious stone (known for its hardness); 1a) perhaps the jasper, onyx, or diamond

H3096.definition: or יַהְצָה; or (feminine) יַהְצָה; from an unused root meaning to stamp; perhaps threshing-floor; Jahaz or Jahazah or Jahzah = "trodden down"; 1) a place in Reuben east of the Dead Sea where Israel defeated Sihon king of the Amorites; site uncertain

H3097.definition: from H3068 and H1; Jehovah-fathered; Joab = "Jehovah is father"; 1) son of David's sister Zeruiah and general of David's army; 2) a Judaite descendant of Kenaz; 3) a post exilic family

H3098.definition: from H3068 and H251; Jehovahbrothered; Joah = "Jehovah is brother"; 1) son of Asaph and chronicler to Hezekiah; 2) a Gershonite son or grandson of Zimmah; 3) a Korhite, 3rd son of Obed-edom and doorkeeper in the time of David; 4) son of Joahaz and chronicler to king Josiah

H3099.definition: a form of H3059; Joahaz or Jehoahaz = "Jehovah has grasped"; 1) the father of Joah, Josiah's chronicler

H3100.definition: from H3068 and H410; Jehovah (is his) God; Joel = "Jehovah is God"; 1) son of Pethuel and the 2nd of the 12 minor prophets with a book by his name; probably prophesied in the time of king Uzziah of Judah; 2) eldest son of Samuel the prophet and father of Heman the singer; 3) a Simeonite chief; 4) a Reubenite; 5) a chief of Gad; 6) son of Izrahiah and a chief of Issachar; 7) brother of Nathan of Zobah and one of David's mighty warriors; 8) son of Pedaiah and a chief of the half tribe of Manasseh west of the Jordan in the time of David; 9) a son of Nebo who returned with Ezra and had a foreign wife; 10) a Benjamite, son of Zichri; 11) a Levite; 12) a Kohathite Levite in the reign of Hezekiah; 13) a Gershonite Levite chief in the time of David; 14) a Gershonite Levite, son of Jehiel and a descendant of Laadan; maybe same as 13

H3101.definition: or יֹאָשׁ; (2 Chronicles 24:1), a form of H3060; Joash = "given by the Lord"; 1) son of king Ahaziah and the 8th king of Judah; 2) son of king Jehoahaz and the 12th king of the northern kingdom of Israel; 3) father of Gideon; 4) a son of king Ahab; 5) a descendant of Shelah the son of Judah; either the son of Shelah or the son of Jokim; 6) son of Shemaah of Gibeah who resorted to David at Ziklag

H3102.definition: perhaps a form of H3103, but more probably by erroneous transcription for H3437; Job = "persecuted"; 1) the 3rd son of Issachar also called 'Jashub'

H3103.definition: from H2980; howler; Jobab = "a desert"; 1) the last in order of the sons of Joktan, a descendant of Shem; 2) one of the kings of Edom; 3) the king of Madon, located in northern Canaan, and one of the kings who opposed Joshua during the conquest and who were routed at Meron; 4) head of a Benjamite house; 5) another Benjamite

H3104.definition: or יֹבֵל; apparently from H2986; 1) ram, ram's horn, trumpet, cornet; 1a) ram (only in combination); 1a1) ram's horn, trumpet; 1b) jubilee year (marked by the blowing of cornets) (meton)

H3106.definition: from H2986; stream; Jubal = "stream"; 1) the son of Lamech by Adah and the inventor of musical instruments

H3107.definition: a form of H3075; Jozabad or Josabad = "Jehovah has endowed"; 1) a Korhite Levite, 2nd son of Obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David; 2) one of David's mighty warriors; 3) another of David's mighty warriors; 4) four other priests or Levites

H3108.definition: from H3068 and H2142; Jehovah-remembered; Jozachar = "Jehovah remembers"; 1) a servant of king Joash of Judah and one of his murderers; 1a) also called 'Zabad'

H3109.definition: probably from H3068 and a variation of H2421; Jehovah-revived; Joha = "Jehovah gives life"; 1) one of the sons of Beriah the Benjamite; 2) the Tizite, one of David's mighty warriors

H3110.definition: a form of H3076; Johanan = "Jehovah has graced"; 1) a priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim who returned with Zerubbabel; 2) a Jewish captain after the fall of Jerusalem; 3) the eldest son of king Josiah; 4) a post-exilic prince of the line of David; 5) father of Azariah, priest in Solomon's time; 6) a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors; 7) a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors; 8) a returning exile

H3111.definition: a form of H3077; Joiada or Jehoiada = "Jehovah knows"; 1) son of Paseah, who assisted to repair the old gate of Jerusalem; 2) son of the high priest Eliashib in the time of Nehemiah

H3112.definition: a form of H3078; Jehoiachin = "Jehovah establishes"; 1) king of Judah, son of Jehoiakim, and the next to last king of Judah before the Babylonian captivity; kingship lasted for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar who took him to Babylon and imprisoned him for 36 years when he was finally released

H3113.definition: a form of H3079; Joiakim or Jehoiakim = "Jehovah raises up"; 1) a priest and son of Jeshua the high priest

H3114.definition: a form of H3080; Joiarib = "Jehovah contends"; 1) the head of the 1st of the 24 courses of priests in David's time; 2) a teacher in the time of Ezra; 3) a Judaite in the time of Nehemiah

H3115.definition: from H3068 contracted and H3513; Jehovah-gloried; Jochebed = "Jehovah is glory"; 1) the daughter of Levi, wife and at the same time aunt of Amram, and the mother of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam

H3116.definition: a form of H3081; Jucal = "Jehovah is able"; 1) a son of Shelemiah and a servant of king Zedekiah whom he sent to Jeremiah to entreat his prayers and advice

H3117.definition: from an unused root meaning to be hot; 1) day, time, year; 1a) day (as opposed to night); 1b) day (24 hour period); 1b1) as defined by evening and morning in Genesis 1; 1b2) as a division of time; 1b2a) a working day, a day's journey; 1c) days, lifetime (pl.); 1d) time, period (general); 1e) year; 1f) temporal references; 1f1) today; 1f2) yesterday; 1f3) tomorrow
H3117.kjvUsage: age, [phrase] always, [phrase] chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), [phrase] elder, [idiom] end, [phrase] evening, [phrase] (for) ever(-lasting, -more), [idiom] full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, [phrase] old, [phrase] outlived, [phrase] perpetually, presently, [phrase] remaineth, [idiom] required, season, [idiom] since, space, then, (process of) time, [phrase] as at other times, [phrase] in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), [idiom] whole ([phrase] age), (full) year(-ly), [phrase] younger

H3118.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3117; 1) day; 2) day always refers to a twenty-four hour period when the word is modified by a definite or cardinal number

H3119.definition: from H3117; adv; 1) by day, in the daytime; subst; 2) daytime

H3120.definition: probably from the same as H3196; effervescing (i.e. hot and active); Javan = "Ionia" or "Greece"; n pr m; 1) a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah; n pr loc; 2) Greece, Ionia, Ionians; 2a) location of descendants of Javan

H3121.definition: from the same as H3196; 1) mire, mirer

H3122.definition: a form of H3082; Jonadab or Jehonadab = "Jehovah is willing"; 1) a son of Rechab, chief of the Rechabites, in the time of Jehu and Ahab; 2) a nephew of David

H3123.definition: probably from the same as H3196; 1) dove, pigeon

H3124.definition: the same as H3123; Jonah = "dove"; 1) son of Amittai and a native of Gath-hepher; 5th of the minor prophets who prophesied during the reign of Jeroboam II and whom God sent also to prophecy to Nineveh

H3126.definition: active participle of H3243; 1) sucker, suckling, sapling, young plant

H3127.definition: feminine of H3126; 1) young plant, twig, young shoot

H3128.definition: from H3123 and H482 and the plural of H7350; Jonath-elem-recho-kim = "the silent dove of far-off places"; 1) meaning uncertain; 1a) probably name of melody; 1b) only used in title of Ps 56:1

H3129.definition: a form of H3083; Jonathan or Jehonathan = "Jehovah has given"; 1) a son of king Saul and a friend of David; 2) a son of the high priest Abiathar and the last descendant of Eli of whom we hear; 3) one of David's mighty warriors; 4) a Levite and father of Zechariah, a priest who blew the trumpet at the dedication of the wall; 5) a son of Kareah and a brother of Johanan; a Judaite captain after the fall of Jerusalem; 6) another Judaite; 7) father of Ebed in the time of Ezra; 8) son of Asahel in the time of Ezra; 9) a priest of the family of Melicu in the time of Nehemiah; 10) son of Joiada and his successor to the high priesthood in the time of Nehemiah

H3130.definition: future of H3254; let him add (or perhaps simply active participle adding); Joseph = "Jehovah has added"; 1) the eldest son of Jacob by Rachel; 2) father of Igal, who represented the tribe of Issachar among the spies; 3) a son of Asaph; 4) a man who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 5) a priest of the family of Shebaniah in the time of Nehemiah

H3131.definition: from active participle of H3254 and H3050; Jah (is) adding; Josiphiah = "Jehovah adds"; 1) father or ancestor of Shelomith who returned with Ezra

H3132.definition: perhaps feminine active participle of H3276; furthermore; Joelah = "may he avail"; 1) son of Jeroham of Gedor and one of David's mighty warriors

H3133.definition: apparently the active participle of H3259; appointer; Joed = "Jehovah is witness"; 1) a Benjamite, son of Pedaiah

H3134.definition: from H3068 and H5828; Jehovah (is his) help; Joezer = "Jehovah is help"; 1) a Korhite, one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag

H3135.definition: from H3068 and H5789; Jehovahhastened; Joash = "Jehovah hastens"; 1) a Benjamite, son of Becher; 2) one of the officers in David's court

H3136.definition: a form of H3087; Jozadak = "Jehovah is righteous"; 1) grandson of the high priest Hilkiah; son of the high priest Seraiah; and father of the high priest Joshua; he never attained the office of high priest himself because he was carried captive to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar

H3137.definition: a form of H3113; Jokim = "Jehovah raises up"; 1) a descendant of Judah

H3138.definition: active participle of H3384; 1) early rain, autumn shower; 1a) rain which falls in Palestine from late October until early December

H3139.definition: from H3384; rainy; Jorah = "he instructs"; 1) the head or ancestor of a family who returned from Babylon with Ezra

H3140.definition: from H3384; rainy; Jorai = "Jehovah has taught me"; 1) one of the Gadites dwelling at Gilead in Bashan in the reign of king Jotham of Judah

H3141.definition: a form of H3088; Joram = "Jehovah is exalted"; 1) son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and himself king of Judah for 8 years; his wife was the wicked Athaliah who was probably the instigator for his returning the nation of Judah to the worship of Baal; 2) son of king Ahab of the northern kingdom of Israel and king of Israel himself for 12 years; he was murdered by Jehu on the plot of land for which his father had murdered Naboth thus fulfilling the prophecy of Elijah to the very letter; 3) a Levite in the time of David and an ancestor of Shelomith; 4) son of Toi, king of Hamath

H3142.definition: from H7725 and H2617; kindness will be returned; Jushab-hesed = "whose love is returned"; 1) son of Zerubbabel

H3143.definition: from H3427 and H3050; Jehovah will cause to dwell; Josibiah = "Jehovah causes to dwell"; 1) a Simeonite, father of Jehu

H3144.definition: probably a form of H3145; Joshah = "Jehovah makes equal"; 1) a prince of the house of Simeon

H3145.definition: from H3068 and H7737; Jehovah-set; Joshaviah = "Jehovah makes equal"; 1) son of Elnaam and one of David's mighty warriors

H3146.definition: a form of H3092; Joshaphat or Jehoshaphat = "Jehovah judges"; n pr m; 1) one of David's mighty warriors; 2) a priest and trumpeter in the time of David

H3147.definition: from H3068 and H8535; Jehovah (is) perfect; Jotham = "Jehovah is perfect"; 1) son of king Uzziah of Judah by Jerushah; king of Judah for 16 years and contemporary with Isaiah and king Pekah of Israel; 2) son of Jahdai and a descendant of Caleb and Judah; 3) youngest son of Gideon who escaped from the massacre of his brothers

H3148.definition: active participle of H3498; n m; 1) superiority, advantage, excess; adv; 2) excess, better; conj; 3) besides, moreover, more

H3149.definition: from an unused root (meaning to sprinkle) and H410; sprinkled of God; Jeziel = "the assembly of God"; 1) a Benjamite and one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag

H3150.definition: from the same as the first part of H3149 and H3050; sprinkled of Jah; Jeziah = "Jehovah sprinkles"; 1) a descendant of Parosh who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H3151.definition: from the same as H2123; he will make prominent; Jaziz = "He makes prominent"; 1) a Hagarite, officer of David in charge of the flocks

H3152.definition: perhaps from an unused root (meaning to draw up); he will draw out; Jezliah = "whom God will preserve"; 1) a Benjamite of the sons of Elpaal

H3153.definition: or יְזַנְיָהוּ; probably for H2970; Jezaniah = "Jehovah has listened"; 1) son of Hoshaiah the Maachathite and one of the captains who escaped from Jerusalem during the last siege of the Babylonians; one of the first to return to Gedaliah at Mizpah where he took a prominent part after the assassination of Gedaliah

H3154.definition: from an unused root mean to ooze; 1) sweat, perspiration

H3155.definition: a variation for H250; Izrahite = "descendant of Zerah"; 1) a descendant of Zerah of Judah

H3156.definition: from H2224 and H3050; Jah will shine; Izrahiah or Jezrahiah = "Jehovah will shine"; 1) a chieftain of Issachar; 2) a Levite and leader of the chorus at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah

H3157.definition: from H2232 and H410; God will sow; Jezreel = "God sows"; n pr m; 1) a descendant of the father or founder of Etam of Judah; 2) first son of Hosea the prophet; n pr loc; 3) a city in the Nekeb of Judah; 4) a city in Issachar on the northwest spur of Mount Gilboa

H3158.definition: patronymically from H3157; Jezreelite = see Jezreel "sown of God"; 1) an inhabitant of Jezreel

H3159.definition: feminine of H3158; Jezreelitess = see Jezreel "sown of God"; 1) a female inhabitant of Jezreel; 1a) used only of Ahinoam, a wife of David

H3160.definition: from H2247; hidden; Jehubbah = "hidden"; 1) a man of Asher, son of Shomer or Shamer of the house of Beriah

H3161.definition: a primitive root; 1) to join, unite, be joined, be united; 1a) (Qal) to be united; 1b) (Piel) to unite

H3162.definition: from H3161; n m; 1) union, unitedness; adv; 2) together, altogether, all together, alike
H3162.kjvUsage: alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-) together, withal

H3163.definition: from H3162 with pronominal suffix; his unity, i.e. (adverb) together; Jahdo = "His unity"; 1) a Gileadite, son of Buz and father of Jeshishai

H3164.definition: from H3162 and H410; unity of God; Jahdiel = "my unity is God"; 1) a chief of Manasseh on the east of the Jordan

H3165.definition: from H3162 and H3050; unity of Jah; Jehdeiah = "Jehovah is unity"; 1) a Levite in the time of David; 2) a Meronothite, officer of David in charge of the she-asses

H3166.definition: from H2372 and H410; beheld of God; Jahaziel = "beheld of God"; 1) a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag; 2) a priest in the reign of David who helped move the ark; 3) a Kohathite Levite, 3rd son of Hebron; 4) a Levite, son of Zechariah, of the sons of Asaph, in the reign of Jehoshaphat; 5) an ancestor of one of the families who returned from exile with Ezra

H3167.definition: from H2372 and H3050; Jah will behold; Jahaziah = "Jehovah views"; 1) son of Tikvah, apparently a priest and leader during the time of Ezra

H3168.definition: from H2388 and H410; God will strengthen; Ezekiel or Jehezekel = "God strengthens"; 1) son of Buzi and a priest and prophet; author of the book by his name; taken captive with Jehoiachin and exiled in Babylon where he prophesied for the next 22 years; 2) a priest in charge of the 20th course in the time of David

H3169.definition: or יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ; from H3388 and H3050; strengthened of Jah; Hezekiah or Jehizkiah = "Jehovah has made strong"; 1) son of king Ahazby Abi or Abijah and the 12th king of Judah; his reign was characterised by his godly conduct; reigned for 29 years; 2) head of a family of returning exiles in the time of Nehemiah; 3) an Ephraimite in the time of Ahaz

H3170.definition: from the same as H2386; perhaps protection; Jahzerah = "whom God leads back"; 1) a priest of the house of Immer

H3171.definition: or (2 Chronicles 29:14) יְחַוְאֵל; from H2421 and H410; God will live; Jehiel = "God lives"; 1) a Levite and one of the chief musicians in the time of David; 2) a Gershonite Levite who had charge of the treasures in the time of David; 3) son of Hachmoni and an officer of David and tutor of David's sons; 4) a son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah put to death by his brother Jehoram; 5) Hemanite who took part in the restoration of king Hezekiah; 6) a Levite and overseer in the time of Hezekiah; 7) a ruler of the temple during the reforms of Josiah; 8) father of Obadiah of the sons of Joab in the time of Ezra; 9) father of Shechaniah of the sons of Elam in the time of Ezra; 10) a son of Elam who put away his foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 11) a priest of the sons of Harim who also had to put away his foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H3172.definition: patronymically from H3171; Jehieli = "God shall save alive" or "swept away of God"; 1) a Gershonite Levite of the family of Laadan

H3173.definition: from H3161; adj; 1) only, only one, solitary, one; 1a) only, unique, one; 1b) solitary; 1c)(TWOT) only begotten son; subst; 2) one

H3174.definition: from H2421 and H3050; Jah will live; Jehiah = "Jehovah lives"; 1) doorkeeper of the ark at the time of its establishment in Jerusalem

H3176.definition: a primitive root; 1) to wait, hope, expect; 1a) (Niphal) to wait; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to wait, await, tarry; 1b2) to wait for, hope for; 1c) (Hiphil) to wait, tarry, wait for, hope for
H3176.kjvUsage: (cause to, have, make to) hope, be pained, stay, tarry, trust, wait

H3177.definition: from H3176 and H410; expectant of God; Jahleel = "God waits"; 1) the 3rd of the 3 sons of Zebulun; founder of the family of the Jahleelites

H3178.definition: patronymically from H3177; Jahleelites = "the hope of God"; 1) descendants of Jahleel of the tribe of Zebulun

H3179.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be hot, conceive; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be hot, become hot; 1a2) to mate (of animals); 1a3) to be or become hot (fig. of anger); 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to conceive (sexually); 1b2) to be in heat (of animals)
H3179.kjvUsage: get heat, be hot, conceive, be warm

H3180.definition: from H2560; 1) roebuck; 1a) a kind of deer, reddish in colour; 1b) perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning unknown

H3181.definition: probably from H3179; hot; Jahmai = "whom Jehovah guards"; 1) a man of Issachar and one of the heads of the family of Tola

H3182.definition: from an unused root meaning to take off the shoes; 1) barefoot; 1a) bareness, being unshod (subst)

H3183.definition: from H2673lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה and H410; God will allot; Jahzeel = "God divides"; 1) the 1st of the 4 sons of Naphtali and founder of the family of Jahzeelites

H3184.definition: patronymically from H3183; Jahzeelites = see Jahzeel "God divides"; 1) the descendants of Jahzeel, the 1st son of Naphtali

H3185.definition: from H2673lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה and H410; allotted of God; Jahziel = "God divides"; 1) the 1st of the 4 sons of Naphtali and founder of the family of Jahzeelites

H3186.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to delay, tarry, defer

H3187.definition: a primitive root; to sprout; used only as denominative from H3188; 1) (Hithpael) to reckon genealogically, enrol on a genealogy, enrol, be enrolled
H3187.kjvUsage: (number after, number throughout the) genealogy (to be reckoned), be reckoned by genealogies

H3189.definition: from H3161; unity; Jahath = "He will snatch up"; 1) son of Reaiah and grandson of Shobal of the tribe of Judah; 2) a son of Libni and grandson of Gershom and great grandson of Levi; 3) a Gershonite Levite; the eldest son of Shimei and the grandson of Laadan; founder of the house of Jahath; 4) a Levite and son of Shelomoth; 5) a Merarite Levite in the reign of Josiah

H3190.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be good, be pleasing, be well, be glad; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be glad, be joyful; 1a2) to be well placed; 1a3) to be well for, be well with, go well with; 1a4) to be pleasing, be pleasing to; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to make glad, rejoice; 1b2) to do good to, deal well with; 1b3) to do well, do thoroughly; 1b4) to make a thing good or right or beautiful; 1b5) to do well, do right

H3191.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3190 1) (P'al) to be good, do good, be pleasing

H3192.definition: from H3190; pleasantness; Jotbah = "pleasing"; 1) a city in Judah, hometown of Meshullemeth, wife of king Manasseh; 1a) site unknown

H3193.definition: from H3192; Jotbath or Jotbathah = "pleasantness"; 1) a stopping place in the wilderness; site unknown

H3194.definition: or יוּטָה; from H5186; extended; Juttah = "stretched out"; 1) a town in the mountains of Judah, in the neighbourhood of Maon and Carmel; modern 'Yutta'

H3195.definition: probably from the same as H2905; encircled (i.e. inclosed); Jetur = "enclosed"; 1) a son of Ishmael whose descendants warred with Israel east of the Jordan; 1a) also called 'Ituraea'

H3196.definition: from an unused root meaning to effervesce; 1) wine

H3197.definition: by erroneous transcription for H3027; 1) hand, (way)side

H3198.definition: a primitive root; 1) to prove, decide, judge, rebuke, reprove, correct, be right; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to decide, judge; 1a2) to adjudge, appoint; 1a3) to show to be right, prove; 1a4) to convince, convict; 1a5) to reprove, chide; 1a6) to correct, rebuke; 1b) (Hophal) to be chastened; 1c) (Niphal) to reason, reason together; 1d) (Hithp) to argue

H3199.definition: from H3559; he (or it) will establish; Jachin = "He will establish"; n pr m; 1) the 4th son of Simeon and founder of the family of Jachinites; 2) a priest and the head of the 21st coursein the time of David; 3) a post-exilic priest in the time of Nehemiah; n pr; 4) name of the right-hand pillar before the temple

H3200.definition: patronymically from H3199lemma יִכִין first vowel, corrected to יָכִין; Jachinites = see Jachin "he will establish"; 1) the descendants of Jachin

H3201.definition: or (fuller) יָכוֹל; a primitive root; 1) to prevail, overcome, endure, have power, be able; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be able, be able to gain or accomplish, be able to endure, be able to reach; 1a2) to prevail, prevail over or against, overcome, be victor; 1a3) to have ability, have strength
H3201.kjvUsage: be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, (-not)), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer

H3202.definition: (Aramaic) or יְכִיל; (Aramaic), to H3201 1) to be able; 1a) (P'al); 1a1) to be able; 1a2) to prevail

H3203.definition: and יְכׇלְיָהוּ; or (2 Chronicles 26:3) יְכִילְיָה; from H3201 and H3050; Jah will enable; Jecoliah or Jecholiah = "Jehovah is able"; 1) wife of king Amaziah of Judah and mother of king Uzziah (Azariah)

H3204.definition: and יְכׇנְיָהוּ; or (Jeremiah 27:20) יְכוֹנְיָה; from H3559 and H3050; Jah will establish; Jeconiah = "Jehovah will establish"; 1) son of king Jehoiakim of Judah and king of Judah for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar and was taken captive to Babylon where he was imprisoned for the next 36 years; released at the death of Nebuchadnezzar and lived in Babylon until his death; 1a) primary spelling 'Jehoiachin'

H3205.definition: a primitive root; 1) to bear, bringforth, beget, gender, travail; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to bear, bring forth; 1a1a) of child birth; 1a1b) of distress (simile); 1a1c) of wicked (behaviour); 1a2) to beget; 1b) (Niphal) to be born; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to cause or help to bring forth; 1c2) to assist or tend as a midwife; 1c3) midwife (participle); 1d) (Pual) to be born; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to beget (a child); 1e2) to bear (fig. -of wicked bringing forth iniquity); 1f) (Hophal) day of birth, birthday (infinitive); 1g) (Hithpael) to declare one's birth (pedigree)
H3205.kjvUsage: bear, beget, birth(-day), born, (make to) bring forth (children, young), bring up, calve, child, come, be delivered (of a child), time of delivery, gender, hatch, labour, (do the office of a) midwife, declare pedigrees, be the son of, (woman in, woman that) travail(-eth, -ing woman)

H3206.definition: from H3205; 1) child, son, boy, offspring, youth; 1a) child, son, boy; 1b) child, children; 1c) descendants; 1d) youth; 1e) apostate Israelites (fig.)
H3206.kjvUsage: boy, child, fruit, son, young man (one)

H3207.definition: feminine of H3206; 1) girl, damsel, marriageable girl

H3210.definition: from H3885; lodging; Jalon = "Jehovah lodges"; 1) a son of Ezra and a descendant of Caleb

H3212.definition: a primitive root (compare H1980); 1) to go, walk, come; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go, walk, come, depart, proceed, move, go away; 1a2) to die, live, manner of life (fig.); 1b) (Hiphil) to lead, bring, lead away, carry, cause to walk
H3212.kjvUsage: [idiom] again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, [phrase] follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, [phrase] pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, [idiom] be weak

H3213.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Hiphil) to howl, wail, make a howling

H3215.definition: feminine of H3214 1) a howling (of distress), wailing

H3216.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to speak rashly, talk wildly; 1a) (TWOT) to swallow, swallow down

H3217.definition: from an unused root apparently meaning to stick or scrape; 1) scab, skin sore, scales, scurf, an eruptive disease

H3218.definition: from an unused root meaning to lick up; 1) young locust (early stage of development); 1a) caterpillar (as devouring)

H3219.definition: from H3950; 1) wallet, purse, pouch, bag, receptacle

H3220.definition: from an unused root meaning to roar; 1) sea; 1a) Mediterranean Sea; 1b) Red Sea; 1c) Dead Sea; 1d) Sea of Galilee; 1e) sea (general); 1f) mighty river (Nile); 1g) the sea (the great basin in the temple court); 1h) seaward, west, westward

H3222.definition: from the same as H3117; 1) meaning uncertain, meaning perhaps mules or hot springs

H3223.definition: from H3117 and H410; day of God; Jemuel = "day of God"; 1) the eldest son of Simeon

H3224.definition: perhaps from the same as H3117; properly, warm, i.e. affectionate; hence, dove (compare H3123); Jemima = "day by day"; 1) one of the daughters of Job born after the restoration

H3225.definition: from H3231; 1) right, right hand, right side; 1a) right hand; 1b) right (of direction); 1c) south (the direction of the right hand when facing East)

H3226.definition: the same as H3225; Jamin = "right hand"; 1) the 2nd son of Simeon; founder of the family of Jaminites; 2) a Judaite, the 2nd son of Ram the Jerahmeelite; 3) a Levite who helped Ezra interpret the Law

H3227.definition: for H3225; 1) right, on the right, right hand

H3228.definition: patronymically from H3226; Jaminites = see Jamin "the right hand"; 1) the descendants of Jamin

H3229.definition: or יִמְלָה; from H4390; full; Imlah or Imla = "whom God will fill up"; 1) father of Michaiah the prophet

H3230.definition: from H4427; he will make king; Jamlech = "He will reign"; 1) a chief of the tribe of Simeon

H3231.definition: a primitive root; to be (physically) right (i.e. firm); but used only as denominative from H3225 and transitive, 1) (Hiphil) to choose the right, go to the right, use the right hand, be right handed
H3231.kjvUsage: go (turn) to (on, use) the right hand

H3232.definition: from H3231; prosperity (as betokened by the right hand); Imna or Imnah or Jimnah = "right hand"; n pr m; 1) the 1st born son of Asher; 2) a Levite, descendant of Imnah, who assisted in the reforms of Hezekiah; n patr; 3) descendants of Imnah, son of Asher

H3234.definition: from H4513; he will restrain; Imna = "He will restrain"; 1) son of Helem, descendant of Asher, and leader of the tribe of Asher

H3235.definition: a primitive root; 1) to exchange; 1a) (Hiphil) to exchange; 1b) (Hithpael) to enter into, be changed into; 2) (TWOT) to promise

H3236.definition: probably from H3235; interchange; Imrah = "bitterness"; 1) a descendant of Asher of the family of Zophah and a chief of the tribe

H3237.definition: a primitive root; 1) to touch; 1a) (Hiphil) to touch, feel

H3238.definition: a primitive root; 1) to oppress, suppress, treat violently, maltreat, vex, do wrong; 1a) (Qal) to oppress, suppress; 1b) (Hiphil) to treat violently, maltreat
H3238.kjvUsage: destroy, (thrust out by) oppress(-ing, -ion, -or), proud, vex, do violence

H3239.definition: from H3240; quiet; Janoah or Janohah = "He rests"; 1) a place apparently in the north of Galilee in Naphtali, taken by Tiglath-pileser in his first incursion into Palestine

H3240.definition: a primitive root; 1) to rest; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to rest, settle down and remain; 1a2) to repose, have rest, be quiet; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause to rest, give rest to, make quiet; 1b2) to cause to rest, cause to alight, set down; 1b3) to lay or set down, deposit, let lie, place; 1b4) to let remain, leave; 1b5) to leave, depart from; 1b6) to abandon; 1b7) to permit; 1c) (Hophal); 1c1) to obtain rest, be granted rest; 1c2) to be left, be placed; 1c3) open space (subst)
H3240.kjvUsage: bestow, cast down, lay (down, up), leave (off), let alone (remain), pacify, place, put, set (down), suffer, withdraw, withhold. (The Hiphil forms with the dagesh are here referred to, in accordance with the older grammarians; but if any distinction of the kind is to be made, these should rather be referred to H5117, and the others here.)

H3241.definition: from H5123; asleep; Janum = "asleep"; 1) a town in the mountains of Judah apparently not far from Hebron

H3242.definition: from H3243; 1) young plant, twig, young shoot

H3243.definition: a primitive root; 1) to suckle, nurse, suck; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to suck; 1a2) suckling, babe (subst); 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to give suck to, nurse; 1b2) nursing, nursing woman, nurse (participle)
H3243.kjvUsage: milch, nurse(-ing mother), (give, make to) suck(-ing child, -ling)

H3244.definition: or יַנְשׁוֹף; apparently from H5398; (compare H5399) 1) great owl, eared owl; 1a) an unclean animal

H3245.definition: a primitive root; 1) to found, fix, establish, lay foundation; 1a) (Qal) to found, establish, begin; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to fix or seat themselves close together, sit in conclave; 1b2) to be founded; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to found; 1c2) to establish, appoint, ordain; 1d) (Pual) to be founded, be laid; 1e) (Hophal) to be founded
H3245.kjvUsage: appoint, take counsel, establish, (lay the, lay for a) found(-ation), instruct, lay, ordain, set, [idiom] sure

H3246.definition: from H3245; 1) a beginning, foundation, that being founded

H3247.definition: from H3245; 1) foundation, base; 1a) foundation; 1b) base, bottom

H3248.definition: feminine of H3246; 1) foundation; 1a) founding of city

H3250.definition: from H3256; 1) faultfinder, reprover, one who reproves

H3251.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to anoint, be poured,

H3252.definition: from an unused root meaning to watch; observant; Iscah = "one who looks forth"; 1) daughter of Haran, niece of Abraham, sister of Lot and Milcah

H3253.definition: from H5564 and H3050; Jah will sustain; Ismachiah = "Jehovah sustains"; 1) a Levite and overseer of the offerings during the revival in the time of king Hezekiah

H3254.definition: a primitive root; 1) to add, increase, do again; 1a) (Qal) to add, increase, do again; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to join, join oneself to; 1b2) to be joined, be added to; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to add, increase; 1c2) to do more, do again
H3254.kjvUsage: add, [idiom] again, [idiom] any more, [idiom] cease, [idiom] come more, [phrase] conceive again, continue, exceed, [idiom] further, [idiom] gather together, get more, give more-over, [idiom] henceforth, increase (more and more), join, [idiom] longer (bring, do, make, much, put), [idiom] (the, much, yet) more (and more), proceed (further), prolong, put, be (strong-) er, [idiom] yet, yield

H3255.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3254 1) to add; 1a) (Hophal) to be added

H3256.definition: a primitive root; 1) to chasten, discipline, instruct, admonish; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to chasten, admonish; 1a2) to instruct; 1a3) to discipline; 1b) (Niphal) to let oneself be chastened or corrected or admonished; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to discipline, correct; 1c2) to chasten, chastise; 1d) (Hiphil) to chasten; 1e) (Nithpael) to teach
H3256.kjvUsage: bind, chasten, chastise, correct, instruct, punish, reform, reprove, sore, teach

H3258.definition: from an unused root probably meaning to grieve; sorrowful; Jabez = "sorrow"; n pr m; 1) the head of a Calebite family; n pr loc; 2) a town in Judah apparently near Bethlehem

H3259.definition: a primitive root; 1) to fix, appoint, assemble, meet, set, betroth; 1a)(Qal) to appoint, assign, designate; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to meet; 1b2) to meet by appointment; 1b3) to gather, assemble by appointment; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to meet; 1d) (Hophal) to be set, be placed before, be fixed
H3259.kjvUsage: agree,(maxke an) appoint(-ment, a time), assemble (selves), betroth, gather (selves, together), meet (together), set (a time)

H3260.definition: from H3259; appointed; Iddo = "appointed"; 1) the seer who proclaimed to king Jeroboam of Israel

H3261.definition: a primitive root; apparently 1) (Qal) to sweep, sweep away, sweep together

H3262.definition: from H3261 and H410; carried away of God; Jeuel = "God sweeps away"; 1) son of Zerah and a chief man of Judah

H3263.definition: from H5779; counsellor; Jeuz = "counsellor"; 1) head of a house of Benjamin

H3264.definition: a variation of H3298; 1) wood, forest, thicket, wooded height

H3265.definition: apparently the passive participle of the same as H3293; wooded; Jair = "forested"; 1) father of Elhanan the giant slayer, one of David's mighty warriors; 1a) also called 'Jaare-oregim'

H3266.definition: from H5789; hasty; Jehush or Jeush = "He hurries to aid"; 1) son of Eshek, a remote descendant of king Saul; 2) a Gershonite Levite of the house of Shimei; 3) son of king Rehoboam of Judah

H3267.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be strong, be fierce (meaning dubious); 1a) (Niphal) barbarous (participle)

H3268.definition: from H3267 and H410; emboldened of God; Jaaziel = "made bold by God"; 1) one of the Levites appointed by David to perform the musical service before the ark

H3269.definition: from H3267 and H3050; emboldened of Jah; Jaaziah = "made bold by Jehovah"; 1) a Levite, apparently the 3rd son or a descendant of Merari

H3270.definition: or יַעְזֵר; from H5826; helpful; Jazer or Jaazer = "helped"; 1) a Levitical city east of the Jordan, in Gilead in the territory of Gad, formerly an Amorite city; site uncertain

H3272.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3289; 1) (Ithpael) to advise, counsel, take counsel; 2) (P'al) counsellor (participle)

H3274.definition: from H5789; hasty; Jeush = "assembler"; 1) son of Esau by Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, son of Zibeon the Hivite; 2) a Benjamite, son of Bilhan

H3275.definition: from the same as H5912; troublesome; Jachan = "troublesome"; 1) one of seven chief men of the tribe of Gad

H3276.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Hiphil) to gain, profit, benefit, avail
H3276.kjvUsage: [idiom] at all, set forward, can do good, (be, have) profit, (able)

H3278.definition: the same as H3277; Jael = "mountain goat"; 1) the wife of Heber the Kenite who killed the general Sisera as he slept by driving a peg through his temples into the ground

H3279.definition: or יַעֲלָה; the same as H3280 or direct from H3276; Jaala or Jaalah = "ascending"; 1) the head of a family of the descendants of Solomon's slaves who returned from exile with Zerubbabel

H3280.definition: feminine of H3277 1) female mountain goat

H3281.definition: from H5956; occult; Jaalam = "concealed"; 1) an Edomite, descendant of Esau

H3282.definition: from an unused root meaning to pay attention; conj; 1) because, therefore, because that, on account of; prep; 2) because of, on account of; 3) why (with interrogative pron)
H3282.kjvUsage: because (that), forasmuch ([phrase] as), seeing then, [phrase] that, [phrase] wheras, [phrase] why

H3283.definition: from the same as H3282; 1) ostrich; 1a) ceremonially unclean animal

H3284.definition: feminine of H3283, and meaning the same 1) an unclean bird; 1a) owl, ostrich, literally translated as "daughters of the owl"; 1b) perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown

H3285.definition: from the same as H3283; responsive; Jaanai = "whom Jehovah answers"; 1) a chief man in the tribe of Gad

H3286.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be or grow weary, be fatigued, be faint; 1a) (Qal) to be or grow weary, be fatigued, be faint; 1b) (Hophal) wearied (participle)

H3289.definition: a primitive root; 1) to advise, consult, give counsel, counsel, purpose, devise, plan; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to advise, counsel, give counsel, consult; 1a2) counsellor (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to consult together, exchange counsel, deliberate, counsel together; 1c) (Hithpael) to conspire
H3289.kjvUsage: advertise, take advise, advise (well), consult, (give, take) counsel(-lor), determine, devise, guide, purpose

H3290.definition: from H6117; heel-catcher (i.e. supplanter); Jacob = "heel holder" or "supplanter"; 1) son of Isaac, grandson of Abraham, and father of the 12 patriarchs of the tribes of Israel

H3291.definition: from H3290; Jaakobah = "toward Jacob"; 1) son of Simeon and grandson of Jacob

H3292.definition: from the same as H6130; Jakan = "let him oppress them"; 1) an Edomite

H3293.definition: from an unused root probably meaning to thicken with verdure; 1) forest, wood, thicket, wooded height

H3294.definition: a form of H3295; Jarah = "forested"; 1) a descendant of Saul, son of Micah, great grandson of Mephibosheth

H3295.definition: feminine of H3293, and meaning the same 1) forest; 1a) honeycomb (meton)

H3296.definition: from the plural of H3293 and the masculine plural active participle of H707; woods of weavers; Jaare-oregim = "forests of weaver"; 1) a man of Bethlehem, father of Elhanan the giant slayer and one of David's mighty warriors; also called 'Jair'

H3297.definition: plural of H3293; forests; Jearim = "forests"; 1) a hill on the northern boundary of Judah

H3298.definition: from an unused root of uncertain signification and H3050; Jaresiah = "whom Jehovah nourishes"; 1) a Benjamite, one of the descendants of Jehoram

H3299.definition: from H6213; they will do; Jaasau = "they will do"; 1) one of the descendants of Bani who took a foreign wife during the time of Ezra

H3300.definition: from H6213 and H410; made of God; Jasiel or Jaasiel = "God is maker"; 1) one of David's mighty warriors; 2) a son of Abner and a chief of Benjamin

H3301.definition: from H6299 and H3050; Jah will liberate; Iphedeiah = "Jehovah will redeem"; 1) a descendant of Benjamin and of the family of Shashak

H3302.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be bright, be beautiful, be handsome, be fair; 1a) (Qal) to be beautiful; 1b) (Piel) to beautify; 1c) (Pual) to be beautiful; 1d) (Hithpael) to beautify oneself
H3302.kjvUsage: be beautiful, be (make self) fair(-r), deck

H3303.kjvUsage: [phrase] beautiful, beauty, comely, fair(-est, one), [phrase] goodly, pleasant, well

H3304.definition: from H3302 by reduplication; 1) pretty (reduplication with the force of the diminutive); 1a) fair of mouth (lit.); 2) (CLBL) very beautiful

H3305.definition: or יָפוֹא; (Ezra 3:7), from H3302; beautiful; Joppa or Japho = "beautiful"; 1) a town on the southwest coast of Palestine in the territory of Dan; became primary port of Jerusalem during reign of Solomon

H3306.definition: a primitive root; 1) to breathe, breathe hard, puff; 1a) (Hithpael) to gasp for breath

H3307.definition: from H3306; 1) a breathing out, exhaling, puffing out (subst)

H3309.definition: from H3313; bright; Japhia = "shining"; n pr loc; 1) a town on the border of Zebulun and Issachar; 1a) perhaps modern 'Yafa'; n pr m; 2) the king of Lachish at the time of the conquest of Canaan by Joshua; 3) a son of David by a concubine

H3310.definition: from H6403; he will deliver; Japhlet = "he will deliver"; 1) a descendant of Asher through Beriah

H3311.definition: patronymically from H3310; Japhleti see Japhlet = "let him escape"; 1) descendants of Asher of the family of Japhlet who lived on the southwest border of Ephraim. Used as location

H3312.definition: from H6437; he will be prepared; Jephunneh = "He will be facing"; 1) a Kenezite and father of Caleb the spy from the tribe of Judah; 2) son of Jether and descendant of Asher

H3313.definition: a primitive root; 1) to shine, shine forth or out, cause to shine, send out beams; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to shine out, shine forth, send out beams; 1a2) to cause to shine
H3313.kjvUsage: be light, shew self, (cause to) shine (forth)

H3315.definition: from H6601; expansion; Japheth = "opened"; 1) the 3rd son of Noah whose descendants after the flood settled on the coastal lands of the Mediterranean spreading north into Europe and parts of Asia

H3316.definition: from H6605; he will open; Jephthah or Jiphtah = "he opens"; n pr m; 1) a son of Gilead and a concubine and the judge who defeated the Ammonites; after the victory because of a vow taken before the battle he sacrificed his daughter as a burnt offering; n pr loc; 2) a city in Judah

H3317.definition: from H6605 and H410; God will open; Jiphthah-el = "God opens"; 1) a valley between Zebulun and Asher; location uncertain

H3318.definition: a primitive root; 1) to go out, come out, exit, go forth; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go or come out or forth, depart; 1a2) to go forth (to a place); 1a3) to go forward, proceed to (to or toward something); 1a4) to come or go forth (with purpose or for result); 1a5) to come out of; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause to go or come out, bring out, lead out; 1b2) to bring out of; 1b3) to lead out; 1b4) to deliver; 1c) (Hophal) to be brought out or forth

H3320.definition: a primitive root; 1) to place, set, stand, set or station oneself, present oneself; 1a) (Hithpael) to station oneself, take one's stand, stand, present oneself, stand with someone
H3320.kjvUsage: present selves, remaining, resort, set (selves), (be able to, can, with-) stand (fast, forth, -ing, still, up)

H3321.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3320; 1) (Pael) to make stand, make certain, gain certainty, know the truth, be certain

H3322.definition: a primitive root; 1) to place, set, establish; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to set, place; 1a2) to present; 1a3) to exhibit; 1b) (Hophal) to be stopped, be stayed, be detained
H3322.kjvUsage: establish, leave, make, present, put, set, stay

H3323.definition: from H6671; 1) fresh oil, shining (pure) oil

H3324.definition: the same as H3323; Izhar = "shining oil"; 1) son of Kohath, grandson of Levi, uncle of Moses and Aaron, and father of Korah; progenitor of the Izharites

H3325.definition: patronymically from H3324; Izharites or Izeharites = "oil"; 1) descendants of Izhar son of Kohath and grandson of Levi

H3326.definition: passive participle of H3331; 1) couch, bed

H3327.definition: from H6711; laughter (i.e. mochery); Isaac = "he laughs"; 1) son of Abraham by Sarah his wife and father of Jacob and Esau

H3331.definition: a primitive root; 1) to spread out, make a bed; 1a) (Hiphil) to lay, spread out; 1b) (Hophal) to be laid, be spread out

H3332.definition: a primitive root; 1) to pour, flow, cast, pour out; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to pour, pour out; 1a2) to cast; 1a3) to flow; 1b) (Hiphil) to pour, pour out; 1c) (Hophal); 1c1) to be poured; 1c2) cast, molten (participle); 1c3) being firmly established (participle)
H3332.kjvUsage: cast, cleave fast, be (as) firm, grow, be hard, lay out, molten, overflow, pour (out), run out, set down, stedfast

H3333.definition: passive participle feminine of H3332; 1) a casting (of metal)

H3334.definition: a primitive root; 1) to bind, be distressed, be in distress, be cramped, be narrow, be scant, be in straits, make narrow, cause distress, beseige; 1a) (Qal) to suffer distress
H3334.kjvUsage: be distressed, be narrow, be straitened (in straits), be vexed

H3335.definition: probably identical with H3334 (through the squeezing into shape); (compare H3331); 1) to form, fashion, frame; 1a) (Qal) to form, fashion; 1a1) of human activity; 1a2) of divine activity; 1a2a) of creation; 1a2a1) of original creation; 1a2a2) of individuals at conception; 1a2a3) of Israel as a people; 1a2b) to frame, pre-ordain, plan (fig. of divine) purpose of a situation); 1b) (Niphal) to be formed, be created; 1c) (Pual) to be predetermined, be pre-ordained; 1d) (Hophal) to be formed
H3335.kjvUsage: [idiom] earthen, fashion, form, frame, make(-r), potter, purpose

H3336.definition: from H3335; 1) form, framing, purpose, framework; 1a) form; 1a1) pottery; 1a2) graven image; 1a3) man (as formed from the dust); 1b) purpose, imagination, device (intellectual framework)
H3336.kjvUsage: frame, thing framed, imagination, mind, work

H3337.definition: the same as H3336; Jezer = "forming"; 1) the 3rd son of Naphtali and the founder of the family of Jezerites

H3338.definition: passive participle of H3335; 1) forms, members (of the body)

H3339.definition: from H3335; formative; Izri = "my fashioner"; 1) a leader of one of the Levitical sanctuary choirs

H3340.definition: ; patronymically from H3337; Jezerites = "imagination: form: purpose"; 1) descendants of Jezer the son of Naphtali

H3341.definition: a primitive root; 1) to kindle, burn, set on fire; 1a) (Qal) to kindle; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be kindled; 1b2) to be left desolate; 1c) (Hiphil) to set on fire, kindle
H3341.kjvUsage: burn (up), be desolate, set (on) fire (fire), kindle

H3342.definition: from an unused root meaning to excavate; 1) wine vat, wine-press

H3343.definition: from H6908 and H410; God will gather; Jekabzeel = "God gathers"; 1) the most remote city of Judah; located in southern Judah on the border of Edom

H3344.definition: a primitive root; 1) to burn, kindle, be kindled; 1a) (Qal) to be kindled; 1b) (Hophal) to burn, be burning,

H3347.definition: from H3344 and H5971; burning of (the) people; Jokdeam = "burning of a people"; 1) a city in the mountains of southern Judah; apparently south of Hebron

H3348.definition: from an unused root probably meaning to obey; obedient; Jakeh = "blameless"; 1) father of Agur the sage

H3349.definition: from the same as H3348; 1) obedience, cleansing, purging

H3351.definition: from H6965; 1) living substance, that which stands or exists, existence, substance

H3353.definition: passive participle of H3369; 1) fowler, trapper, bait-layer

H3354.definition: from the same as H3348 and H410; obedience of God; Jekuthiel = "cleansing of God"; 1) a descendant of Caleb of the tribe of Judah

H3355.definition: from H6994; he will be made little; Joktan = "smallness"; 1) son of Eber and descendant of Shem and patriarch of various Arabian tribes

H3356.definition: from H6965; he will raise; Jakim = "He will raise"; 1) a Benjamite and descendant of Shimhi; 2) a Levite priest in charge of the 12th course in the time of David

H3357.definition: from H3365; 1) rare, very precious, honour, dear

H3358.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3357 1) rare, noble, famous, difficult; 1a) honourable; 1b) difficult (meton)

H3359.definition: from H6965 and H3050; Jah will rise; Jecamiah or Jekamiah = "Jehovah raises"; 1) a descendant of Judah, son of Shallum in the line of Ahlai; 2) a descendant of David and one of the seven introduced into the royal line on the failure of it in the person of Jehoiachin

H3360.definition: from H6965 and H5971; (the) people will rise; Jekameam = "let the people rise"; 1) a Levite, the 4th son of Hebron and grandson of Kohath in the time of David

H3361.definition: from H6965 and H5971; (the) people will be raised; Jokmeam = "gathered by the people"; 1) a city of refuge in Ephraim given to the Kohathite Levites

H3362.definition: from H6969 and H5971; (the) people will be lamented; Jokneam = "the people lament"; 1) a city of Canaan conquered by Joshua and in the territory of Zebulun but allotted to the Merarite Levites and located Mount Carmel

H3363.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be dislocated, be alienated; 1a) (Qal) to be dislocated, be torn away, be alienated; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to execute slowly (by exposure or impalation); 1b2) to hang; 1c) (Hophal) to be executed
H3363.kjvUsage: be alienated, depart, hang (up), be out of joint

H3364.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to awake, awaken, become active

H3365.definition: a primitive root; 1) to esteem, be prized, be valuable, be precious, be costly, be appraised; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be precious, be highly valued, be esteemed, be costly; 1a2) to be appraised; 1b) (Hiphil) to make something precious

H3366.definition: from H3365; 1) price, value, preciousness, honour, splendour, pomp; 1a) preciousness; 1b) price; 1c) honour, esteem

H3368.definition: from H3365; 1) valuable, prized, weighty, precious, rare, splendid; 1a) precious; 1a1) costly; 1a2) precious, highly valued; 1a3) precious stones or jewels; 1b) rare; 1c) glorious, splendid; 1d) weighty, influential
H3368.kjvUsage: brightness, clear, costly, excellent, fat, honourable women, precious, reputation

H3369.definition: a primitive root; 1) to lure, entice, snare, lay a snare or lure, set a trap; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to lay snares (fig. of devices of wicked); 1a2) fowlers (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be ensnared, be caught by a bait; 1c) (Pual) to be entrapped

H3370.definition: from H3369; insidious; Jokshan = "snarer"; 1) a son of Abraham by Keturah and father of Sheba and Dedan

H3372.definition: a primitive root; 1) to fear, revere, be afraid; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to fear, be afraid; 1a2) to stand in awe of, be awed; 1a3) to fear, reverence, honour, respect; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be fearful, be dreadful, be feared; 1b2) to cause astonishment and awe, be held in awe; 1b3) to inspire reverence or godly fear or awe; 1c) (Piel) to make afraid, terrify; 2) (TWOT) to shoot, pour
H3372.kjvUsage: affright, be (make) afraid, dread(-ful), (put in) fear(-ful, -fully, -ing), (be had in) reverence(-end), [idiom] see, terrible (act, -ness, thing)

H3374.definition: feminine of H3373; 1) fear, terror, fearing; 1a) fear, terror; 1b) awesome or terrifying thing (object causing fear); 1c) fear (of God), respect, reverence, piety; 1d) revered

H3375.definition: from H3372; fearfulness; Iron = "fearing"; 1) a city of Naphtali; site unknown

H3376.definition: from H3373 and H3050; fearful of Jah; Irijah = "Jehovah sees me"; 1) son of Shelemiah, a captain of the guard who arrested Jeremiah

H3377.definition: from H7378; he will contend; Jareb = "contender"; 1) an epithet given to the king of Assyria

H3378.definition: from H7378 and H1168; Baal will contend; Jerubbaal = "let Baal contend"; 1) name given to Gideon by his father when he destroyed the altar of Baal

H3379.definition: from H7378 and H5971; (the) people will contend; Jeroboam = "the people will contend"; 1) the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel when the kingdom split at the death of Solomon and the 10 tribes split off from Judah and Benjamin and the kingdom under Solomon's son Rehoboam; idolatry was introduced at the beginning of his reign; 2) the 8th king of the northern kingdom of Israel, son of Joash, and 4th in the dynasty of Jehu; during his reign the Syrian invaders were repelled and the kingdom restored to its former borders but the idolatry of the kingdom was maintained

H3381.definition: a primitive root; 1) to go down, descend, decline, march down, sink down; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go or come down; 1a2) to sink; 1a3) to be prostrated; 1a4) to come down (of revelation); 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to bring down; 1b2) to send down; 1b3) to take down; 1b4) to lay prostrate; 1b5) to let down; 1c) (Hophal); 1c1) to be brought down; 1c2) to be taken down

H3382.definition: from H3381; a descent; Jered or Jared = "descent"; 1) son of Mahalaleel and father of Enoch in the 4th generation from Seth; 2) a descendant of Judah and father of Gedor

H3383.definition: from H3381; a descender; Jordan = "descender"; 1) the river of Palestine running from the roots of Anti-Lebanon to the Dead Sea a distance of approx 200 miles (320 km)

H3384.definition: or (2 Chronicles 26:15) יָרָא; a primitive root; 1) to throw, shoot, cast, pour; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to throw, cast; 1a2) to cast, lay, set; 1a3) to shoot arrows; 1a4) to throw water, rain; 1b) (Niphal) to be shot; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to throw, cast; 1c2) to shoot; 1c3) to point out, show; 1c4) to direct, teach, instruct; 1c5) to throw water, rain

H3385.definition: from H3384 and H410; founded of God; Jeruel = "taught by God"; 1) a place in the wilderness of southern Judah

H3386.definition: perhaps denominative from H3394; (born at the) new moon; Jaroah = "new moon"; 1) a chief man of the tribe of Gad

H3387.definition: from H3417; 1) greens, green plants, green thing

H3388.definition: or יְרוּשָׁה feminine passive participle of H3423; possessed; Jerushah or Jerusha = "dispossessor"; 1) the wife of king Uzziah and mother of king Jotham of Judah

H3389.definition: rarely יְרוּשָׁלַיִם; a dual (in allusion to its two main hills (the true pointing, at least of the former reading, seems to be that of H3390)); probably from (the passive participle of) H3384 and H7999; founded peaceful; Jerusalem = "teaching of peace"; 1) the chief city of Palestine and capital of the united kingdom and the nation of Judah after the split

H3390.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3389 Jerusalem = "teaching of peace"; 1) the chief city of Palestine and capital of the united kingdom and the nation of Judah after the split

H3391.definition: from a unused root of uncertain signification; 1) month (lunar cycle), moon; 1a) month; 1b) calendar month

H3392.definition: the same as H3391; Jerah = "new moon"; 1) a 4th son of Joktan and a progenitor of an Arabian tribe

H3394.definition: from the same as H3391; 1) moon

H3395.definition: from H7355; compassionate; Jeroham = "showing pity"; 1) father of Elkanah and grandfather of Samuel of the house of Kohath; 2) a Benjamite and the founder of a family of Benjamites; 3) father or progenitor of Ibneiah and a Benjamite; maybe same as 2; 4) a descendant of Aaron and a priest of the family of Immer; son of Pashur and father of Adaiah; 5) another priest; maybe same as 4; 6) a resident of Gedor and father of one of David's mighty warriors; 7) a Danite whose son or descendant Azareel was head of the tribe in the time of David; 8) father of Azariah one of the captains with Jehoiada in the time of Athaliah

H3396.definition: from H7355 and H410; God will compassionate; Jerahmeel = "may God have pity"; 1) the 1st son of Hezron, grandson of Pharez, and great grandson of Judah and the founder of the family of Jerahmeelites; 2) officer sent by king Jehoiakim of Judah to arrest Baruch; 3) a Merarite Levite the representative of the family of Kish, the son of Mahli

H3397.definition: patronymically from H3396; Jerahmeelites = see Jerahmeel "may God have pity"; 1) the descendants of Jerahmeel, the great grandson of Judah

H3398.definition: probably of Egyptian origin; Jarha = "the month of sweeping away"; 1) the Egyptian slave of Sheshan, about the time of Eli, to whom his master gave his daughter or heir as wife

H3399.definition: a primitive root; 1) to precipitate, be precipitate, push headlong, drive recklessly; 1a) (Qal) to precipitate, wring out, be precipitate

H3400.definition: from H3384 and H410; thrown of God; Jeriel = "taught by God"; 1) one of the 6 heads of the house of Tola of the tribe of Issachar

H3402.definition: the same as H3401; Jarib = "he contends"; 1) a son of Simeon; 2) one of the chief men of Israel who returned from exile with Ezra; 3) son of Jozadak and a priest of the house of Jeshua who married a foreign wife and was compelled by Ezra to put her away

H3403.definition: from H3401; contentious; Jeribai = "my contentions"; 1) a descendant of Elnaam and one of David's mighty warriors

H3404.definition: or יְרִיָּהוּ; from H3384 and H3050; Jah will throw; Jerijah or Jeriah = " taught by Jehovah"; 1) a Kohathite Levite and chief of the house of Hebron when David organised the service

H3405.definition: or יְרֵחוֹ; or variation (1 Kings 16:34) יְרִיחֹה; perhaps from H3394; its month; or else from H7306; fragrant; Jericho = "its moon"; 1) a city 5 miles (8 km) west of the Jordan and 7 miles (11.5 km) north of the Dead Sea and the first city conquered by the Israelites upon entering the promised land of Canaan

H3406.definition: or יְרֵימוֹת; or יְרֵמוֹת; feminine plural from H7311; elevations; Jerimoth or Jeremoth = "He is Most High"; 1) a Benjamite, son of Bela and head of a house of Benjamite; 2) a Benjamite, son of Becher and head of a house of Benjamite; 3) a Benjamite, son of Beriah and grandson of Elpaal; 4) a Merarite Levite, son of Mushi; 5) one of the men that joined David in the wilderness; 6) a Levite, son of Heman and head of the 15th course of musicians; 7) a Levite in the reign of Hezekiah; 8) a son of Azriel, ruler of the tribe of Naphtali in the reign of David; 9) a son of king David and the father of the wife of Rehoboam; 10) a son of Elam, a man with a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 11) a son of Zattu, a man with a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
H3406.kjvUsage: Jermoth, Jerimoth, and Ramoth (from the margin)

H3408.definition: plural of H3407; curtains; Jerioth = "curtains"; 1) the wife or concubine of Caleb, the son of Hezron of the descendants of Judah

H3409.definition: from an unused root meaning to be soft; 1) thigh, side, loin, base; 1a) thigh; 1a1) outside of thigh (where sword was worn); 1a2) loins (as the seat of procreative power); 1b) side (flank) (of object); 1c) base

H3410.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3411; 1) thigh, loin, flank, side, recess

H3411.definition: feminine of H3409; 1) flank, side, extreme parts, recesses; 1a) side; 1b) sides, recesses (dual)

H3413.definition: from H7311; elevated; Jeremai = "my exaltations"; 1) a descendant of Hashum who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra and was compelled to put her away
