H3415.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to tremble, quiver
H3415.kjvUsage: be grevious (only Isaiah 15:4; the rest belong to H7489)

H3416.definition: from H7495 and H410; God will heal; Irpeel = "God will heal"; 1) a city in Benjamin; site unknown

H3418.definition: from H3417 (in the sense of vacuity of color); 1) green, greenness, green plants, greenery

H3419.definition: from the same as H3418; 1) herbs, herbage, vegetables, garden greens

H3420.definition: from H3418; 1) mildew, paleness, lividness; 1a) mildew, rust; 1b) paleness

H3421.definition: from H7324 and H5971; people will be poured forth; Jorkoam = "the people empty"; 1) a Calebite descendant of Judah

H3422.definition: from the same as H3418; 1) greenish, pale green, greenish-yellow

H3423.definition: or יָרֵשׁ; a primitive root; 1) to seize, dispossess, take possession off, inherit, disinherit, occupy, impoverish, be an heir; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to take possession of; 1a2) to inherit; 1a3) to impoverish, come to poverty, be poor; 1b) (Niphal) to be dispossessed, be impoverished, come to poverty; 1c) (Piel) to devour; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to cause to possess or inherit; 1d2) to cause others to possess or inherit; 1d3) to impoverish; 1d4) to dispossess; 1d5) to destroy, bring to ruin, disinherit
H3423.kjvUsage: cast out, consume, destroy, disinherit, dispossess, drive(-ing) out, enjoy, expel, [idiom] without fail, (give to, leave for) inherit(-ance, -or) [phrase] magistrate, be (make) poor, come to poverty, (give to, make to) possess, get (have) in (take) possession, seize upon, succeed, [idiom] utterly

H3426.definition: perhaps from an unused root meaning to stand out, or exist; entity; used adverbially or as a copula for the substantive verb (H1961); 1) being, existence, substance, there is or are; 1a) substance; 1b) existence; 1c) there is or are
H3426.kjvUsage: (there) are, (he, it, shall, there, there may, there shall, there should) be, thou do, had, hast, (which) hath, (I, shalt, that) have, (he, it, there) is, substance, it (there) was, (there) were, ye will, thou wilt, wouldest

H3427.definition: a primitive root; 1) to dwell, remain, sit, abide; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to sit, sit down; 1a2) to be set; 1a3) to remain, stay; 1a4) to dwell, have one's abode; 1b) (Niphal) to be inhabited; 1c) (Piel) to set, place; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to cause to sit; 1d2) to cause to abide, set; 1d3) to cause to dwell; 1d4) to cause (cities) to be inhabited; 1d5) to marry (give an dwelling to); 1e) (Hophal); 1e1) to be inhabited; 1e2) to make to dwell
H3427.kjvUsage: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry

H3428.definition: from H3427 and H1; seat of (his) father; Jeshebeab = "dwelling of the father"; 1) a Levite, head of the 14th course of the priests

H3429.definition: from the active participle of H3427 and H7674, with a preposition and the article interposed; sitting in the seat; Josheb-basshebeth = "dwelling in rest"; 1) one of David's mighty warriors

H3430.definition: from H3427 and H5011, with a pronominal suffix and a preposition interposed; his dwelling (is) in Nob; Ishbi-benob = "his dwelling is in Nob"; 1) son of Rapha, one of the nation of Philistine giants who attacked David in battle and was slain by Abishai

H3431.definition: from H7623; he will praise; Ishbah = "he will praise"; 1) father of Eshtemoa and descendant of Judah

H3432.definition: patronymically from H3437; Jashubites = see Jashub "he will return"; 1) descendants of Jashub of the tribe of Issachar

H3433.definition: from H7725 and H3899; returner of bread; Jashubi-lehem = "returner of bread"; 1) a descendant of Shelah, the son of Judah by Bath-shua the Canaanitess
H3433.kjvUsage: Jashubi-lehem. (Prob. the text should be pointed יֹשְׁבֵי לֶחֶם and rendered '(they were) inhabitants of Lechem,' i.e. of Bethlehem (by contraction). Compare H3902)

H3434.definition: from H7725 and H5971; people will return; Jashobeam = "the people will return"; 1) a Hachmonite, the leader of the 30 mighty warriors of David; he joined David at Ziklag and was best known as the man who slew 800 or 300 men at one time; also called 'Adino the Eznite'; 2) a Korahite, another of David's mighty warriors; same as 1?

H3435.definition: from an unused root corresponding to H7662; he will leave; Ishbak = "he releases"; 1) a son of Abraham by Keturah and progenitor of an Arabian tribe

H3436.definition: from H3427 and H7186; a hard seat; Joshbekashah = "seated in hardness"; 1) son of Heman and the leader of the 17th course of musicians

H3437.definition: or יָשִׁיב; from H7725; he will return; Jashub = "he will return"; 1) the 3rd son of Issachar and founder of the family of Jashubites; 2) one of the sons of Bani who had to put away a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H3438.definition: from H7737; he will level; Ishuai or Isuah = "he will resemble"; 1) the 2nd son of Asher

H3439.definition: from the same as H3445 and H3050; Jah will empty; Jeshohaiah = "Jehovah humbles"; 1) a descendant of Shimei and a chief of the Simeonites

H3440.definition: from H7737; level; Ishui or Ishuai or Isui or Jesui = "he resembles me"; 1) the 2nd son of Saul by his wife Ahinoam; 2) the 3rd son of Asher and founder of the family of Ishuaites

H3441.definition: patronymically from H3440; Jesuites = see Jesui "he will justify me"; 1) the descendants of Jesui ( H03440-2)

H3442.definition: for H3091; he will save; Jeshua = "he is saved"; n pr m; 1) son of Nun of the tribe of Ephraim and successor to Moses as the leader of the children of Israel; led the conquest of Canaan; 2) son of Jehozadak and high priest after the restoration; 3) a priest in the time of David who had charge of the 9th course; 4) a Levite in the reign of Hezekiah; 5) head of a Levitical house which returned from captivity in Babylon; 6) father of a builder of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; n pr loc; 7) a town in southern Judah reinhabited by the people of Judah after the return from captivity

H3443.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3442 Jeshua = "he is saved"; 1) an exilic priest who returned with Zerubbabel

H3444.definition: feminine passive participle of H3467; 1) salvation, deliverance; 1a) welfare, prosperity; 1b) deliverance; 1c) salvation (by God); 1d) victory
H3444.kjvUsage: deliverance, health, help(-ing), salvation, save, saving (health), welfare

H3445.definition: from an unused root meaning to gape (as the empty stomach); 1) a sinking feeling, emptiness

H3446.definition: from H7831; he will laugh; Isaac = "he laughs"; 1) son of Abraham by Sarah his wife and father of Jacob and Esau

H3447.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Hiphil) to hold out, extend

H3448.definition: by Aramaic אִישַׁי; from the same as H3426; extant; Jesse = "I possess"; 1) son of Boaz and the father of king David

H3449.definition: or יִשִּׁיָּהוּ; from H5383 and H3050; Jah will lend; Ishiah or Ishijah or Jesiah = "Jehovah will lend"; 1) a Korhite, one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag; 2) the 5th of 5 sons of Izrahiah and one of the heads of the tribe of Issachar in the time of David; 3) a Levite, the 2nd son of Uzziel and grandson of Kohath; 4) another Levite, son of Rehabiah; 5) a descendant of Harim who had a foreign wife

H3450.definition: from H7760 and H410; God will place; Jesimiel = "God will place"; 1) a Simeonite chief of the family of Shimei

H3452.definition: from H3456; 1) waste, wilderness, desert, desolate place

H3453.definition: from H3486; 1) aged, old man, aged one

H3454.definition: from H3453; aged; Jeshishai = "my old one"; 1) a Gadite from Gilead

H3455.definition: a primitive root; 1) to put, place, set, appoint, make; 1a) (Qal) to put, place

H3456.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to ruin, be desolate

H3457.definition: from H3456; desolate; Ishma = "desolation"; 1) a Judaite descended from Hur

H3458.definition: from H8085 and H410; God will hear; Ishmael = "God will hear"; 1) son of Abraham and Sarah's handmaid Hagar and the progenitor of the Arabian peoples; 2) son of Nethaniah and the murderer of Gedaliah; 3) a Benjamite, one of the sons of Azel a descendant of Saul through Meribbaal or Mephibosheth; 4) a Judaite, father of Zebadiah; 5) a Judaite, son of Johanan and one of the captains who aided Jehoiada in restoring Joash to the throne; 6) a priest of the family of Pashur with a foreign wife whom he was forced to put away by Ezra

H3459.definition: patronymically from H3458; Ishmaelite = see Ishmael "God will hear"; 1) a descendant of Ishmael

H3460.definition: or יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּlemma יְשְׁמַעְיָהוּ first vowel, corrected to יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּ; from H8085 and H3050; Jah will hear; Ishmaiah = "Jehovah will hear"; 1) a Gibeonite and one of David's mighty warriors; 2) a son of Obadiah and the ruler of the tribe of Zebulun in the time of king David

H3461.definition: from H8104; preservative; Ishmerai = "He keeps me"; 1) a Benjamite of the family of Elpaal

H3462.definition: a primitive root; 1) to sleep, be asleep; 1a) (Qal) to sleep, go to sleep, be asleep; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to remain a long time, be stored up; 1b2) to be festering (of leprosy); 1c) (Piel) to cause to sleep, entice to sleep

H3464.definition: the same as H3463; Jashen = "sleeping"; 1) the father of one or more of David's mighty warriors

H3466.definition: feminine of H3465; Jeshanah = "storage"; 1) a town of the southern border of the northern kingdom near Bethel

H3467.definition: a primitive root; 1) to save, be saved, be delivered; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to be liberated, be saved, be delivered; 1a2) to be saved (in battle), be victorious; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to save, deliver; 1b2) to save from moral troubles; 1b3) to give victory to
H3467.kjvUsage: [idiom] at all, avenging, defend, deliver(-er), help, preserve, rescue, be safe, bring (having) salvation, save(-iour), get victory

H3468.definition: or יֵשַׁע; from H3467; 1) deliverance, salvation, rescue, safety, welfare; 1a) safety, welfare, prosperity; 1b) salvation; 1c) victory

H3469.definition: from H3467; saving; Ishi = "He saves me"; 1) son of Appaim, one of the line of Jerahmeel of the house of Hezron; 2) a chief of Manasseh and head of a family on the east of Jordan; 3) a chief of Judah, father of Zoheth; 4) a chief of Simeon and head of a family

H3470.definition: or יְשַׁעְיָהוּ; from H3467 and H3050; Jah has saved; Isaiah or Jesaiah or Jeshaiah = "Jehovah has saved"; 1) the major prophet, son of Amoz, who prophesied concerning Judah and Jerusalem during the days of kings Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah of Judah; author of the prophetic book by his name; tradition has it that he was sawn asunder in the trunk of a carob tree by king Manasseh and that this is the incident referred to in Heb 11:37; 2) son of Hananiah, brother of Pelatiah, and grandson of Zerubbabel; 3) a Benjamite; 4) one of the 6 sons of Jeduthun; 5) son of Rehabiah, a descendant of Moses through Gershom, and an ancestor of a Levite treasurer in the time of David; 6) son of Athaliah and chief of the house of Elam who returned with Ezra; 7) a chief of the descendants of Merari who returned with Ezra

H3471.definition: from an unused root meaning to polish; 1) jasper (a precious stone)

H3472.definition: perhaps from H8192; he will scratch; Ispah = "He is bare"; 1) a Benjamite of the family of Beriah and one of the heads of his tribe

H3473.definition: probably from the same as H8227; he will hide; Ishpan = "he hides"; 1) a Benjamite of the family of Shashak

H3474.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be right, be straight, be level, be upright, be just, be lawful, be smooth; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go straight; 1a2) to be pleasing, be agreeable, be right (fig.); 1a3) to be straightforward, be upright; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to make right, make smooth, make straight; 1b2) to lead, direct, lead straight along; 1b3) to esteem right, approve; 1c) (Pual) to be made level, be laid smoothly out; 1d) (Hiphil) to make straight, look straight
H3474.kjvUsage: direct, fit, seem good (meet), [phrase] please (will), be (esteem, go) right (on), bring (look, make, take the) straight (way), be upright(-ly)

H3475.definition: from H3474; the right; Jesher = "upright"; 1) one of the sons of Caleb and grandson of Hezron by wife Azubah

H3476.definition: from H3474; 1) straightness, uprightness; 1a) straightness, evenness (moral implications); 1b) rightness, uprightness; 1c) what is right, what is due

H3477.definition: from H3474; 1) straight, upright, correct, right; 1a) straight, level; 1b) right, pleasing, correct; 1c) straightforward, just, upright, fitting, proper; 1d) uprightness, righteous, upright; 1e) that which is upright (subst)
H3477.kjvUsage: convenient, equity, Jasher, just, meet(-est), [phrase] pleased well right(-eous), straight, (most) upright(-ly, -ness)

H3478.definition: from H8280 and H410; he will rule as God; Israel = "God prevails"; 1) the second name for Jacob given to him by God after his wrestling with the angel at Peniel; 2) the name of the descendants and the nation of the descendants of Jacob; 2a) the name of the nation until the death of Solomon and the split; 2b) the name used and given to the northern kingdom consisting of the 10 tribes under Jeroboam; the southern kingdom was known as Judah; 2c) the name of the nation after the return from exile

H3479.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3478 Israel = "God prevails"; 1) the second name for Jacob given to him by God after his wrestling with the angel at Peniel; 2) the name of the descendants and the nation of the descendants of Jacob; 2a) the name of the nation until the death of Solomon and the split; 2b) the name used and given to the northern kingdom consisting of the 10 tribes under Jeroboam; the southern kingdom was known as Judah; 2c) the name of the nation after the return from exile

H3480.definition: by variation from H3477 and H410 with directive enclitic; right towards God; Jesharelah = "these are upright"; 1) a Levite and son of Asaph and leader of the 7th course of the musicians

H3481.definition: patronymically from H3478; Israelite = see Israel "God prevails"; 1) a descendant or inhabitant of the nation of Israel

H3482.definition: feminine of H3481; Israelitess = see Israel "God prevails"; 1) a female descendant or inhabitant of the nation of Israel

H3484.definition: from H3474; upright; Jeshurun = "upright one"; 1) a symbolic name for Israel describing her ideal character

H3485.definition: (strictly yis-saws-kawr'); from H5375 and H7939; he will bring a reward; Issachar = "there is recompense"; n pr m; 1) the 9th son of Jacob and the 5th by Leah his first wife and the progenitor of a tribe by his name; 2) a Korahite Levite and the 7th son of Obed-edom and doorkeeper to the temple; n pr coll; 3) the tribe descended from Issachar the son of Jacob; n pr loc; 4) the territory allocated to the descendants of Issachar when they entered the land of Canaan

H3486.definition: from an unused root meaning to blanch; 1) aged, decrepit, feeble

H3487.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H853; 1) (mark of the direct object or the accusative and not translated)

H3488.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3427; 1) to sit, dwell; 1a) (P'al) to sit, be seated; 1b) (Aphel) to cause to dwell

H3489.definition: from an unused root meaning to pin through or fast; 1) pin, stake, peg, nail; 1a) pin, peg, tent pin, tent stake; 1b) nail, pin (fig.); 1c) pin (used in weaving)

H3490.definition: from an unused root meaning to be lonely; 1) an orphan, fatherless

H3491.definition: passive participle of H3498; 1) to remain over, leave, range over; 2) (BDB) a searching (n m)

H3492.definition: from H3498; redundant; Jattir = "plenty"; 1) a town in the mountains of Judah

H3493.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3492; adj; 1) pre-eminent, surpassing, extreme, extraordinary; adv; 2) exceedingly, extremely

H3494.definition: probably from H8518; it will hang, i.e. be high; Jethlah = "he hangs"; 1) one of the towns in southern Dan

H3495.definition: from the same as H3490; orphanage; Ithmah = "orphan"; 1) a Moabite, one of David's mighty warriors

H3496.definition: from an unused root meaning to endure, and H410; continued of God; Jathniel = "God hires me"; 1) a Korhite Levite and the 4th of the family of Meshelemiah

H3497.definition: from the same as H8577; extensive; Ithnan = "hire"; 1) one of the towns in the extreme south of Judah; site unknown

H3498.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be left over, remain, remain over, leave; 1a) (Qal) remainder (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be left over, remain over, be left behind; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to leave over, leave; 1c2) to save over, preserve alive; 1c3) to excel, show pre-eminence; 1c4) to show excess, have more than enough, have an excess
H3498.kjvUsage: excel, leave (a remnant), left behind, too much, make plenteous, preserve, (be, let) remain(-der, -ing, -nant), reserve, residue, rest

H3499.definition: from H3498; 1) remainder, excess, rest, remnant, excellence; 1a) remainder, remnant; 1b) remainder, rest, other part; 1c) excess; 1d) abundantly (adv); 1e) abundance, affluence; 1f) superiority, excellency
H3499.kjvUsage: [phrase] abundant, cord, exceeding, excellancy(-ent), what they leave, that hath left, plentifully, remnant, residue, rest, string, with

H3500.definition: the same as H3499; Jether = "abundance"; 1) father-in-law of Moses; 2) oldest son of Gideon; 3) father of Jephunneh and the chief of a line of warriors of the line of Asher; 4) father of Amasa, the commander of Absalom's army; 5) son of Jada, a descendant of Hezron, of the tribe of Judah; 6) a son of Ezra, a Judaite

H3501.definition: by variation for H3502; Ithra = "abundance"; 1) father of Amasa, the commander of Absalom's army; also 'Jether'

H3502.definition: feminine of H3499; 1) abundance, riches, wealth

H3503.definition: from H3499 with pron. suffix; his excellence; Jethro = "his abundance"; 1) father-in-law of Moses; also 'Jether'

H3505.definition: patronymically from H3500; Ithrite = "a remnant: excellence"; 1) a descendant of Jether

H3506.definition: from H3498; excellent; Ithran = "advantage"; 1) an Edomite, son of Dishon, a Horite, and probably a phylarch of a tribe of the Horim; 2) an descendant of Asher

H3507.definition: from H3499 and H5971; excellence of people; Ithream = "profit of the people"; 1) a son of David by his wife Eglah; the 6th son and born in Hebron

H3508.definition: feminine active participle of H3498; 1) appendage, overhang, protrusion, the caudate lobe of the liver of a sacrificial animal

H3509.definition: of uncertain derivation; Jetheth = "a nail"; 1) one of the dukes of Edom who came of Esau

H3510.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be in pain, be sore, have pain, be sorrowful; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be in pain (physical); 1a2) to be in pain (mental); 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause pain, hurt, mar; 1b2) pain, mar (participle)
H3510.kjvUsage: grieving, mar, have pain, make sad (sore), (be) sorrowful

H3511.definition: from H3510; 1) pain (mental and physical), sorrow

H3512.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be sad, be disheartened, be cowed; 1a) (Niphal) to be disheartened, be cowed; 1b) (Hiphil) to make sad

H3513.definition: or כָּבֵד; a primitive root; 1) to be heavy, be weighty, be grievous, be hard, be rich, be honourable, be glorious, be burdensome, be honoured; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be heavy; 1a2) to be heavy, be insensible, be dull; 1a3) to be honoured; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be made heavy, be honoured, enjoy honour, be made abundant; 1b2) to get oneself glory or honour, gain glory; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to make heavy, make dull, make insensible; 1c2) to make honourable, honour, glorify; 1d) (Pual) to be made honourable, be honoured; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to make heavy; 1e2) to make heavy, make dull, make unresponsive; 1e3) to cause to be honoured; 1f) (Hithpael); 1f1) to make oneself heavy, make oneself dense, make oneself numerous; 1f2) to honour oneself
H3513.kjvUsage: abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, [idiom] be dim, glorify, be (make) glorious (things), glory, (very) great, be grievous, harden, be (make) heavy, be heavier, lay heavily, (bring to, come to, do, get, be had in) honour (self), (be) honourable (man), lade, [idiom] more be laid, make self many, nobles, prevail, promote (to honour), be rich, be (go) sore, stop

H3514.definition: from H3513; 1) weight, heaviness, mass, great; 1a) heaviness, weight; 1b) mass, abundance; 1c) vehemence, heaviness

H3515.definition: from H3513; 1) heavy, great; 1a) heavy; 1b) massive, abundant, numerous; 1c) heavy, dull; 1d) hard, difficult, burdensome; 1e) very oppressive, numerous, rich
H3515.kjvUsage: (so) great, grievous, hard(-ened), (too) heavy(-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick

H3516.definition: the same as H3515; 1) the liver; 1a) the liver (as the heaviest organ)

H3518.definition: a primitive root; 1) to quench, put out, be put out, be quenched, be extinguished; 1a) (Qal) to be quenched, be extinguished; 1b) (Piel) to quench, extinguish

H3519.definition: rarely כָּבֹד; from H3513; 1) glory, honour, glorious, abundance; 1a) abundance, riches; 1b) honour, splendour, glory; 1c) honour, dignity; 1d) honour, reputation; 1e) honour, reverence, glory; 1f) glory

H3520.definition: irregular feminine passive participle of H3513; 1) abundance, riches, wealth; 2) gloriousness, glorious

H3521.definition: from the same as H3525 in the sense of limitation; sterile; Cabul = "binding"; 1) a city on the border of Asher and located approx 10 miles (16 km) east of Akko; modern 'Kabul'; 2) a district in Galilee given by Solomon to Hiram and contemptuously called 'Cabul' by Hiram

H3522.definition: from an unused root meaning to heap up; hilly; Cabbon = "the builder"; 1) a town in the low country of Judah

H3523.definition: from H3527 in the original sense of plaiting; 1) (something) netted, a quilt, fly net, pillow

H3524.definition: from H3527; 1) mighty, great, powerful, many, much
H3524.kjvUsage: [phrase] feeble, mighty, most, much, strong, valiant

H3525.definition: from an unused root meaning to twine or braid together; 1) bond(s), fetter(s)

H3526.definition: a primitive root; 1) to wash (by treading), be washed, perform the work of a fuller; 1a) (Qal) washer, fuller, treader (participle); 1b) (Piel) to wash (garments, person); 1c) (Pual) to be washed; 1d) (Hothpael) to be washed out

H3527.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be much, be many, be in abundance, intertwine, multiply; 1a) (Hiphil) to make many, make great

H3528.definition: from H3527; 1) already, long ago, a great while

H3529.definition: the same as H3528; length; Chebar = "far-off"; 1) a Babylonian river near which many Israelite exiles settled; maybe the 'Habor' or the 'Royal Canal' of Nebuchadnezzar

H3531.definition: from H3527 in its original sense; 1) sieve, sifter

H3532.definition: from an unused root meaning to dominate; 1) lamb, sheep, young ram

H3533.definition: a primitive root; 1) to subject, subdue, force, keep under, bring into bondage; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to bring into bondage, make subservient; 1a2) to subdue, force, violate; 1a3) to subdue, dominate, tread down; 1b) (Niphal) to be subdued; 1c) (Piel) to subdue; 1d) (Hiphil) to bring into bondage
H3533.kjvUsage: bring into bondage, force, keep under, subdue, bring into subjection

H3535.definition: or כַּבְשָׂה; feminine of H3532; 1) ewe-lamb, lamb

H3536.definition: from H3533; 1) kiln (pottery or lime), smelting forge, furnace

H3537.definition: from an unused root meaning to deepen; 1) jar, large jar (portable)

H3538.definition: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H3576; 1) false, lying

H3539.definition: from the same as H3537 in the sense of striking fire from a metal forged; 1) a precious stone (maybe ruby, agate)

H3540.definition: of foreign origin; Chedorlaomer = "handful of sheaves"; 1) the king of Elam defeated by Abraham

H3541.definition: from the prefix k and H1931; 1) thus, here, in this manner; 1a) thus, so; 1b) here, here and there; 1c) until now, until now...until then, meanwhile
H3541.kjvUsage: also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder

H3542.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H3541 1) here, so far, thus

H3543.definition: a primitive root; 1) to grow weak, grow dim, grow faint, falter, be weak, be dim, be darkened, be restrained, be faint, fail; 1a) (Qal) to grow dim, grow faint; 1b) (Piel) to faint, grow weak, grow faint
H3543.kjvUsage: darken, be dim, fail, faint, restrain, [idiom] utterly

H3999.definition: from H2986 in the sense of flowing; 1) flood, deluge.; 1a) Noah's flood that submerged the entire planet earth under water for about a year; ++++; Some think Noah's flood was only local. However the description of it found in Gen. 6 through 8 makes this patently absurd. If it was local, Noah had 120 years to migrate out of the area to safe ground! Why waste all that effort building a ship? He only had to move less than 1500 feet a day to reach the farthest point on the globe! With the possible exception of Ps 29:10, this word always refers to Noah's flood. The real reason for insisting on a local flood is the acceptance of evolution with its long geological ages. Most holding that view are not willing to allow a global world wide flood to have happened less than 5000 years ago. To admit such eliminates the need for the geological ages for most of the geological column would have been rapidly laid down by Noah's flood.

H5602.definition: from an unused root meaning to depress; 1) bowl, basin

H5604.definition: from H5603; 1) cover, cover in, panel, wainscotting

H5605.definition: a primitive root; properly, to snatch away, i.e. terminate; but used only as denominative from H5592 (in the sense of a vestibule), 1) (Hithpoel) to stand at or guard the threshold

H5606.definition: or שָׂפַק; (1 Kings 20:10; Job 27:23; Isaiah 2:6), a primitive root; 1) to clap, slap; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to slap, clap; 1a2) to slap, chastise; 1a3) to splash, throw up; 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to clap

H5607.definition: or שֶׂפֶק; (Job 20:22; Job 36:18), from H5606; 1) handclapping, mocking, mockery, scorn; 1a) meaning dubious

H5613.definition: (Aramaic) from the same as H5609; 1) scribe, secretary

H5614.definition: of foreign derivation; Sepharad = "separated"; 1) a place where Israelites were exiled; site unknown

H5616.definition: patrial from H5617; Sepharvites see Sepharvaim = "enumeration"; 1) an inhabitant of Sepharvaim

H5617.definition: (dual) Sepharvaim = "the two Sipparas"; 1) a city in Syria conquered by the king of Assyria; 1a) perhaps near the modern 'Mosaib' and on the Euphrates above Babylon

H5618.definition: feminine active participle of H5608; a scribe (properly, female); Sophereth = "writing"; 1) an ancestor of a family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel

H5619.definition: a primitive root; 1) to stone (to death), put to death by stoning; 1a) (Qal) to pelt with stones, stone to death; 1b) (Niphal) to be stoned to death; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to stone, pelt with stones; 1c2) to free from stones (of vineyard, highway); 1d) (Pual) to be stoned to death

H5620.definition: contracted from H5637; 1) stubborn, implacable, rebellious, resentful, sullen

H5621.definition: from an unused root meaning to sting; 1) brier, rebel; 1a) meaning dubious

H5622.definition: (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; 1) mantle, coat; 1a) meaning dubious; perhaps also 'a babouche' (oriental slipper)

H5623.definition: of foreign derivation; Sargon = "prince of the sun"; 1) king of Assyria, son of Shalmaneser, and father of Sennacherib; ruled from 721-702 BC; conqueror of Samaria

H5624.definition: from a primitive root meaning to tremble; trembling; Sered = "fear"; 1) the 1st son of Zebulun

H5625.definition: patron from H5624; Sardites = see Sered "fright"; 1) descendants of Sered, the 1st born son of Zebulun

H5626.definition: from H5493; departure; Sirah = "the turning"; 1) a well or cistern; apparently on the road north from Hebron

H5627.definition: from H5493; 1) apostasy, defection, turning aside, withdrawal; 1a) defection (of moral or legal offenses); 1b) apostasy; 1c) withdrawal (negated)
H5627.kjvUsage: [idiom] continual, rebellion, revolt(-ed), turn away, wrong

H5628.definition: a primitive root; 1) to go free, be unrestrained, be overrun, exceed, overhang, grow luxuriously; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go free, be unrestrained, sprawl; 1a1a) overrunning, spreading (participle); 1a2) to overhang; 1b) (Niphal) to be let loose or dismissed or gone
H5628.kjvUsage: exceeding, hand, spread, stretch self, banish

H5631.definition: or סָרִס; from an unused root meaning to castrate; 1) official, eunuch

H5633.definition: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; 1) lord, ruler, tyrant; 2) axle

H5636.definition: from H5635; 1) an unidentified desert plant; 1a) meaning doubtful; perhaps brier, nettle

H5637.definition: a primitive root; 1) to rebel, be stubborn, be rebellious, be refractory; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be stubborn; 1a2) stubborn, rebel (subst)
H5637.kjvUsage: [idiom] away, backsliding, rebellious, revolter(-ing), slide back, stubborn, withdrew

H5638.definition: from an unused root meaning to hide; 1) winter, rainy season

H5639.definition: from H5641; hidden; Sethur = "hidden"; 1) son of Michael, the spy from the tribe of Asher

H5640.definition: or שָׂתַם; (Numbers 24:15), a primitive root; 1) to stop up, shut up, keep close; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to stop up; 1a2) to shut up, keep close; 1a3) secret (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be stopped up; 1c) (Piel) to stop up
H5640.kjvUsage: closed up, hidden, secret, shut out (up), stop

H5641.definition: a primitive root; 1) to hide, conceal; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to hide oneself; 1a2) to be hidden, be concealed; 1b) (Piel) to hide carefully; 1c) (Pual) to be hidden carefully, be concealed; 1d) (Hiphil) to conceal, hide; 1e) (Hithpael) to hide oneself carefully
H5641.kjvUsage: be absent, keep close, conceal, hide (self), (keep) secret, [idiom] surely

H5642.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5641; 1) (Pael) to hide, remove from sight; 2) (P'al) destroy

H5643.definition: or (feminine) סִתְרָה; (Deuteronomy [32:38), from H5641; n m; 1) covering, shelter, hiding place, secrecy; 1a) covering, cover; 1b) hiding place, shelter, secret place; 1c) secrecy; 1c1) secrecy (of tongue being slanderous); n f; 2) shelter, protection
H5643.kjvUsage: backbiting, covering, covert, [idiom] disguise(-th), hiding place, privily, protection, secret(-ly, place)

H5644.definition: from H5643; protective; Zithri = "protection of Jehovah"; 1) son of Uzziel and grandson of Kohath the son of Levi; 1a) more properly 'Sithri'

H5645.definition: (masculine and feminine); from H5743; 1) darkness, cloud, thicket; 1a) dark cloud; 1b) cloud mass; 1c) thicket (as refuge)
H5645.kjvUsage: clay, (thick) cloud, [idiom] thick, thicket. Compare H5672

H5646.definition: or עֹב; from an unused root meaning to cover; properly, equivalent to H5645; but used only as an architectural term, 1) an architectural term; 1a) meaning dubious; perhaps projecting roof, landing, thick beam, plank, threshold

H5647.definition: a primitive root; 1) to work, serve; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to labour, work, do work; 1a2) to work for another, serve another by labour; 1a3) to serve as subjects; 1a4) to serve (God); 1a5) to serve (with Levitical service); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be worked, be tilled (of land); 1b2) to make oneself a servant; 1c) (Pual) to be worked; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to compel to labour or work, cause to labour, cause to serve; 1d2) to cause to serve as subjects; 1e) (Hophal) to be led or enticed to serve

H5648.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5647; 1) to make, do; 1a)(P'al); 1a1) to make, create; 1a2) to do, perform; 1b) (Ithp'al); 1b1) to be made into; 1b2) to be done, be wrought, be performed, be executed, be carried out
H5648.kjvUsage: [idiom] cut, do, execute, go on, make, move, work

H5650.definition: from H5647; 1) slave, servant; 1a) slave, servant, man-servant; 1b) subjects; 1c) servants, worshippers (of God); 1d) servant (in special sense as prophets, Levites etc); 1e) servant (of Israel); 1f) servant (as form of address between equals)

H5651.definition: the same as H5650; Ebed = "servant"; 1) father of Gaal in the time of the judges; 2) son of Jonathan and one of the sons of Adin who returned from exile with Ezra

H5653.definition: from H5647; work; Abda = "servant of Jehovah"; 1) father of Adoniram; 2) a Levite, son of Shammua; also called 'Obadiah'

H5654.definition: from the active participle of H5647 and H123; worker of Edom; Obed-edom = "servant of Edom"; 1) a Levite and a Gittite who kept the ark after Uzzah was slain by God for touching the ark while it was being taken to Jerusalem; 2) a Merarite Levite and a singer and gatekeeper; 2a) the family descended from him

H5655.definition: from H5647 and H410; serving God; Abdeel = "servant of God"; 1) father of Shelemiah of Judah in the time of Jeremiah

H5656.definition: or עֲבוֹדָה; from H5647; 1) labour, service; 1a) labour, work; 1b) labour (of servant or slave); 1c) labour, service (of captives or subjects); 1d) service (of God)
H5656.kjvUsage: act, bondage, [phrase] bondservant, effect, labour, ministering(-try), office, service(-ile, -itude), tillage, use, work, [idiom] wrought

H5657.definition: passive participle of H5647; 1) service, household servants

H5658.definition: from H5647; servitude; Abdon = "servile"; n pr m; 1) a judge of Israel in the time of the judges; perhaps the same as 'Bedan'; 2) a Benjamite, son of Shashak; 3) a Gibeonite, son of Jehiel and a grandson of Gideon; 4) son of Micah in the time of king Josiah of Judah; also 'Achbor'; n pr loc; 5) a city in Asher allotted to the Gershonite Levites; located 10 miles (16 km) north of Accho; modern 'Abdeh'

H5660.definition: from H5647; serviceable; Abdi = "servant of Jehovah"; 1) a Merarite Levite and ancestor of Ethan the singer; 2) a Merarite Levite, father of Kish, in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah; 3) one of the family of Elam who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H5661.definition: from H5650 and H410; servant of God; Abdiel = "servant of God"; 1) a Gadite, son of Guni and father of Ahi and one who settled in the land of Bashan in the time of king Jotham of Judah

H5662.definition: or עֹבַדְיָהוּ; active participle of H5647 and H3050; serving Jah; Obadiah = "servant of Jehovah"; 1) the 4th of the 12 minor prophets; nothing personal is known of him but it is probable that he was contemporary with Jeremiah, Ezekiel, and Daniel; 1a) the prophetic book by him; prophesies against Edom; 2) father of Ishmaiah, one of the chiefs of Zebulun in the time of David; 3) a Merarite Levite overseer of the work of restoring the temple in the time of king Josiah of Judah; 4) chief of the household of king Ahab of Israel; an devout worshipper of Jehovah who at risk to his own life hid over 100 prophets during the persecution of Jezebel; 5) a descendant of David; 6) a chief of the tribe of Issachar; 7) a Benjamite, one of the 6 sons of Azel and a descendant of king Saul; 8) a Levite, son of Shemaiah and a descendant of Jeduthun; 9) a Gadite chief, the 2nd of the lion-faced Gadites who joined David at Ziklag; 10) a prince of Judah in the time of king Jehoshaphat of Judah; 11) a priest, son of Jehiel of the sons of Joab who returned from exile with Ezra; 12) a gatekeeper in the time of Nehemiah; 13) one of the men who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; 13a) perhaps the same as 12

H5663.definition: from H5650 and H4428; servant of a king; Ebed-melech = "servant of the king"; 1) an Ethiopian eunuch in the service of king Zedekiah, through whose interference Jeremiah was released from prison

H5664.definition: the same as H5665; Abed-nego = "servant of Nebo"; 1) the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Abednego; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord; 1a) also, 'Azariah' ( H05838 or H05839)

H5665.definition: (Aramaic) of foreign origin; Abed-nego = "servant of Nebo"; 1) the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Abednego; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord; 1a) also, 'Azariah' ( H05838 or H05839)

H5666.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be thick, be fat, be gross; 1a) (Qal) to be fat, be thick, be gross

H5667.definition: or עֲבֹט; from H5670; 1) pledge, a thing given as security, article pledged as security for debt

H5670.kjvUsage: borrow, break (ranks), fetch (a pledge), lend, [idiom] surely

H5676.definition: from H5674; 1) region beyond or across, side; 1a) region across or beyond; 1b) side, opposite side
H5676.kjvUsage: [idiom] against, beyond, by, [idiom] from, over, passage, quarter, (other, this) side, straight

H5677.definition: the same as H5676; Eber or Heber = "the region beyond"; 1) son of Salah, great grandson of Shem, father of Peleg and Joktan; 2) a Gadite chief; 3) a Benjamite, son of Elpaal and descendant of Sharahaim; 4) a Benjamite, son of Shashak; 5) a priest in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua

H5678.definition: feminine of H5676; 1) outpouring, overflow, excess, fury, wrath, arrogance; 1a) overflow, excess, outburst; 1b) arrogance; 1c) overflowing rage or fury

H5680.definition: patronymic from H5677; Hebrew = "one from beyond"; n pr; 1) a designation of the patriarchs and the Israelites; adj; 2) a designation of the patriarchs and the Israelites

H5681.definition: the same as H5680; Ibri = "Hebrew"; 1) a Merarite Levite of the family of Jaaziah in the time of David

H5684.definition: feminine of H5683; Ebronah = "passage"; 1) one of the stations of the Israelites in the wilderness immediately preceding Ezion-geber

H5686.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Piel) to wind, weave, weave together

H5687.definition: or עָבוֹת; from H5686; 1) having interwoven foliage, leafy, dense with foliage

H5688.definition: or עֲבוֹת; or (feminine) עֲבֹתָה; the same as H5687; 1) cord, rope, cordage, foliage, interwoven foliage; 1a) cord, rope, cordage, chain; 1b) interwoven foliage
H5688.kjvUsage: band, cord, rope, thick bough (branch), wreathen (chain)

H5689.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to have inordinate affection or lust; 1a) lust (participle); 1b) paramours (participle as subst)

H5692.definition: from H5746; 1) disc or cake (of bread); 1a) cake of hot stones (cake baked on hot stones)

H5693.definition: passive part (but with active sense) of an unused root meaning to twitter; 1) name of a bird; 1a) perhaps a thrush, swallow, crane

H5694.definition: from the same as H5696; 1) hoop, ring, earring; 1a) adornment for men or women

H5695.definition: from the same as H5696; 1) calf, bull-calf

H5696.definition: or עָגוֹל; from an unused root meaning to revolve, 1) round

H5698.definition: the same as H5697; Eglah = "a heifer"; 1) a wife of David and mother of Ithream

H5699.definition: from the same as H5696; 1) cart, wagon

H5700.definition: from H5695; vituline; Eglon = "calf-like"; n pr m; 1) king of Moab who oppressed the children of Israel for 18 years before he was killed by the judge Ehud; n pr loc; 2) a royal city in Canaan that opposed the conquest; located in the low lands of Judah

H5701.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to be grieved

H5702.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Niphal) to shut oneself in or off or up

H5704.definition: properly, the same as H5703 (used as a preposition, adverb or conjunction; especially with a preposition); prep; 1) as far as, even to, until, up to, while, as far as; 1a) of space; 1a1) as far as, up to, even to; 1b) in combination; 1b1) from...as far as, both...and (with 'min' -from); 1c) of time; 1c1) even to, until, unto, till, during, end; 1d) of degree; 1d1) even to, to the degree of, even like; conj; 2) until, while, to the point that, so that even

H5705.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5704 prep; 1) even to, until, up to, during; conj; 2) until, up to the time that, ere that
H5705.kjvUsage: [idiom] and, at, for, (hither-) to, on till, (un-) to, until, within

H5706.definition: the same as H5703 in the sense of the aim of an attack; 1) booty, prey

H5707.definition: contracted from H5749; 1) witness; 1a) witness, testimony, evidence (of things); 1b) witness (of people)

H5708.definition: from an unused root meaning to set a period (compare H5710, H5749); 1) menstruation; 1a) filthy rag, stained garment (fig. of best deeds of guilty people)

H5709.definition: (Aramaic) or עֲדָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to H5710 1) to pass on, pass away; 1a)(P'al); 1a1) to pass on, pass over; 1a2) to pass away; 1b) (Aphel) to take away, remove, depose

H5710.definition: a primitive root; 1) to pass on, advance, go on, pass by, remove; 1a) (Qal) to pass on, put on; 1b) (Hiphil) to remove
H5710.kjvUsage: adorn, deck (self), pass by, take away

H5711.definition: from H5710; ornament; Adah = "ornament"; 1) the 1st of the 2 wives of Lamech and mother of Jabal and Jubal; 2) a Hittitess, 1 of the 3 wives of Esau and mother of Eliphaz; 2a) also called 'Bashemath'

H5712.definition: feminine of H5707 in the original sense of fixture; 1) congregation, gathering
H5712.kjvUsage: assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare H5713

H5713.definition: feminine of H5707 in its techn. sense; 1) testimony, witness; 1a) always plural and always of laws as divine testimonies

H5714.definition: or עִדּוֹא; or עִדִּיא; from H5710; timely; Iddo = "His witness"; 1) father of Abinadab, an officer of Solomon; 2) grandfather of the prophet Zechariah; 3) a Gershonite Levite, son of Joah; 4) a priest in the time of Nehemiah; 5) a seer in the time of king Jeroboam of the northern kingdom of Israel; 6) son of Zechariah, ruler of the tribe of Manasseh in the time of David; 7) a chief of the temple slaves who assembled at Casiphia at the time of the 2nd caravan from Babylon

H5716.definition: from H5710 in the sense of trappings; 1) ornaments; 1a) ornaments; 1b) trappings (of horses)

H5717.definition: from H5716 and H410; ornament of God; Adiel = "ornament of God"; 1) a prince of the Simeon of the family of Shimei in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah; 2) a priest, ancestor of Maasiai; 3) ancestor of Azmaveth, the treasurer of David

H5718.definition: or עֲדָיָהוּ; from H5710 and H3050; Jah has adorned; Adaiah = "Jehovah has adorned Himself"; 1) maternal grandfather of king Josiah of Judah and native of Boscath in the lowlands of Judah; 2) a Gershonite Levite and ancestor of Asaph; 3) a Benjamite, son of Shimhi; 4) a priest, son of Jehoram; 5) ancestor of Maaseiah, one of the captains who supported Jehoiada; 6) a descendant of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 7) a descendant of another Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 8) a descendant of Pharez of the tribe of Judah

H5720.definition: the same as H5719; Adin = "dainty" or "delicate"; 1) ancestor of a family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel; 2) a chief among the returned exiles who signed the covenant with Nehemiah

H5721.definition: from H5719; effeminacy; Adina = "slender"; 1) a chief of the Reubenites, and a captain of David

H5722.definition: probably from H5719 in the original sense of slender (i.e. a spear); Adino = "his ornament"; 1) one of David's mighty warriors

H5723.definition: dual of a feminine of H5706; double prey; Adithaim = "double ornament"; 1) a town in the lowland of Judah

H5724.definition: probably from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Adlai = "justice of Jehovah"; 1) ancestor of Shaphat, the overseer of David's herds

H5725.definition: probably from the passive participle of the same as H5724; Adullam = "justice of the people"; 1) a town of the Canaanites allotted to Judah and lying in the lowlands; site of the cave where David hid

H5726.definition: patrial from H5725; Adullamite = see Adullam "justice of the people"; 1) an inhabitant of Adullam

H5727.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Hithpael) to luxuriate, delight oneself

H5728.definition: or עֲדֶנָּה; from H5704 and H2004; 1) hitherto, still, yet

H5729.definition: from H5727; pleasure; Eden = "pleasure"; 1) a place conquered by Assyria; probably located in the northwest of Mesopotamia

H5730.definition: or (feminine) עֶדְנָה; from H5727; 1) luxury, dainty, delight, finery; 2) delight
H5730.kjvUsage: delicate, delight, pleasure. See also H1040

H5731.definition: the same as H5730 (masculine); Eden= "pleasure"; n pr m loc; 1) the first habitat of man after the creation; site unknown; n pr m; 2) a Gershonite Levite, son of Joah in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah

H5732.definition: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of H5708; 1) time; 1a) time (of duration); 1b) year

H5733.definition: from H5727; pleasure; Adna = "rest" or "pleasure"; 1) one of the family of Pahath-moab who returned with Ezra and married a foreign wife; 2) a priest, descendant of Harim in the days of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua

H5734.definition: from H5727; pleasure; Adnah = "pleasure"; 1) a Manassite who deserted from Saul and joined David at Ziklag; 2) a captain in charge of over 300,000 men of Judah in the time of Jehoshaphat

H5735.definition: from H5712; festival; Adadah = "festival" or "boundary"; 1) one of the towns in the extreme south of Judah

H5736.definition: a primitive root; 1) to remain over, be in excess; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be in excess; 1a1a) excess (subst); 1a1b) surplus (participle); 1b) (Hiphil) to have a surplus
H5736.kjvUsage: be more, odd number, be (have) over (and above), overplus, remain

H5737.definition: a primitive root; 1) to help; 1a) (Qal) to help; 2) to hoe; 2a) (Niphal) to be hoed; 3) to be lacking, fail; 3a)(Niphal); 3b1) to be lacking; 3b1) to leave lacking; 3b) (Piel) to leave lacking

H5738.definition: from H5737; an arrangement (i.e. drove); Ader = "flock"; 1) a Benjamite, son of Beriah, chief of the inhabitants of Aijalon; 1a) also 'Eder'

H5739.definition: from H5737; 1) flock, herd; 1a) flock; 1b) herds, flocks and herds

H5740.definition: the same as H5739; Eder = "a flock"; n pr m; 1) a Merarite Levite in the time of David; n pr loc; 2) a town in the extreme south of Judah on the border of Edom; site unknown

H5741.definition: from H5739 and H410; flock of God; Adriel = "flock of God"; 1) son of Barzillai, and the man to whom Saul gave his daughter Merab in marriage although she was already promised to David

H5742.definition: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; 1) lentil

H5744.definition: active participle of H5647; serving; Obed = "serving"; 1) son of Boaz by Ruth and the grandfather of David; 2) a Judaite, a descendant of Jarha, the Egyptian slave of Sheshan, in the line of Jerahmeel; 3) a Judaite, father of Azariah, one of the captains of hundreds who joined with Jehoiada in the revolution by which Athaliah fell; 4) one of David's mighty warriors; 5) son of Shemaiah and a gatekeeper of the temple

H5745.definition: of foreign derivation; Obal = "stripped bare"; 1) a son of Joktan and the founder of an Arab tribe

H5746.definition: a primitive root; properly, to gyrate; but used only as a denominative from H5692, 1) (Qal) to bake, bake a cake

H5747.definition: probably from H5746; round; Og = "long-necked"; 1) the Amorite king of Bashan and one of the last representatives of the giants of Rephaim

H5748.definition: or עֻגָּב; from H5689 in the original sense of breathing; 1) a musical instrument; 1a) perhaps a flute, reed-pipe, or panpipes

H5749.definition: a primitive root; 1) to return, repeat, go about, do again; 1a) (Piel) to surround, go round and round; 1b) (Pilel) to restore, relieve; 1c) (Hithpalel) to be restored; 2) to bear witness; 2a) (Qal) to bear witness, say again and again; 2b) (Hiphil); 2b1) to testify, bear witness; 2b2) to cause to testify, take or call as witness, invoke; 2b3) to protest, affirm solemnly, warn, exhort or enjoin solemnly, admonish, charge; 2c) (Hophal) to protest, give warning
H5749.kjvUsage: admonish, charge, earnestly, lift up, protest, call (take) to record, relieve, rob, solemnly, stand upright, testify, give warning, (bear, call to, give, take to) witness

H5750.definition: or עֹד; from H5749; subst; 1) a going round, continuance; adv; 2) still, yet, again, besides; 2a) still, yet (of continuance or persistence); 2b) still, yet, more (of addition or repetition); 2c) again; 2d) still, moreover, besides
H5750.kjvUsage: again, [idiom] all life long, at all, besides, but, else, further(-more), henceforth, (any) longer, (any) more(-over), [idiom] once, since, (be) still, when, (good, the) while (having being), (as, because, whether, while) yet (within)

H5751.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5750 1) still, while, yet

H5752.definition: or עֹדֵד; from H5749; reiteration; Oded = "restorer"; 1) father of Azariah the prophet in the reign of king Asa of Judah; 2) a prophet of Jehovah in Samaria at the time of Pekah's invasion of Judah

H5753.definition: a primitive root; 1) to bend, twist, distort; 1a) (Niphal) to be bent, be bowed down, be twisted, be perverted; 1b) (Piel) to twist, distort; 1c) (Hiphil) to do perversely; 2) to commit iniquity, do wrong, pervert; 2a) (Qal) to do wrong, commit iniquity; 2b) (Hiphil) to commit iniquity
H5753.kjvUsage: do amiss, bow down, make crooked, commit iniquity, pervert, (do) perverse(-ly), trouble, [idiom] turn, do wickedly, do wrong

H5754.definition: intensive from H5753 abbreviated; 1) distortion, ruin

H5755.definition: or עַוָּא; (2 Kings 17:24), for H5754; Ava or Ivah = "ruin"; 1) a city conquered by the Assyrians

H5756.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Hiphil) to take refuge, bring to refuge, seek refuge

H5757.definition: patrial from H5755; Avims or Avites = "perverters"; 1) inhabitants of Ava or Ivah

H5758.definition: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H5753; 1) perversity, iniquity

H5759.definition: from H5764; 1) young male or man or boy, boy

H5760.definition: from H5765; 1) perverse one, unjust one

H5761.definition: plural of H5757; Avim = "ruins"; n pr m; 1) a people among the early inhabitants of Palestine located in the southwest corner of the seacoast; n pr loc; 2) a city in Benjamin

H5762.definition: or perhaps (עַיּוֹת (as if plural of H5857) (עַיוּת; from H5753; ruin; Avith = "ruins"; 1) the city of Hadad Ben-Bedad, one of the kings of Edom

H5763.definition: a primitive root; 1) to give suck, suckle, nurse; 1a) (Qal) giving suck (participle)

H5765.definition: a primitive root; 1) to act wrongfully or unjustly, deviate from; 1a) (Piel) to act wrongfully

H5766.definition: or עָוֶל; and (feminine) עַוְלָה; or עוֹלָה; or עֹלָה; from H5765; 1) injustice, unrighteousness, wrong; 1a) violent deeds of injustice; 1b) injustice (of speech); 1c) injustice (generally)

H5767.definition: intensive from H5765; 1) unjust one, perverse one, unrighteous one

H5768.definition: or עֹלָל; from H5763; 1) child, boy

H5769.definition: or עֹלָם; from H5956; 1) long duration, antiquity, futurity, for ever, ever, everlasting, evermore, perpetual, old, ancient, world; 1a) ancient time, long time (of past); 1b) (of future); 1b1) for ever, always; 1b2) continuous existence, perpetual; 1b3) everlasting, indefinite or unending future, eternity
H5769.kjvUsage: alway(-s), ancient (time), any more, continuance, eternal, (for, (n-)) ever(-lasting, -more, of old), lasting, long (time), (of) old (time), perpetual, at any time, (beginning of the) world ([phrase] without end). Compare H5331, H5703

H5770.definition: denominative from H5869; 1) to eye, look at; 1a) (Qal) to eye, look at

H5771.definition: or עָווֹן; (2 Kings 7:9; Psalm 51:5 (H7)), from H5753; 1) perversity, depravity, iniquity, guilt or punishment of iniquity; 1a) iniquity; 1b) guilt of iniquity, guilt (as great), guilt (of condition); 1c) consequence of or punishment for iniquity
H5771.kjvUsage: fault, iniquity, mischeif, punishment (of iniquity), sin

H5772.definition: from an unused root apparently meaning to dwell together; 1) cohabitation, conjugal rights

H5774.definition: a primitive root; to cover (with wings or obscurity); hence (as denominative from H5775) v; 1) to fly, fly about, fly away; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to fly, hover; 1a2) to fly away; 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to fly, light upon; 1c) (Polel); 1c1) to fly about or to and fro; 1c2) to cause to fly to and fro, brandish; 1d) (Hithpolel) to fly away; 2) (Qal) to cover, be dark; n f; 3) gloom
H5774.kjvUsage: brandish, be (wax) faint, flee away, fly (away), [idiom] set, shine forth, weary

H5775.definition: from H5774; 1) flying creatures, fowl, insects, birds; 1a) fowl, birds; 1b) winged insects

H5777.definition: or עֹפֶרֶת; feminine participle active of H6080; 1) lead

H5778.definition: from H5775; birdlike; Ephai = "gloomy"; 1) a Netophathite, whose sons were among the captains of the forces left in Judah after the deportation to Babylon

H5779.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to counsel, plan

H5780.definition: apparently from H5779; consultation; Uz = "wooded"; n pr m; 1) son of Aram and grandson of Seth; 2) son of Nahor by Milcah; 3) an Edomite, son of Dishan and grandson of Seir; n pr loc; 4) the country of Job; probably east and southeast of Palestine somewhere in the Arabian desert

H5781.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Hiphil) to totter, cause to totter, crush; 1a) meaning dubious

H5782.definition: a primitive root (rather identical with through the idea of opening the eyes); 1) to rouse oneself, awake, awaken, incite; 1a) (Qal) to rouse oneself, awake; 1b) (Niphal) to be roused; 1c) (Polel) to stir up, rouse, incite; 1d) (Hithpolel) to be excited, be triumphant; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to rouse, stir up; 1e2) to act in an aroused manner, awake
H5782.kjvUsage: (a-) wake(-n, up), lift up (self), [idiom] master, raise (up), stir up (self)

H5783.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Niphal) to be exposed, be bared, be laid bare

H5785.definition: from H5783; 1) skin, hide; 1a) skin (of men); 1b) hide (of animals)

H5786.definition: a primitive root (rather denominatively from H5785 through the idea of a film over the eyes); 1) (Piel) to blind, make blind, put out the eyes of
H5786.kjvUsage: blind, put out. See also H5895

H5787.definition: intensive from H5786; 1) blind; 1a) blind (physically); 1b) blind (fig.)

H5789.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to lend aid, come to help, hasten

H5790.definition: for H5789; 1) (Qal) to hasten to, help, succour; 1a) meaning dubious

H5791.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be bent, be crooked, bend, make crooked, pervert; 1a)(Piel); 1a1) to make crooked, falsify, pervert, subvert; 1a2) to bend, make crooked; 1b) (Pual) thing bent (participle); 1c) (Hithpael) to bend oneself
H5791.kjvUsage: bow self, (make) crooked., falsifying, overthrow, deal perversely, pervert, subvert, turn upside down

H5793.definition: from H5790; succoring; Uthai = "helpful"; 1) son of Ammihud and a descendant of Pharez of Judah; 2) one of the sons of Bigvai who returned from exile with the 2nd caravan with Ezra

H5794.kjvUsage: fierce, [phrase] greedy, mighty, power, roughly, strong

H5795.definition: from H5810; 1) female goat, she-goat, goat, kid

H5797.definition: or (fully) עוֹז; from H5810; 1) might, strength; 1a) material or physical; 1b) personal or social or political
H5797.kjvUsage: boldness, loud, might, power, strength, strong

H5798.definition: or עֻזָּה; feminine of H5797; strength; Uzza or Uzzah = "strength"; n pr m; 1) a man slain by Jehovah for touching the sacred ark; 2) a Benjamite of the sons of Ehud; 3) ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; 4) a Merarite Levite; n pr loc; 5) the garden where kings Manasseh and Amon of Judah were buried

H5799.definition: from H5795 and H235; 1) entire removal, scapegoat; 1a) refers to the goat used for sacrifice for the sins of the people; 1b) meaning dubious

H5800.definition: a primitive root; 1) to leave, loose, forsake; 1a) (Qal) to leave; 1a1) to depart from, leave behind, leave, let alone; 1a2) to leave, abandon, forsake, neglect, apostatise; 1a3) to let loose, set free, let go, free; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be left to; 1b2) to be forsaken; 1c) (Pual) to be deserted; 2) to restore, repair; 2a) (Qal) to repair
H5800.kjvUsage: commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, [idiom] surely

H5801.definition: from H5800 in the sense of letting go (for a price, i.e. selling); 1) wares, goods

H5802.definition: from H5794 and the root of H950; stern depopulator; Azbuk = "strong devastation"; 1) father of Nehemiah, leader of half the district of Beth Zur, and a repairer of the walls of Jerusalem under another Nehemiah

H5803.definition: from H5794 and H1409; stern troop; Azgad = "Gad is mighty"; 1) ancestor of a family of laymen who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; 2) a man who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah

H5804.definition: feminine of H5794; strong; Azzah = "the strong"; 1) another name for 'Gaza', a city of the Philistines located in the extreme southwest of Palestine close to the Mediterranean

H5805.definition: feminine passive participle of H5800; 1) forsakenness, desolation

H5806.definition: the same as H5805; Azubah = "forsaken"; 1) wife of Caleb, the son of Hezron; 2) daughter of Shilhi, wife of king Asa, and mother of king Jehoshaphat of Judah

H5809.definition: or עַזֻּר; from H5826; helpful; Azur or Azzur = "he that assists"; 1) a Benjamite of Gibeon, father of the false prophet Hananiah; 2) father of Jaazaniah, one of the princes against whom Ezekiel was commanded to prophecy

H5810.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be strong; 1a) (Qal) to be strong, prevail; 1b) (Hiphil) to make firm, strengthen
H5810.kjvUsage: harden, impudent, prevail, strengthen (self), be strong

H5811.definition: from H5810; strong; Azaz = "strong"; 1) a Reubenite, father of Bela

H5812.definition: from H5810 and H3050; Jah has strengthened; Azaziah = "Jehovah is mighty"; 1) a Levite musician in the reign of David who played the harp in the procession which brought the ark from Obed-edom to Jerusalem; 2) a Levite in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah in charge of the tithes; 3) father of Hoshea, prince of the tribe of Ephraim when David took the census

H5813.definition: from H5810; forceful; Uzzi = "strong"; 1) a Levite, son of Bukki and father of Zerahiah in the line of the high priest although apparently never high priest himself; 2) son of Tola and grandson of Issachar; 3) a Benjamite, son of Bela and head of a family of Benjamin; 4) son of Michri and father of Elah and an ancestor of a family of returned exiles settling in Jerusalem. Maybe same as 3; 5) a Levite, son of Bani, and an overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; 6) a priest, chief of the father's house of Jedaiah, in the time of Joiakim the high priest; 7) one of the priests who helped Ezra in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem. Maybe same as 6

H5814.definition: perhaps for H5818; Uzzia = "strength of Jehovah"; 1) one of David's mighty warriors

H5815.definition: from H5756 and H410; strengthened of God; Aziel = "whom God comforts"; 1) a Levite; also 'Jaaziel'

H5816.definition: from H5797 and H410; strength of God; Uzziel = "my strength is God"; 1) the 4th son of Kohath and grandson of Levi, uncle of Moses and Aaron; 2) a Simeonite captain, son of Ishi, in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah; 3) descendant of Bela, head of a family in the tribe of Benjamin; 4) a musician of the sons of Heman in the time of David; 5) a Levite of the sons of Jeduthun in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah; 6) son of Harhaiah, probably a priest and a goldsmith, who took part in repairing the wall under Nehemiah

H5817.definition: patronymically from H5816; Uzzielites = see Uzziel "my strength is God"; 1) descendants of Uzziel

H5818.definition: or עֻזִּיָּהוּ; from H5797 and H3050; strength of Jah; Uzziah = "my strength is Jehovah"; 1) son of king Amaziah of Judah and king of Judah himself for 52 years; also 'Azariah'; 2) a Kohathite Levite and ancestor of Samuel; 3) a priest of the sons of Harim who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 4) a Judaite, father of Athaiah or Uthai; 5) father of Jehonathan, one of David's overseers

H5819.definition: from H5756; strengthfulness; Aziza = "strong"; 1) a layman of the family of Zattu who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H5820.definition: from H5794 and H4194; strong one of death; Azmaveth = "strong unto death"; n pr m; 1) one of David's mighty warriors; 2) a descendant of Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan and grandson of king Saul; 3) a Benjamite, father of Jeziel and Pelet who were two of David's men who joined him at Ziklag; 4) overseer of the royal treasures in the reign of David; n pr loc; 5) a place in Benjamin; also 'Beth-azmeveth'

H5821.definition: from H5794; strong one; Azzan = "very strong"; 1) father of Paltiel prince of the tribe of Issachar who represented his tribe in the division of the promised land

H5822.definition: probably feminine of H5797; 1) an unclean bird of prey; 1a) osprey, black eagle, buzzard; 1b) perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown

H5823.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Piel) to dig about

H5824.definition: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H5823; 1) signet-ring

H5825.definition: from H5823; tilled; Azekah = "dug over"; 1) a town in the lowlands of Judah

H5826.definition: a primitive root; 1) to help, succour, support; 1a) (Qal) to help; 1b) (Niphal) to be helped; 1c) (Hiphil) to help

H5827.definition: from H5826; help; Ezer = "treasure"; 1) son of Ephraim who was slain by inhabitants of Gath; 2) a priest who helped at the dedication of the walls of Jerusalem under Nehemiah

H5828.definition: from H5826; 1) help, succour; 1a) help, succour; 1b) one who helps

H5829.definition: the same as H5828; Ezer = "treasure"; 1) father of Hushah of the sons of Hur; 2) a Gadite chief who fought with David; 3) a Levite who aided in repairing the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah

H5830.definition: a variation of H5833; Ezra = "help"; 1) the priest and scribe who led the reforms of the returned exiles in Jerusalem; co-worker with Nehemiah; 2) a priest with Zerubbabel; 3) another post-exilic Jew

H5831.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5830; Ezra = "help"; 1) the priest and scribe who led the reforms of the returned exiles in Jerusalem; co-worker with Nehemiah

H5832.definition: from H5826 and H410; God has helped; Azarael or Azareel = "God has helped"; 1) a Korhite warrior of David who joined him at Ziklag; 2) a Levite musician of the family of Heman in the time of David; 3) a Danite, son of Jeroham and a prince of the tribe at the census of David; 4) one of the sons of Bani who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 5) a priest, ancestor of Maasiai or Amashai, a priest in Jerusalem after the return from exile; 6) a priest and musician in the time of Nehemiah

H5833.definition: or עֶזְרָת; (Psalm 60:11 (13); Psalm 108:12 (13)), feminine of H5828; 1) help, succour, assistance; 1a) help, succour; 1b) one who helps

H5834.definition: the same as H5833; Ezra = "help"; 1) a Judaite, father of Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon

H5835.definition: from H5826 in its original meaning of surrounding; 1) enclosure; 1a) ledge (surrounding Ezekiel's altar); 1b) court (outer one of temple)

H5836.definition: from H5828; helpful; Ezri = "help of Jehovah"; 1) son of Chelub and superintendent of king David's farm labourers

H5837.definition: from H5828 and H410; help of God; Azriel = "my help is God"; 1) a head of a house of the half-tribe of Manasseh beyond the Jordan; 2) a Naphtalite, ancestor of Jerimoth, the head of the tribe at the time of the census of David; 3) father of Seraiah, an officer of king Jehoiakim of Judah

H5838.definition: or עֲזַרְיָהוּ; from H5826 and H3050; Jah has helped; Azariah = "Jehovah has helped"; 1) son of king Amaziah of Judah and king of Judah himself for 52 years; also 'Uzziah'; 2) the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Abednego; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord; 2a) also, 'Abednego' ( H05664 or H05665); 3) son of Nathan and an officer of Solomon; perhaps David's grandson and Solomon's nephew; 4) a prophet in the days of king Asa of Judah; 5) son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and brother to 5; 6) another son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and brother to 4; 7) a priest, son of Ahimaaz, grandson of Zadok and high priest in the reign of king Solomon; 8) the high priest in the reign of king Uzziah of Judah; 9) a priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; probably same as 18; 10) a Kohathite Levite, father of Joel in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah; 11) a Merarite Levite, son of Jehalelel in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah; 12) a Kohathite Levite, son of Zephaniah and ancestor of Samuel the prophet; 13) a Levite who helped Ezra in instructing the people in the law; 14) son of Jeroham and one of the temple captains of Judah in the time of queen Athaliah; probably the same as 21; 15) son of Maaseiah who repaired part of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; 16) one of the leaders who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel; 17) a man who assisted in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; probably the same as 10; 18) son of Johanan, one of the captains of Ephraim in the reign of king Ahaz of Judah; 19) a Judaite, son of Ethan of the sons of Zerah; 20) a Judaite, son of Jehu of the family of the Jerahmeelites and descended from Jarha the Egyptian slave of Sheshan; probably one of the captains of the time of queen Athaliah and the same as 15; 21) a priest, son of Hilkiah; 22) a priest, son of Johanan; 23) son of king Jehoram of Judah; probably clerical error for 'Ahaziah'; 24) son of Meraioth; 25) son of Hoshaiah and one of the proud men who confronted Jeremiah

H5839.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5838; Azariah = "Jehovah has helped"; 1) the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Abednego; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord; 1a) also, 'Abednego' ( H05664 or H05665)

H5840.definition: from H5828 and active participle of H6965; help of an enemy; Azrikam = "help against the enemy"; 1) son of Neariah and descendant of Zerubbabel of the royal line of Judah; 2) a Benjamite, eldest son of Azel and descendant of Saul; 3) a Levite, ancestor of Shemaiah in the time of Nehemiah; 4) governor of the palace of king Ahaz of Judah and victim of murder by Zichri

H5841.definition: patrial from H5804; Gazathites or Gazites = see Gaza "the strong"; 1) an inhabitant of the city of Gaza

H5842.definition: from H5860 (contracted) in the sense of swooping, i.e. side-long stroke; 1) stylus; 1a) iron stylus with diamond tip used to write on stone or metal; 1b) reed pen used on a roll

H5844.definition: a primitive root; 1) to cover, enwrap, wrap oneself, envelop oneself; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to wrap, envelop oneself; 1a2) to cover (the beard in mourning); 1a3) mourner, one who covers (participle); 1b) (Hiphil) to cover, enwrap, envelop; 2) to grasp; 2a) (Qal) to grasp
H5844.kjvUsage: array self, be clad, (put a) cover (-ing, self), fill, put on, [idiom] surely, turn aside

H5845.definition: from an unused root meaning apparently to contain; 1) bucket, pail

H5846.definition: from an unused root meaning to sneeze; 1) sneezing

H6154.definition: or עֶרֶב; (1 Kings 10:15), (with the article [prefix), from H6148; 1) woof; 1a) as mixed, interwoven; 1b) knitted material; 2) mixture, mixed people, mixed company

H6157.definition: from H6148; 1) swarm; 1a) probable meaning from 'mixture' and 'incessant or involved motion'

H6159.definition: or עוֹרֵב; the same as H6158; Oreb = "raven"; n pr m; 1) one of the chieftains of the Midianite army defeated by Gideon; n pr loc; 2) a rock east of the Jordan where Oreb and part of his army fell to the Ephraimites

H6160.definition: from H6150 (in the sense of sterility); 1) desert plain, steppe, desert, wilderness
H6160.kjvUsage: Arabah, champaign, desert, evening, heaven, plain, wilderness. See also H1026

H6161.definition: feminine passive participle of H6048 in the sense of a bargain or exchange; 1) pledge, token, bond, surety, thing exchanged

H6162.definition: from H6148 (in the sense of exchange); 1) pledge, security

H6163.definition: or עַרְבִי; patrial from H6152; Arabian = see Arabia "mixed"; 1) an inhabitant of Arabia; 1a) steppe-dweller

H6164.definition: patrial from H1026; Arbathite = see Betharabah "desert house"; 1) an inhabitant of Beth-arabah

H6165.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to long for, pant after

H6166.definition: from an unused root meaning to sequester itself; fugitive; Arad = "a wild ass"; n pr m; 1) a Benjamite, son of Beriah, who drove out the inhabitants of Gath; n pr loc; 2) a royal city of the Canaanites north of the wilderness of Judah

H6168.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be bare, be nude, uncover, leave destitute, discover, empty, raze, pour out; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to bare, lay bare; 1a2) to lay bare by emptying, empty; 1a3) to pour out; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to make naked, strip bare (of sexual offences); 1b2) to pour out; 1c) (Niphal) to be poured out, be exposed; 1d) (Hithpael); 1d1) to expose oneself, make oneself naked; 1d2) pouring oneself, spreading oneself (participle)
H6168.kjvUsage: leave destitute, discover, empty, make naked, pour (out), rase, spread self, uncover

H6170.definition: or עֲרֻגָה; feminine passive participle of H6165; 1) garden terrace or bed

H6171.definition: from the same as H6166; 1) wild ass

H6172.definition: from H6168; 1) nakedness, nudity, shame, pudenda; 1a) pudenda (implying shameful exposure); 1b) nakedness of a thing, indecency, improper behaviour; 1c) exposed, undefended (fig.)

H6173.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H6172; 1) dishonour, nakedness; 1a) dishonour (metaphor of nakedness)

H6174.definition: or עָרֹם; from H6191 (in its original sense); 1) naked, bare

H6175.definition: passive participle of H6191; 1) subtle, shrewd, crafty, sly, sensible; 1a) crafty; 1b) shrewd, sensible, prudent

H6176.definition: or עַרְעָר; from H6209 reduplicated; 1) naked, stripped, destitute; 2) tree or bush; 2a) probably juniper or cypress

H6177.definition: or עֲרֹעֵר; or עַרְעוֹר; the same as H6176; nudity of situation; Aroer = "ruins"; 1) a city on the north bank of the river Arnon, the southern point of the territory of Sihon the king of the Amorites and later of Reuben; modern 'Arair'; 2) a city in Ammon near the Jabbok belonging to Gad; 3) a town in southern Judah

H6178.definition: passive participle of H6206; 1) dreadful; 2) (CLBL) chasm, ravine, steep slope

H6179.definition: from H5782; watchful; Eri = "watchful"; 1) son of Gad and progenitor of the family of Erites

H6180.definition: patronymically of H6179; Erites = see Erites "watchful"; 1) descendants of Eri, the son of Gad

H6182.definition: from an unused root meaning to comminute; 1) dough, meal, coarse meal, kneading trough; 1a) meaning dubious

H6184.definition: from H6206; 1) awe-inspiring, terror-striking, awesome, terrifying, ruthless, mighty
H6184.kjvUsage: mighty, oppressor, in great power, strong, terrible, violent

H6185.definition: from H6209; 1) stripped, childless, bare of children

H6186.definition: a primitive root; 1) to arrange, set or put or lay in order, set in array, prepare, order, ordain, handle, furnish, esteem, equal, direct, compare; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to arrange or set or lay in order, arrange, state in order, set forth (a legal case), set in place; 1a2) to compare, be comparable; 2) (Hiphil) to value, tax
H6186.kjvUsage: put (set) (the battle, self) in array, compare, direct, equal, esteem, estimate, expert (in war), furnish, handle, join (battle), ordain, (lay, put, reckon up, set) (in) order, prepare, tax, value

H6187.definition: from H6186; 1) order, row, estimate, things that are set in order, layer, pile; 1a) order, row; 1b) estimate, valuation
H6187.kjvUsage: equal, estimation, (things that are set in) order, price, proportion, [idiom] set at, suit, taxation, [idiom] valuest

H6188.definition: a primitive root; properly, to strip; but used as denominative from H6189; 1) to remain uncircumcised, count uncircumcised, count as foreskin; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to regard as uncircumcised; 1a2) to remain unharvested (fig.); 1b) (Niphal) to be counted as uncircumcised
H6188.kjvUsage: count uncircumcised, foreskin to be uncovered

H6189.definition: from H6188; properly, exposed, i.e. projecting loose (as to the prepuce); used only technically, 1) uncircumcised, having foreskin

H6191.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be subtle, be shrewd, be crafty, beware, take crafty counsel, be prudent; 1a) (Qal) to be crafty, be subtle; 1b) (Hiphil) to be crafty, be or become shrewd
H6191.kjvUsage: [idiom] very, beware, take crafty (counsel), be prudent, deal subtilly

H6192.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Niphal) to heap up, pile, be heaped up

H6194.definition: (Jeremiah 50:26) or (feminine) עֲרֵמָה; from H6192; 1) heap, pile

H6195.definition: feminine of H6193; 1) shrewdness, craftiness, prudence

H6196.definition: probably from H6191; 1) plane-tree; 1a) as stripped of bark

H6197.definition: probably from H5782; watchful; Eran = "watcher"; 1) the eldest son of Ephraim

H6198.definition: patronymically from H6197; Eranites = see Eran "watcher"; 1) the descendants of Eran, the son of Ephraim

H6200.definition: patronymically from H6177; Aroerite = see Aroer "destitute"; 1) an inhabitant of Aroer

H6201.definition: a primitive root; 1) to drop, drip; 1a) (Qal) to drop, trickle

H6202.definition: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of sloping); properly, to bend downward; but used only as a denominative from H6203, 1) (Qal) to break the neck (of an animal)
H6202.kjvUsage: that is beheaded, break down, break (cut off, strike off) neck

H6203.definition: from H6202; 1) neck, back of the neck, back; 1a) back of the neck; 1a1) of fleeing foe; 1a2) of apostasy (fig.); 1b) stiff of neck, obstinate (fig.)

H6204.definition: feminine of H6203; mane; Orpah = "gazelle"; 1) a Moabite woman, wife of Chilion, the son of Naomi, and sister-in- law of Ruth

H6205.definition: probably from H6201; 1) cloud, heavy or dark cloud, darkness, gross darkness, thick darkness

H6206.definition: a primitive root; 1) to tremble, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, break, be terrified, cause to tremble; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cause to tremble, terrify; 1b2) to tremble, feel dread; 1b) (Niphal) to be awesome, be terrible; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to regard or treat with awe, regard or treat as awful; 1c2) to inspire with awe, terrify
H6206.kjvUsage: be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly

H6207.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to gnaw, chew

H6208.definition: patrial from an unused name meaning a tush; Arkite = see Arki "gnawing"; 1) an inhabitant of Arki or Arka

H6209.definition: a primitive root; 1) to strip, make bare, strip oneself; 1a) (Qal) to strip, strip oneself; 1b) (Poel) to lay bare; 1c) (Hithpalpel) to be utterly stripped, be utterly laid bare; 1d) (Pilpel) break

H6210.definition: from an unused root meaning perhaps to arch; 1) couch, divan, bed

H6212.definition: from an unused root meaning to glisten (or be green); 1) herb, herbage, grass, green plants

H6213.definition: a primitive root; 1) to do, fashion, accomplish, make; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to do, work, make, produce; 1a1a) to do; 1a1b) to work; 1a1c) to deal (with); 1a1d) to act, act with effect, effect; 1a2) to make; 1a2a) to make; 1a2b) to produce; 1a2c) to prepare; 1a2d) to make (an offering); 1a2e) to attend to, put in order; 1a2f) to observe, celebrate; 1a2g) to acquire (property); 1a2h) to appoint, ordain, institute; 1a2i) to bring about; 1a2j) to use; 1a2k) to spend, pass; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be done; 1b2) to be made; 1b3) to be produced; 1b4) to be offered; 1b5) to be observed; 1b6) to be used; 1c) (Pual) to be made; 2) (Piel) to press, squeeze

H6214.definition: from H6213 and H410; God has made; Asahel = "God-made"; 1) nephew of David, son of David's sister Zeruiah, and brother of Joab and Abishai; swift of foot he was killed by Abner when he pursued him in battle and caught him; 2) a Levite in the reign of king Jehoshaphat of Judah who went through the kingdom giving instruction in the law; 3) a Levite in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah in charge of the tithes and dedicated things in the temple; 4) a priest, father of Jonathan, in the time of Ezra

H6215.definition: apparently a form of the passive participle of H6213 in the original sense of handling; rough (i.e. sensibly felt); Esau = "hairy"; 1) eldest son of Isaac and Rebecca and twin brother of Jacob; sold the birthright for food when he was hungry and the divine blessing went to Jacob; progenitor of the Arab peoples

H6217.definition: or עָשֻׁק; passive participle of H6231; 1) oppression, extortion

H6218.definition: or עָשֹׂר; from H6235; 1) ten, decade; 1a) ten, tenth; 1b) ten-stringed, harp

H6221.definition: from H6213 and H410; made of God; Asiel = "made by God"; 1) a Simeonite and ancestor of Jehu

H6222.definition: from H6213 and H3050; Jah has made; Asaiah or Asahiah = "made by Jehovah"; 1) a prince of the tribe of Simeon in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah; 2) a servant of king Josiah of Judah; 3) a Merarite Levite, chief of his family, in the time of David

H6223.definition: from H6238; adj; 1) rich, wealthy; n; 2) the rich, the wealthy, rich man

H6224.definition: from H6235; 1) ordinal number; 1a) a tenth

H6225.definition: a primitive root; 1) to smoke, be angry, be wroth; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to smoke; 1a2) to fume, be wroth, be furious

H6227.definition: from H6225; 1) smoke; 1a) smoke; 1b) in metaphor, simile; 1c) smoke (fig.)

H6229.definition: a primitive root (identical with H6231); 1) (Hithpael) to strive, contend, quarrel

H6230.definition: from H6229; Esek = "contention"; 1) a well which the herdsmen of Isaac dug in the valley of Gerar

H6231.definition: a primitive root (compare H6229); 1) to press upon, oppress, violate, defraud, do violence, get deceitfully, wrong, extort; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to oppress, wrong, extort; 1a2) to oppress; 1b) (Pual) to be exploited, be crushed
H6231.kjvUsage: get deceitfully, deceive, defraud, drink up, (use) oppress(-ion), -or), do violence (wrong)

H6232.definition: from H6231; oppression; Eshek = "oppressor"; 1) a Benjamite, late descendant of Saul
