H6237.kjvUsage: [idiom] surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), [idiom] truly

H6238.definition: a primitive root; 1) to be or become rich or wealthy, enrich, pretend to be rich; 1a) (Qal) to be or become rich; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to make rich; 1b2) to gain riches; 1c) (Hithpael) to enrich oneself, pretend to be rich
H6238.kjvUsage: be(-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make (1 Kings 22:48 marg). See H6240

H6240.definition: for H6235; 1) ten, -teen (in combination with other numbers); 1a) used only in combination to make the numbers 11-19
H6240.kjvUsage: (eigh-, fif-, four-, nine-, seven-, six-, thir-) teen(-th), [phrase] eleven(-th), [phrase] sixscore thousand, [phrase] twelve(-th)

H6241.definition: or עִשָּׂרֹן; from H6235; 1) tenth part, tithe

H6244.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to waste away, fail

H6245.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Qal) to be smooth, be shiny, gleam; 2) (Hithpael) to think

H6246.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H6245; 1) (P'al) to think, plan

H6247.definition: from H6245; 1) plate, slab, something fabricated

H6249.definition: apparently masculine plural construction of H6247 in the sense of an afterthought (used only in connection with H6240 in lieu of H259) 1) one, eleven, eleventh; 1a) one as combined with ten ( H06240)

H6251.definition: probably from H6238; 1) ewe, flock, increase, young

H6252.definition: or עַשְׁתָּרֹת; plural of H6251; Ashtaroth or Astaroth = "star"; n pr f deity; 1) false goddesses in the Canaanite religion, usually related to fertility cult; n pr loc; 2) a city in Bashan east of the Jordan given to Manasseh; 2a) same as H06255

H6260.definition: or עַתֻּד; from H6257; 1) ram, he-goat, chief one

H6264.definition: from H6257; 1) ready, prepared; 1a) ready; 1b) ready, skilled; 1c) prepared, impending; 1d) prepared, stored up, treasure

H6272.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Niphal) to be burned up, be scorched; 1a) meaning dubious

H6273.definition: from an unused root meaning to force; forcible; Othni = "lion of Jehovah"; 1) a Levite, son of Shemaiah, the first-born of Obed-edom

H6274.definition: from the same as H6273 and H410; force of God; Othniel = "lion of God"; 1) son of Kenaz, younger brother of Caleb, and husband of Achsah the daughter of Caleb and his own niece; first judge of Israel, who after the death of Joshua, delivered the Israelites from the oppression of Chushanrishathaim

H6275.definition: a primitive root; 1) to move, proceed, advance, move on, become old, be removed; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to move; 1a2) to advance (in years), grow old and weak; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to move forward, proceed, move on; 1b2) to remove; 1b3) to transcribe

H6279.definition: a primitive root (rather denominative from H6281); 1) to pray, entreat, supplicate; 1a) (Qal) to pray, entreat; 1b) (Niphal) to be supplicated, be entreated; 1c) (Hiphil) to make supplication, plead

H6285.definition: feminine of H6311; 1) corner, edge, side, quarter, extremity; 1a) corner; 1b) side

H6286.definition: a primitive root; also denominative from H6288, 1) to glorify, beautify, adorn; 1a) (Piel) to glorify, beautify; 1b) (Hithpael); 1b1) to glorify oneself; 1b2) to get glory to oneself, be glorified; 2) (Piel) to go over the boughs

H6288.definition: or פֹּרָאה; or פֻּארָה; from H6286; 1) bough, branch, shoot

H6289.definition: from H6286; 1) glow, heat; 1a) meaning dubious

H6290.definition: from H6286; ornamental; Paran = "place of caverns"; 1) wilderness area bounded on the north by Palestine, on the west by the wilderness of Etham, on the south by the desert of Sinai, and on the east by the valley of Arabah; the exodus was through this area and probably all 18 stops were in this area

H6291.definition: from an unused root meaning to be torpid, i.e. 1) green fig, early fig

H6292.definition: or פִּגֻּל; from an unused root meaning to stink; 1) foul thing, refuse; 1a) unclean sacrificial flesh (only use)

H6293.kjvUsage: come (betwixt), cause to entreat, fall (upon), make intercession, intercessor, intreat, lay, light (upon), meet (together), pray, reach, run

H6297.definition: from H6296; 1) corpse, carcass, monument, stela; 1a) corpse (of man); 1b) carcass (of animals)

H6298.definition: a primitive root; 1) to meet, join, encounter; 1a) (Qal) to meet, encounter; 1b) (Niphal) to meet together, meet each other; 1c) (Piel) to meet, encounter

H6300.definition: from H6299 and H410; God has ransomed; Pedahel = "ransomed by God"; 1) son of Ammihud and prince of the tribe of Naphtali

H6301.definition: from H6299 and H6697; a rock (i.e. God) has ransomed; Pedahzur = "the Rock has ransomed"; 1) father of Gamaliel who was the chief of the tribe of Manasseh at the time of the exodus

H6303.definition: from H6299; ransom; Padon = "ransom"; 1) an head or ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned with Zerubbabel

H6304.definition: or פְּדֻת; from H6929lemma קדְמָה missing vowel, corrected to קֵדְמָה; 1) ransom

H8087.definition: for the same as H8088; Shema = "hear"; n pr m; 1) a Reubenite, son of Joel, father of Azaz, and grandfather of Bela; 2) a Judaite, son of Hebron and father of Raham; 3) a Benjamite, son of Elpaal who along with his brother Beriah were heads of their fathers houses in Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath. Probably the same as 'Shimhi'; 4) an Israelite who stood on the right hand of Ezra as he read the Law to the people

H8088.kjvUsage: bruit, fame, hear(-ing), loud, report, speech, tidings

H8089.definition: from H8085; 1) report, rumour, news, fame

H8090.definition: for H8087; Shema = "hear"; 1) a town in Judah at the limits of the tribe toward Edom in the south; 1a) same as H08088; this word 08090 not found in the Hebrew text

H8091.definition: from H8085; obedient; Shama = "obedient"; 1) son of Hotham the Aroerite, brother of Jeiel, both listed as mighty warriors of David

H8092.definition: for H8093; Shimea = "fame"; 1) son of David by Bathsheba; 2) brother of David, the 3rd son of Jesse; 2a) also 'Shammah', 'Shimma', and 'Shimeah'; 3) a Gershonite Levite, father of Berachiah, and grandfather of Asaph; 4) a Merarite Levite, son of Uzzah, and father of Haggiah

H8093.definition: feminine of H8088; annunciation; Shimeah = "fame"; 1) brother of David, the 3rd son of Jesse; 1a) also 'Shammah', and 'Shimma'

H8094.definition: for H8093; Shemaah = "the rumour"; 1) a Benjamite, the Gibeathite, father of Ahiezer and Joash, both mighty warriors of David who joined him at Ziklag

H8095.definition: from H8085; hearing; Simeon or Shimeon = "heard"; 1) the 2nd son of Jacob by his wife Leah and progenitor of the tribe of Simeon; 2) an Israelite of the sons of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H8096.definition: from H8088; famous; Shimei or Shimhi or Shimi or Shimea = "renowned"; 1) a Benjamite, son of Gera of the house of Saul in the time of David; 2) a Benjamite, son of Elah and commissariat officer in the time of Solomon; 3) the Ramathite in charge of the vineyards of David; 4) son of Gershon and grandson of Levi; 5) a Levite, son of Jeduthun and chief of the 10th division of singers in the time of David; 6) a Levite of the sons of Heman who took part in the purification of the temple in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah; 7) a Levite, brother of Cononiah in charge of receiving the tithes and offerings in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah; 8) a Levite who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 9) a Judaite, son of Pedaiah and brother of Zerubbabel; 10) a Simeonite, son of Zacchur; 11) a Reubenite, son of Gog and father of Micah; 12) one of the sons of Hashum who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 13) one of the sons of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 14) a Benjamite, son of Kish, father of Jair, and grandfather of Mordecai in the time of Esther; 15) a Levite, son of Jahath, grandson of Gershon, and great grandson of Levi; 16) Benjamite, father of Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath. Spelled 'Shimhi'
H8096.kjvUsage: Shimeah (from the margin), Shimei, Shimhi, Shimi

H8097.definition: patronymically from H8096; Shimites = see Shimei "renowned"; 1) descendants of Shimei or Shimi

H8098.definition: or שְׁמַעְיָהוּ; from H8085 and H3050; Jah has heard; Shemaiah = "heard by Jehovah"; 1) a prophet of the Lord in the reign of king Rehoboam of Judah; 2) the Nehelamite, a false prophet in the time of the prophet Jeremiah; 3) father of Delaiah, one of the princes of Judah in the time of the prophet Jeremiah; 4) an inhabitant of Kirjathjearim and father of Urijah, a prophet of the Lord in the time of the prophet Jeremiah; 5) a Judaite, son of Shechaniah, father of Hattush, and descendant of Zerubbabel; 6) a Simeonite, father of Shimri; 7) a Reubenite, son of Joel and father of Gog; 8) a Merarite Levite, son of Hasshub in the time of Nehemiah; 9) a Levite, son of Galal and father of Obadiah; 10) a Levite and head of the family of the sons of Elizaphan who were commissioned to bring the ark to Jerusalem in the time of David; 11) a Levite and scribe, son of Nethaneel in the time of David; 12) a Levite, 1st son of Obed-Edom in the time of David; 13) a Levite, descendant of Jeduthun the singer in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah; 14) a Levite, one of the messengers of Ezra to Iddo; 15) a Levite in the time of king Jehoshaphat of Judah; 16) a Levite, one of several in charge of distributing the free will offerings brought to God to their Levite brethren in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah; 17) a Levite in the time of king Josiah of Judah; 18) head of a family of exiles who returned with Ezra; 19) a priest, of the sons of Harim who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 20) an Israelite of the sons of Harim who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 21) son of Delaiah, grandson of Mehetabeel, and a false prophet hired by Tobiah and Sanballat to give false guidance to Nehemiah; 22) a priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah and participated in the dedication of the wall; 23) a priest who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; 24) a leader of the people at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; 25) grandfather of the priest Zechariah who participated in the dedication of the wall in the time of Nehemiah; 26) another of the priests who along with 25 took part in the dedication of the wall in the time of Nehemiah

H8099.definition: patronymically from H8095; Simeonites = see Simeon "harkening"; 1) descendants of Simeon

H8100.definition: feminine of H8088; annunciation; Shimeath = "report"; 1) an Ammonitess, mother of Jozachar or Zabad, one of the assassins of king Joash of Judah

H8101.definition: patronymically from H8093; Shimeathites =see Shimeath "report"; 1) a family of scribes

H8102.definition: from an unused root meaning to emit a sound; 1) whisper, little

H8103.definition: feminine of H8102; 1) whisper, derision, whispering

H8104.definition: a primitive root; 1) to keep, guard, observe, give heed; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to keep, have charge of; 1a2) to keep, guard, keep watch and ward, protect, save life; 1a2a) watch, watchman (participle); 1a3) to watch for, wait for; 1a4) to watch, observe; 1a5) to keep, retain, treasure up (in memory); 1a6) to keep (within bounds), restrain; 1a7) to observe, celebrate, keep (sabbath or covenant or commands), perform (vow); 1a8) to keep, preserve, protect; 1a9) to keep, reserve; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be on one's guard, take heed, take care, beware; 1b2) to keep oneself, refrain, abstain; 1b3) to be kept, be guarded; 1c) (Piel) to keep, pay heed; 1d) (Hithpael) to keep oneself from
H8104.kjvUsage: beward, be circumspect, take heed (to self), keep(-er, self), mark, look narrowly, observe, preserve, regard, reserve, save (self), sure, (that lay) wait (for), watch(-man)

H8106.definition: the same as H8105; Shemer or Shamer or Shamed = "preserved"; 1) the owner of the hill where the city of Samaria was built; 2) a Merarite Levite, son of Mahli and father of Bani; 3) an Asherite, son of Heber and father of Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram. Also 'Shomer'; 4) a Benjamite, son of Elpaal and builder of the towns of Ono and Lod

H8107.definition: from H8104; n m; 1) night watch, watching, vigil

H8108.definition: feminine of an unused noun from H8104 meaning a guard; 1) guard, watch

H8109.definition: feminine of passive participle of H8104; 1) eyelid

H8110.definition: from H8105 in its original sense; guardianship; Shimron = "watch-height"; n pr m; 1) 4th son of Issachar and the progenitor of the family of Shimronites; n pr loc; 2) a Canaanite royal city allotted to Zebulun

H8111.definition: from the active participle of H8104; watch-station; Samaria = "watch mountain"; 1) the region of northern Palestine associated with the northern kingdom of the 10 tribes of Israel which split from the kingdom after the death of Solomon during the reign of his son Rehoboam and were ruled by Jeroboam; 2) the capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel located 30 miles (50 km) north of Jerusalem and 6 miles (10 km) northwest of Shechem

H8112.definition: from H8110 and a derivative of H4754; guard of lashing; Shimron-meron = "watch-height of Meron"; 1) a Canaanite royal city allotted to Zebulun; 1a) probably the same as 'Shimron'

H8113.definition: from H8105 in its original sense; watchful; Shimri = "vigilant"; 1) a Simeonite, son of Shemaiah and father of Jedaiah; 2) father of Jediael, one of David's mighty warriors; 3) a Merarite Levite, son of Hosah; 4) a Kohathite Levite of the sons of Elizaphan

H8114.definition: or שְׁמַרְיָהוּ; from H8104 and H3050; Jah has guarded; Shemariah = "kept by Jehovah"; 1) a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag; 2) a son of king Rehoboam of Judah; 3) an Israelite of the sons of Harim who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 4) an Israelite of the sons of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H8115.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8111; Samaria = "watch mountain"; 1) the region of northern Palestine associated with the northern kingdom of the 10 tribes of Israelwhich split from the kingdom after the death of Solomon during the reign of his son Rehoboam and were ruled by Jeroboam; 2) the capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel located 30 miles (50 km) north of Jerusalem and 6 miles (10 km) northwest of Shechem

H8116.definition: feminine of H8113; female guard; Shimrith = "vigilant"; 1) a Moabitess, mother of Jehozabad, one of the assassins of king Joash of Judah

H8117.definition: patronymically from H8110; Shimronites = see Shimron "guardian"; 1) descendants of Shimron

H8118.definition: patrial from H8111; Samaritans = "of Samaria"; 1) inhabitants of Samaria

H8119.definition: from H8104; guardship; Shimrath = "guard"; 1) a Benjamite, son of Shimei

H8120.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of H8121 through the idea of activity implied in day-light; 1) (Pael) to minister, serve

H8121.definition: from an unused root meaning to be brilliant; 1) sun; 1a) sun; 1b) sunrise, sun-rising, east, sun-setting, west (of direction); 1c) sun (as object of illicit worship); 1d) openly, publicly (in other phrases); 1e) pinnacles, battlements, shields (as glittering or shining)
H8121.kjvUsage: [phrase] east side(-ward), sun (rising), [phrase] west(-ward), window. See also H1053

H8123.definition: from H8121; sunlight; Samson = "like the sun"; 1) a Danite, son of Manoah, a Nazarite for life, and a judge of Israel for 20 years

H8124.definition: (Aramaic) from H8122; sunny; Shimshai = "sunny"; 1) the scribe for Rehum, the satrap of Judea for the Persian government

H8125.definition: apparently from H8121; sunlike; Shamsherai = "sunlike"; 1) a Benjamite, son of Jeroham

H8126.definition: patronymically from an unused name from H7762 probably meaning garlic-smell; Shumathites = "the exalted"; 1) a descendant or inhabitant of Shumah

H8127.definition: from H8150; compare H8143 1) tooth, ivory; 1a) tooth; 1a1) of man, lex talionis, beast; 1b) tooth, tine (of fork); 1c) ivory; 1c1) as material; 1c2) of commerce; 1d) sharp pointed rock

H8129.definition: the same as H8127; crag; Shen = "crag"; 1) a place in Palestine; 1a) evidently somewhere in the neighbourhood of Mizpah

H8130.definition: a primitive root; 1) to hate, be hateful; 1a) (Qal) to hate; 1a1) of man; 1a2) of God; 1a3) hater, one hating, enemy (participle) (subst); 1b) (Niphal) to be hated; 1c) (Piel) hater (participle); 1c1) of persons, nations, God, wisdom

H8131.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8130 1) (P'al) to hate; 1a) foe (participle)

H8132.definition: a primitive root; 1) to change, alter; 1a) (Qal) to change; 1b) (Piel) to change, alter; 1c) (Pual) to be changed

H8133.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8132 1) to change, be altered, be changed; 1a) (P'al) to change, be changed; 1b) (Pael) to change, transform, frustrate; 1b1) different (participle); 1c) (Ithpael) to be changed; 1d) (Aphel) to change, alter

H8134.definition: probably from H8132 and H1; a father has turned; Shinab = "splendour of the father"; 1) the king of Admah in the time of Abraham

H8135.definition: from H8130; 1) hating, hatred, hate; 1a) hatred; 1a1) of man, God

H8136.definition: from H8132; 1) repetition; 1a) repetitions, twice-told repetition, twice ten thousands, thousands of repetitions, twice-told thousands; 1a1) myriads (in effect)

H8137.definition: apparently of Babylonian origin; Shenazar = "splendid leader"; 1) a Judaite of the royal line, son or grandson of king Jehoiachin of Judah and uncle of Zerubbabel

H8138.definition: a primitive root; 1) to repeat, do again, change, alter; 1a) (Qal) to change; 1b) (Niphal) to be repeated; 1c) (Piel) to change, alter; 1d) (Hithpael) to disguise oneself
H8138.kjvUsage: do (speak, strike) again, alter, double, (be given to) change, disguise, (be) diverse, pervert, prefer, repeat, return, do the second time

H8141.definition: (in plural or (feminine) שָׁנָה; from H8138; 1) year; 1a) as division of time; 1b) as measure of time; 1c) as indication of age; 1d) a lifetime (of years of life)

H8143.definition: from H8127 and the plural apparently of a foreign word; 1) ivory

H8144.definition: of uncertain derivation; 1) scarlet, crimson; 1a) properly, the insect 'coccus ilicis', the dried body of the female yielding colouring matter from which is made the dye used for cloth to colour it scarlet or crimson

H8145.definition: from H8138; 1) second; 1a) second (the ordinal number); 1b) again (a second time); 1c) another, other (something as distinct from something else)

H8146.definition: from H8130; 1) hated, held in aversion

H8147.definition: dual of H8145; feminine שְׁתַּיִם; 1) two; 1a) two (the cardinal number); 1a1) two, both, double, twice; 1b) second (the ordinal number); 1c) in combination with other numbers; 1d) both (a dual number)
H8147.kjvUsage: both, couple, double, second, twain, [phrase] twelfth, [phrase] twelve, [phrase] twenty (sixscore) thousand, twice, two

H8148.definition: from H8150; 1) sharp word, sharp (cutting) word, taunt, gibe

H8149.definition: or שְׂנִיר; from an unused root meaning to be pointed; peak; Senir or Shenir = "snow mountain"; 1) the Amorite name for Mount Hermon

H8150.definition: a primitive root; 1) to sharpen, whet; 1a) (Qal) to whet, sharpen; 1b) (Piel) to sharpen, teach (incisively); 1c)(Hithpolel) to be pierced

H8151.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Piel) to gird up

H8152.definition: probably of foreign derivation; Shinar = "country of two rivers"; 1) the ancient name for the territory later known as Babylonia or Chaldea

H8154.definition: or שָׁשָׂה; (Isaiah 10:13), a primitive root; 1) to spoil, plunder, take spoil; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to plunder; 1a2) plunderers (participle); 1b) (Poel) to plunder

H8155.definition: a primitive root; 1) to plunder, spoil; 1a) (Qal) to plunder; 1b) (Niphal) to be plundered, be rifled

H8156.definition: a primitive root; 1) to divide, cleave, part, split; 1a) (Qal) cleaving, cleft (participle); 1b) (Piel) to tear in two, cleave in two

H8158.definition: a primitive root; 1) (Piel) to hew in pieces, cut in pieces; 1a) meaning dubious

H8159.definition: a primitive root; 1) to look at or to, regard, gaze at or about; 1a) (Qal) to gaze at, regard, behold, look about; 1b) (Hiphil) to look away, cause gaze to turn away; 1c) (Hithpael) to look in dismay, gaze about (in anxiety)
H8159.kjvUsage: depart, be dim, be dismayed, look (away), regard, have respect, spare, turn

H8160.definition: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H8159; 1) brief time, moment

H8161.definition: feminine from an unused root meaning to stamp; 1) stamping (of hoofs), crushing noise

H8162.definition: probably of foreign derivation; 1) mixed stuff, fabric of mixed weave, linsey-woolsey; 1a) a kind of cloth forbidden for garments; 1b) cloth made by weaving linen and wool together
H8162.kjvUsage: garment of divers sorts, linen and wollen

H8163.definition: or שָׂעִר; from H8175; adj; 1) hairy; n m; 2) he-goat, buck; 2a) as sacrificial animal; 2b) satyr, may refer to a demon possessed goat like the swine of Gadara (Mt 8:30-32)
H8163.kjvUsage: devil, goat, hairy, kid, rough, satyr

H8164.definition: formed the same as H8163; 1) raindrops, rain showers

H8165.definition: formed like H8163; rough; Seir = "hairy" or "shaggy"; n pr m; 1) patriarch of the Horites, the inhabitants of Edom before the descendants of Esau, the Edomites; n pr terr; 2) the land of Edom, south of the Dead Sea n pr mont; 3) a mountain range in Edom extending from the Dead Sea to the Elanitic Gulf; 3a) apparently also called 'Mount Seir' and extending most of the distance of the mountain range itself; 4) a mountain in northern Judah lying westward from Kirjath-jearim

H8167.definition: formed as H8166; roughness; Seirath = "the shaggy"; 1) a place probably in southeast Ephraim

H8168.definition: from an unused root meaning to hollow out; 1) hollow hand, hollow of hand, handful; 1a) hollow hand, hollow of hand; 1b) handful

H8169.definition: or שַׁעֲלַבִּין; plural from H7776; fox-holes; Shaalbim or Shaalabbin = "place of foxes"; 1) a town in Dan occupied by the Amorites

H8170.definition: patrial from H8169; Shaalbonite = see Shaalbim "place of foxes"; 1) an inhabitant of Shaalbim or Shaalabbin

H8171.definition: plural of H7776; foxes; Shalim = "foxes"; 1) a district in Israel

H8172.definition: a primitive root; 1) to lean on, trust in, support; 1a) (Niphal) to lean, lean upon, support oneself; 1a1) of trust in God (fig)
H8172.kjvUsage: lean, lie, rely, rest (on, self), stay

H8173.definition: a primitive root; 1) to stroke, be smeared over, be blinded; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be smeared over, be blinded; 1a2) to smear eyes shut; 1b) (Hiphil) to besmear (of eyes), smear over eyes; 1c) (Hithpalpel) to blind oneself, be blinded; 2) to sport, take delight in; 2a) (Pilpel) to sport, delight in, take delight in, delight oneself; 2b) (Palpal) to be fondled; 2c) (Hithpalpel) to delight oneself
H8173.kjvUsage: cry (out) (by confusion with H7768), dandle, delight (self), play, shut

H8174.definition: from H5586; fluctuation; Shaaph = "division"; 1) son of Jahdai of the family of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel; 2) son of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, by his concubine Maachah and father of Madmannah

H8175.definition: a primitive root; 1) to storm, shiver, dread, bristle (with horror), be very afraid; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to bristle (with horror); 1a2) to dread; 2) to storm away, sweep away, whirl away; 2a) (Qal); 2a1) to sweep away; 2a2) to storm away (of God's action against the wicked) (fig); 2b) (Niphal) to be stormy, be tempestuous (exceedingly); 2c) (Piel) to whirl away, be stormed away; 2d) (Hithpael) to storm against, come as a storm
H8175.kjvUsage: be (horribly) afraid, fear, hurl as a storm, be tempestuous, come like (take away as with) a whirlwind

H8176.definition: a primitive root; to split or open, i.e. (literally, but only as denominative from H8179); compare see H7778 1) to split open, reason out, calculate, reckon, estimate; 1a) (Qal) to calculate Pr 23:7

H8178.definition: from H8175; 1) storm, tempest, terror, horror
H8178.kjvUsage: affrighted, [idiom] horribly, [idiom] sore, storm. See H8181

H8179.definition: from H8176 in its original sense; 1) gate; 1a) gate (of entrance); 1b) gate (of space inside gate, i.e. marketplace, public meeting place); 1b1) city, town; 1c) gate (of palace, royal castle, temple, court of tabernacle); 1d) heaven

H8180.definition: from H8176; 1) a unit of measure; 1a) 100 measures = 100 for 1 = 100 fold

H8181.definition: or שַׂעַר; (Isaiah 7:20), from H8175 in the sense of dishevelling; 1) hair; 1a) hair (of animals, man); 1b) hair (of garment made of hair)

H8182.definition: from H8176; 1) horrid, disgusting, vile, offensive

H8184.definition: or שְׂעוֹרָה (feminine meaning the plant); and (masculine meaning the grain); also שְׂעֹר; or שְׂעוֹר; from H8175 in the sense of roughness; 1) barley; 1a) barley (of the plant); 1b) barley (of the meal or grain)

H8185.definition: feminine of H8181; 1) a single hair

H8186.definition: or שַׁעֲרִירִיָּה; or שַׁעֲרֻרִת; feminine from H8176 in the sense of H8175; 1) horrible thing

H8187.definition: from H8176 and H3050; Jah has stormed; Sheariah = "valued by Jehovah"; 1) a Benjamite of the family of Saul, one of the 6 sons of Azel

H8188.definition: masculine plural of H8184; barley grains; Seorim = "barley"; 1) a priest in the time of David in charge of the 4th course of service

H8189.definition: dual of H8179; double gates; Shaaraim = "double gate"; 1) a town in Judah; 2) a town in Simeon

H8190.definition: of Persian derivation; Shaashgaz = "servant of the beautiful"; 1) the eunuch in the palace of Xerxes who was in charge of the women in the 2nd house

H8191.definition: from H8173; 1) delight, enjoyment; 1a) delight; 1b) object of delight

H8192.definition: a primitive root; 1) to sweep bare, scrape; 1a) (Niphal) to be wind-swept, be bare, be scraped barren (by wind); 1b) (Pual) to be bare, be laid bare

H8193.definition: or (in dual and plural) שֶׂפֶת; probably from H5595 or H8192 through the idea of termination (compare H5490); 1) lip, language, speech, shore, bank, brink, brim, side, edge, border, binding; 1a) lip (as body part); 1b) language; 1c) edge, shore, bank (of cup, sea, river, etc)
H8193.kjvUsage: band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, (sea-)shore, side, speech, talk, (vain) words

H8194.definition: from H8192 in the sense of clarifying; 1) cream, cheese; 1a) meaning dubious

H8195.definition: or שְׁפִי; from H8192; baldness (compare H8205); Shepho or Shephi = "bold"; 1) an Edomite, son of Shobal of the sons of Seir

H8196.definition: or שְׁפוּט; from H8199; 1) judgment, act of judgment

H8197.definition: or שְׁפוּפָן; from the same as H8207; serpent-like; Shephuphan or Shupham = "serpent"; 1) son of Bela and grandson of Benjamin

H8198.definition: feminine from an unused root meaning to spread out (as a family; see H4940); 1) maid, maid-servant, slavegirl; 1a) maid, maid-servant (as belonging to a mistress); 1b) of address, speaker, humility (fig)

H8199.definition: a primitive root; 1) to judge, govern, vindicate, punish; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to act as law-giver or judge or governor (of God, man); 1a1a) to rule, govern, judge; 1a2) to decide controversy (of God, man); 1a3) to execute judgment; 1a3a) discriminating (of man); 1a3b) vindicating; 1a3c) condemning and punishing; 1a3d) at theophanic advent for final judgment; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to enter into controversy, plead, have controversy together; 1b2) to be judged; 1c) (Poel) judge, opponent-at-law (participle)
H8199.kjvUsage: [phrase] avenge, [idiom] that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge(-ment), [idiom] needs, plead, reason, rule

H8200.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to H8199; 1) to judge; 1a) (P'al) judge (participle)

H8201.definition: from H8199; 1) judgment, act of judgment

H8438.definition: and (feminine) תּוֹלֵעָה; or תּוֹלַעַת; or תֹּלַעַת; from H3216; a maggot (as voracious); specifically (often with ellipsis of H8144) 1) worm, scarlet stuff, crimson; 1a) worm-the female 'coccus ilicis'; 1b) scarlet stuff, crimson, scarlet; 1b1) the dye made from the dried body of the female of the worm "coccus ilicis"; 2) worm, maggot; 2a) worm, grub; 2b) the worm "coccus ilicis"; ++++; When the female of the scarlet worm species was ready to give birth to her young, she would attach her body to the trunk of a tree, fixing herself so firmly and permanently that she would never leave again. The eggs deposited beneath her body were thus protected until the larvae were hatched and able to enter their own life cycle. As the mother died, the crimson fluid stained her body and the surrounding wood. From the dead bodies of such female scarlet worms, the commercial scarlet dyes of antiquity were extracted. What a picture this gives of Christ, dying on the tree, shedding His precious blood that He might "bring many sons unto glory" (Heb 2:10)! He died for us, that we might live through him! Ps 22:6 describes such a worm and gives us this picture of Christ. (cf. Isa 1:18) (from page 73, "Biblical Basis for Modern Science", 1985, Baker Book House, by Henry Morris)
